༄༅/ /bod kyi brda yig mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bod kyi brda yig mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo bud+dhā ya// bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshigs le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ yang dag par gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan dpe'i gzi byin gser gyi ri 'dra'i sku// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnga chen po'i gsung*// ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa'i thugs// thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma phyag gi gnas// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i phung po cig car du// skal bzang yid mkhar 'gog pa med pa'i gzugs// phan bde'i 'od dkar legs bshad bsil zer can// 'jam mgon smra ba'i zla ba mchog der 'dud// ye shes sgyu 'phrul mdzes sku'i 'jo sgeg dang*// sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud mang snyan 'gyur gyis// snying la zag med bde ster lhag pa'i lha// dbyangs can lha mos blo yi mchog sbyin mdzod// sngon med yi ge'i ngo mtshar snang ba sogs// legs bshad 'od brgyas byang phyogs mun gling 'dir// thub bstan gsal mdzad sam+bho ṭa la sogs// rgya bod mkhas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros rtul zhing sbyangs pa'i mthu chung yang*// tshad ldan mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas// 'khrul ba'i mun chen drung 'byin brda sprod kyi// bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag sgron rab gsal bya// brjod don kā li sum cu la// rkyang pa 'phul dang mgo can dang*// dbyangs lnga ya ra la ba'i 'dogs// rjes 'jug dpe sogs rim pas bstan// ༈ kun mkhyen shākya karma pa// ka ra ka tan ka shi ka /nags klung chu klung dba' klong klu// ka dag klong yangs klong du gyur// ka ku bha ya ka dam+pa// ka sha ku sha ka ma la// kun+da ku mud keng+shu ka /ka ra bī ra ke ta ka /shing kun a krong dar ya kan// ka ped ku ba kim pa'i 'bras// kaṇ+ḍa ka ri g.ya' kyi ma// na rī ke la ka ko la// ke la sha dang ka liṅka// ko shām+bhi dang ko sa la// ka ma ta dang ko'u shi ka

/kā t+yā ya na kauṇ+ḍi n+ya// ke'u tshang du ko krad dang*// yungs kar ka ru thod le kor// ku shu gur kum ka ca kun// bsags kyang 'thab krol phung krol rgyu// kye ma kyi hud kye ho kwa /kye kye kyong kyong kong kong du// krog krog krab krab mgo kyog kyog /krong krong kog gis ker langs nas// ku res do ker ko sko 'degs// ku co kyal ka klan ka'i rgyu// 'on kyang lan kan nyen kor du// ka lan ta ka co ka dang*// ka la piṅka'i kyur kyur skad// ke'u kun dong kag ki kang*// stod kor klad kor klad don dang*// ke sha zhabs kyu lcags kyus btab// kar kar zug langs bad kan chu'i// ku ya kan 'og rtsa kyal kyal// rus krang krang nge skyil krung bcas// 'byams klas mtha' klas klog kyang klag /ston ka dpyid ka gnyis ka'i dus// glang chen thal kar ber kas brdungs// ka lā pa yis kla klo bcom// ka ba ka tsa lin+das klubs// kar+ṣa pa ṇa ke ke ru// kang ka 'di ko klag cor che// keng rus ka li'i klad pa za// kun nas kun tu pags kab kob// ku hu'i mgrin sogs ka rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dkar chag ma dkrugs dkor mdzod dkrogs// dkyil 'khor dkyil du dkrong bskyed dka'// dka' thub dka' spyad dkon cog dkon// mdog dkar dkyel che spyan dkyus ring*// dkyus ma'i dkor zas dri ma dku// dkos thag kun dkris gos kyis dkris// dku skabs dku zlum dku ma rnyongs// sprin dkrigs zho dkrogs rol mo dkrol// dkar yol chag dkrum dkyu sar dkyus// dka' 'grel dkrigs phrag dkan gzar po// phan tshun dkrugs sogs das 'phul ka'o// ༈ //bkra shis bkrag mdangs tshon bkra bkram// bka' bsgos khral khal srad bu bkal// pho nya ston mo 'od sprul bkye// dgongs pa khral bkral dgongs bcings bkrol// dri ma bkru bkrus bkren cing bkres// bkar nas bkyigs te srog bkums bkrongs// bkad sar snod bkang thugs dam bkang*// bsnyen bkur bkur stis gong du bkur// bkod legs bder bkod zur bkol dang*// shing bkug bkas shing g.yog tu bkol// gnang bkag sman bku bkus te bor// gos bkab gzhu bkang rtsa ba bkog

/bka' drin bka' btags bka' blo bde// bka' bkyon brgyad bkag 'khon du bkon// lam bkag spa bkong rgyal pos bkrabs// lus bkan lag bkan bkros nas bkri// mdo bklags mgo bkad thags kyi bkad// bkyal ba'i ngag sogs bas 'phul ka'o// ༈ //rkang lag rka zhing rkang rkan rkub// chom rkun rkyan dang phye rkyal rku// rkong pa chig rkyang sa rko rkos// gan rkyal rked rkyong rkon pa 'dzugs// rka mgo'i rkyal rtsed ri dwags rkyang*// rgyu rkyen la sogs rar btags ka'o// ༈ //lkog gyur lkog ma lkog shal dang*// ngag lkugs la sogs lar btags ka'o// ༈ //ska cog skal ldan skar ma skag /sku skem snum skud skud pa skyol// skyo ma'i skyag pa skyung kas skyud// ska rags skyer skya skyu ru ra// skyes bu skyems kyi skom skyur skol// gos skon skyen yang skyur bas skyo// skem byed skul byed skor ba byed// skyu rum skyu gang skyugs pas skyengs// skran dang skyigs bu skya sbab skrangs// ri skyegs chu skyar skya ga'i skad// skun bu skam pa skya ba skyogs// dge skos bro skrab ḍa ru skrog /skud po skyo sngogs snyan skyos skrag /rgya skyegs skyed tshal skyer ba'i skas// ske dang og skor chu skyegs skyes// skyi g.ya'i skyon skyob skyabs 'gro skyor// 'tsho skyong re skong skyin gor skogs// srab skyogs skyes bzang rgyal gyi skugs// bya skyibs skar khung skor tsher skyid// skyel ma skyes chen skyos ma skrod// chu skyom zho skrog rtsis kyi skyeg /ji skad 'di skad kha skong skabs// sa skyong skyang nul skam re skan// ska cig skra skyes shing skrus pa// sbas skungs mtha' skor skobs su chud// rang skal skye mched thugs dam skong*// bya skon skyi dkar skye tshe'i 'bru// skyo ma snga btsan skyil krung skyod// skya rengs zhal skyin sar btags ka'o//

༈ //'dod la brkam pas brku bya brkus// sra brkyang lag brkyang brko bya brkos// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o// ༈ //byug pa bsku bskus lag bskum bskums// 'phrin 'gan dbang bskur chos la bskul// nor bskyi bskyis dang bskyin pa bskyal// gos bskon rtar bskyon bskyar nas bskrad// gcom bskyungs zas bskru bskyed cing bskrun// bskal mes mtsho bskams chu bskyil bskyams// bskal don bskungs shing 'jigs bskyabs bskyangs// 'pho bskyas rgyang bskyur bya ba bskyungs// mi bskyod bskor ba rgyal sar bskos// ro bska kha bskang thugs dam bskangs// sems bskyed rgya bskyed brjed pa'i bskyud/ bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/// / ༈ go khrab khri khrag khrag khrig khur// khong khro khon 'dzin khro bo khros// khro dang khrol tshags khrud khus khrus// khong khrag khrag khrug khrung khrung khyu// tshul khrims khris 'jags khrims kyi khral// khru gang khrun ring khram kha khra// khrom khrod khri steng khang khyim khyams// bya khra khyis khyer khyor ba'i khre// kho ra khor yug khron chu khrems// sil khrol khams gsum khram pas khrel// dur khrod sna khrid khrums stod smad// khro gnyer khwa ta kha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //mkhan pos sa mkhar mkhrang mkhregs mkhyen// mkhyud spyad dpe mkhyud zhu mkhan mkho// ma mkhal mkhal ma mkhur 'dzum mkhas// mkhan khrod mkhos phab snga mkho bzhin// mkha' mnyam mkhris nad med par mkhyen// chu mkhris mkhrig ma mas 'phul kha'o// ༈ //blo 'khums zhe 'khon 'khang zhing 'khu// 'khyags nas mtha' 'khob 'khyar zhing 'khyams// rgas 'khogs 'khos chung rkang 'khum 'khyog /'khyor 'khyom 'khar bar 'khril 'khris 'khyud// 'khrig tshig ngag 'khyal 'thab 'khrug 'khrul// 'khri ba 'khru 'khrud 'khri shing 'khrungs// gdugs 'khyir bro 'khrab 'khar rnga 'khrol// sems 'khol sems 'khrugs 'khyug por 'khyus// khur 'khur khral 'khri 'od 'khyims 'khyil// 'khor bar 'khren pa 'khras shing 'khar// ma 'khyig ma 'khyer snum 'khur 'khur// ma 'khyur bred 'khrims 'khams shing 'khun// 'khor lo 'khod kyang 'khor bcas 'khobs// g.yog tu 'khul 'khol srad bu 'khal// 'khra sar ma 'khyol 'khrid par 'khums// rus kyi 'khon sogs 'as 'phul kha'o/// /

༈ grub mtha' grub thob grangs med grol// ral gri gro gas gril zhes grag /grul bum grang nad grum bus grongs// mon gru nam gru gre gro bzhin// chos grwa'i gral du rim gro'i grabs// yul gru gru bzhi gru kha'i grong*// gra ma spu gri gru 'dzin ri// mon lug gla sgang gro'i sbang glum// gra phub gro ma mon sran gre'u// grod pa gron can grung zhing grims// gram pa'i chu grog gre ba'i grogs// grib mar gros gleng re gron med// gla rtsi gla rngan glud ltar glen// 'dzam gling glegs bam gling bu'i glu// pho glang glang shu glog pa'i nad// glo ba'i glo dgog leb mor glebs// glang chen glos phab glod nas glal// glo 'bur glo bur glo rdeg glog /glags rnyed lan glan lhan pa glan// sgo glegs chos gos glegs bu'i grwa// gla gor zho sha mdun ma gleng*// bya glag grog ma grib grib gnon// grog por gru mo chag grum grubs// dngos grub gru char 'bebs par grags// sha ba'i gwa dor ga rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dge bsnyen dge tshul dga' dgyes dgod// dgung sngon dgu tshigs dge zhing dgu// nyin dgung dge bshes yod dgu dgug /dge sbyong dge slong dge 'dun dgus// dgra bcom dgongs dgrol yi ger dgod// dgag sgrub snod dgang dgon par dgar// dgo bas pha ba dgo dgo dgas// khal dgal lhan pa dgab dang dgog /skye dgus dge legs dge sgrub dgos// dgongs mo zong dgram me tog dgram// dgun dung can du dgun ka sdod// dgung lo la sogs das 'phul ga'o// ༈ //bka' bgro bgro gleng bgyi bgyid bgyis// go bgos bgegs kyis bgrod lam bgags// dus bgyangs tshod bgam bgo ba bgos// bgres pos mig bgrad bgrang phreng bgrangs// bgrus pa'i 'bras bgos gad mo bgad// gom pa bgoms shing rnyog ma bgrungs// bgo skal la sogs bas 'phul ga'o//

༈ //mgo mgur mgul mgrin mgar mgon mgu// mgal dum mgal me gtor mgron mgyogs// ya mgal ma mgal mas 'phul ga'o// ༈ //'gro 'greng 'grim 'grul 'gying 'gros 'gran// 'grangs 'gengs 'gag 'gog 'gags 'gas 'grib// 'gyangs 'gor 'gyes 'grogs dgongs 'grel 'grol// 'gyel 'gril 'grongs 'gums 'gal 'gras 'gyod// 'gol sar 'gram 'gul nor 'gye 'gyed// 'gan 'khur 'gong po'i 'go nad 'gos// 'phel 'grib 'gyur 'gyus mi 'gong dang*// lam 'gron 'ga' 'gugs rtsig 'gram 'god// brtson 'grus 'go ma'i chu 'grems 'grub// mgo 'gems rigs 'gre tshos kyi 'grib// 'thab mo 'gyed sogs 'as 'phul ga'o// ༈ //rgod po rgya mtshor rgal phyir rgyu// gtam rgyud phreng rgyud rgyud mang rgyan// bya rgod rgan po rga shi'i rgud// phas rgol rgyang 'phen mgo la rgyob// rgod ma'i rgyab rgyas rgyang ring rgyug /rgya bo dmu rgod phyag rgyar rgyo// rgya tsha rgyam tsha rgyags phye'i rgyugs// rgyu mtshan lo rgyus bying rgod rgyu// rgyal ba'i rgyud rgyal rgyu skar rgyal// shes rgyud rgyas btab nga rgyal rgyags// rgya gram rgyan po rgyan dang rgyal// rgun 'brum rgya shug nya rgyar rgyu// rgyus pa rgyu ma lu gu rgyud// gru rgyongs rgyangs shing smig rgyu'i rgyun// rgya yul rgya che lto rgyab skyid// rgyal mtshan rgyal sogs rar btags ga'o// ༈ //la lga lgang ba gcig pur nges// sgom chen blo sgam sgrin por sgrun// lcags sgrog sgor mor sgrim zhing sgril// sgying skyur sgyid lug sgyed bu sgyel// sgyu rtsal g.yo sgyu sgyu ma sgrung*// sgam sgrom sgro ba sgye sgye'u// sgyug mos sgo nga sgog zos sgregs// sdig sgrib chu sgrol chos sgra sgrogs// bya sgro bshad sgros mchu sgros sgrigs// sgal tshigs sgul sgyod sga sge'u gsher// sgren mor sgo drung sgeg mo sgug

/sgyid par gos sgab sgro gus sgrog /dbang sgyur 'khor lo sgyur sgyur byed// lag sgreng zas sgong bu ram sgor// sgar du rta sgas sgron me sgrib// srid sgrub klu sgrub sgrol ma sgrub// mna' sgog sgyogs rdos sgu do gcog /da sgos sgos su rtsig pa sgron// sgu stegs sgang gshongs tsha sgo can// sgrob dang sgrom sogs sar btags ga'o// ༈ //brgal brtag brgal lan brgyad cu brgyad// phreng ba brgya phrag brgyus pas brgyan// chu brgal 'o brgyal dran med brgyal// brgyud pa lam brgyags spyo ba'i brgyad// le brgan gad brgyangs smra ba'i brgya// brgyugs shing brgyungs par brgyud mar brgyab// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ga'o// ༈ //bu ram bsgar zhing bsgrangs nas bsgongs// chos bsgyur mdog bsgyur bka' bsgo bsgos// chu bsgral chos bsgrags ting 'dzin bsgoms// mgo bsgres rigs bsgres rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// mna' bsgags lam bsgugs seng ge bsgyings// bag chags bsgo bsgos phyogs gcig bsgrigs// 'od bsgribs blo bsgrims srad bu bsgrims// bsgrub pa bsgrub bya bsgrun mi nus// bsgrin mi phod dang bya ba'i bsgang*// bsgyel zhing sgra bsgrags rtsis kyi bsgyur// gzhan gyis mi bsgul nor gyis bsgang*// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/// / ༈ snyan dngags zil dngar tshar du dngar// gser dngul dngom che dngos dngos med// dngos grub dngos gzhi dngos bshams dngos// dngangs skrag dngan 'then 'bab chu'i dngo*// gri yi dngo sogs das 'phul nga'o// ༈ //mnga' ris mnga' zhabs mnga' thang mnga'// mnga' mdzad mnga' bdag mngag gzhug mngags// mngon sum mngon gyur mngon mtshan mngal// mngon spyod mnga' brnyes mngan mi bgrang*// chos mngon mngon shes mngar ba'i ro// thugs la mnga' sogs mas 'phul nga'o// ༈ //rngon pa'i rnga yab rnga rnge'u chung*// rngam pa'i bkres rngab rnga mo rnge'u// rngom brjid rngam 'jigs rngo bag can// dbugs rngub zug rngus rngod mkhan rngul// rngos khyer dre'u rngog gla rngan dang*// rnga rngog mthug rngam rngo mi thogs// rngan chan rtswa rnga rngu ma dang*// rus kyi rngog sogs rar btags nga'o//

༈ //zhal snga spyan snga snga sor sngon// gsang sngags sngags pa mdog sngon sngo// snga dro sngas la sngur pa che// snga dus skyo sngogs mon sran snge'u// snga phyi sngun du sngo bar byed// mtshang nas sngog sogs sar btags nga'o// ༈ //brngan yang brngams nas btsas ma brngas// bud med brngod dang rngon pas brngon// chang brngubs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o// ༈ //sdug bsngal bstod bsngags bsngo bas bsngos// rnam par bsngos dang bsngog pa sogs// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o/// / ༈ ci slad ci phyir ldan pa'i can// bdag cag spyi cer sum cu dang*// drug cu bdun cu brgyad cu rnams// lhan cig thabs cig skad cig tsam// khyed cag sems can yod do cog /can cer cab cob chang co re// ha cang cas cus bab col mang*// ci ste cung zad phyin ci log /cang shes cig shos ci nas kyang*// co to'i thor cog cod pan dang*// rgya cang be con lta ci smos// ca co'i cal col mu cor dang*// co 'dri cig car cam gyis 'jog /cog bur car re mig ce re// lan cig cis kyang cir mi rtog /kha cig cang mi shes kyang cong*// cang dang cang te'u ci yang brdung*// cu gang cung zhi cur nis za// ce spyang brag cas ci zhig bya// cog tser tho cos cung seng za// ci ga la sogs ca rkyang ngo*// ༈ //gros gcom gcong nad gcad bya gcod// khon gcugs yid gcugs gcen dang gcung*// gcud bor lag gcus gcur zhing gcun// rnam gcod yongs gcod zhal lce gcod// gcong rong gcong skad gcin gci ba// gcod bzhin gces med gcig gis gcig /gcam bu kha gcang gcugs med gces// tshar gcod gcu gal yid la gcags// sgra gcan gcan gzan la gcan pa// gcig tu gcal bkram grangs kyi gcig /ro gcig rdzas gcig gcer bu gcog /gci'u'i sman sogs gas 'phul ca'o// ༈ //bcom ldan dgra bcom bcas pas bcags// dam bca' khrims bca' bcing bas bcings// shing bcad rlan bcir bca' yos bcem// tshigs bcad bca' gzhi bstan bcos bcang*// logs bcar bca' sga bza' bca'i bcud// mig bcar phyir bcil chu bcur bcug

/nor bcal lag bcangs chags bcag bcol// bcar ba'i rtar bcibs zhal lce bcad// tshar bcad blos bcal bcas rang bcabs// rdo bcag shing bcer gros bcam bcum// bcu dang bzhi bcu lnga bcu dang*// dgu bcu bco lnga bco brgyad bcos// bcos bu'i ras sogs bas 'phul ca'o// ༈ //mnyen lcug lcug phran lcang ma'i lcag /mgo lcogs ches lci blo yis lcogs// gnam lcags lce 'bab me lcer lceb// lcang lo can gyi lcags ri'i lcog /nya lcibs sbal lcong lcung ka'i lce// re'u lcag lca ba lcam pa lcum// lag lcibs tsha lcibs sgo lcibs dang*// spyan lcibs lcam dral skra'i lcang lo// lci ba lcag pod srus lcag lcig /tshig 'bru lcibs sogs lar btags ca'o/// /

༈ chem chem chal chil chos chu'i char// chags bral chog shes cho ga'i ched// go cha mtshon cha'i cha lugs chos// byang chub bar chad cham la phob// rin chen chun po chabs cig chur// chu zheng cha mnyam chem me ba// chibs pa cha de chibs la chogs// srog chags chag chag chal mar brdal// cho los che ge'i cha rkyen chad// chad pas chod la chung ma chol// chang chems che chung thugs su chud// mthar chags chags chogs chir gyis chir// chab 'og chom rkun ches cher chun// choms shig chings shig chab sgo chog /tshar chod thag chod chab 'og chug /cha cho ma chod cha med chas// zan chang 'bras chan chab nas chus// cha lang mal cha che zhe'i chas// cho rigs chud zos cham pa'i nad// chab shog kha chems chig rkyang chong*// bag chags cho 'phrul cho nge 'don// cha ga pa sogs cha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //mchog tu skyabs mchi dkon mchog mchod// mchis mal mchil lham mchig mchig gu// sku mched mchan gyi mchis brang mchor// mchi ma mchil ma mcher pa mchin// zhal mchur kha mchu'i bka' mchid mchis// skye mched mching bu rgya mtsho'i mching*// rtswa mchog me mched mchil pa'i mchongs// gzhu mchog sgyu ma'i mchan bu mchan// mchil pa mchims sogs mas 'phul cha'o// ༈ //chos 'chad khrims 'cha' 'chag sar 'chag /tshul 'chos gar 'chams srog 'chad 'chi// 'chums pa'i gnas 'cha' 'chel sar 'chun// 'chal ba'i 'char sgo mi 'chags 'chab// nyi 'char chu 'chor las 'chol 'chun// gros 'choms khas 'che 'ching zhags 'chang*// 'chol dang 'chus sogs 'as 'phul cha'o/// / ༈ ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs// ji ltar ji srid ji skad smra// jo jo'i jo mo jo bo'i ja// je zhig jag pa ju bo 'phangs// ja hong ja ril je mthor song*// je dang je sogs ja rkyang ngo*// ༈ //mjal 'phrad mjing pa mjug ma mje// mi mjed zhing sogs mas 'phul ja'o// ༈ //'jag ma 'ji ba 'jim pa 'jags// 'jig rten 'jig pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms// 'jus nas sha 'jog 'jar nas 'jabs// 'ja' zhing 'jungs pa'i skyon 'jil 'jem// 'ju ba khrag 'jib zas 'ju 'jang*// 'jud mthun 'jol 'jol 'jo sgeg 'jog

/'jor bu dbyibs 'jong 'jur zhing 'jun// lus 'jam 'jog po mtsho 'jing 'jug /'jam dbyangs snyan 'jebs mnyam par 'jog /blos 'jal tshad mjal 'dod pa 'jo// khrims 'jags 'ja' sa 'ja' mo dang*// 'ja' brdeg 'ja' tshon srad bu'i 'jur// srod 'jing sha 'jums rtsa 'jing gnyen// thob kyis 'jal sogs 'as 'phul ja'o// ༈ //rje btsun rjes 'jug rdo rje'i rjes// rje dpon lha rje rjed pa'i 'os// sa rjen sha rjen rje ngar rjud// rjod byed snying rje lag rjes dang*// thugs rjes rjes bskyangs rje'u'i rigs// til gyi rjang sogs rar btags ja'o// ༈ //brjed ngas brjed byed gzi brjid brjid// brje brjes ma brjed brjod bya brjod// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o// ༈ //yul ljongs ljang bu'i ljan ljin khrod// ljon shing ljid lci sman ljongs ljang*// ro 'dzin ljags sogs lar btags ja'o/// / ༈ nyams rtogs nying khu nyag gcig nyab// nya ma nyag mo nyes 'gyur nyung*// spu nyag nyal nyil nya lto ba// nyam nyes nyon mongs nyam ngar nye// nying sha'i nyod pa nyes 'byung nyen// nyam chung nyam thag nyin mtshan nyal// nyams dga'i nying dgos nye bar nyon// spos nyug lag nyas nyan thos nyams// pho nya nyi ma'i nyen kor du// nya sha nya ga nyi shu nyos// nying tor chu nyog nye reg nyang*// nye gnas nyug rum nyan rna nyid// nyag phran nya rgyas nya rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dpung gnyen bshes gnyen gnyis kyi gnyen// gnya' shing gnyer pa khro gnyer dang*// bka' gnyan gnyan nad dud 'gro gnyan// gnya' bo don gnyer gnyan gnyags gnyos// gnyid kyi gnyen por gnya' ltag gnyul// gnyi gzer gnyig tu lus gnyong chung*// gnya' rengs gnye ma nyag por gnyeg /gnyug ma'i don sogs gas 'phul nya'o// ༈ //mnyan pa thugs mnyes rna bas mnyan// mnyed mnyes shing mnyen mnyan yod gnas// mnyam bzhag mnyam med mtshungs pa'i mnyam// ra mnye mnyes gshin mas 'phul nya'o//

༈ //'dam rnyog rnyed bkur gsar rnying rnyed// so rnyil rnyang ma rnyong dang rnyi// lcang rnyid ma rnyob an+da rnyil// rkang pa rnyong sogs rar btags nya'o// ༈ //go snyod snying po snyid mo'i snying*// spu snyol chang snyol snye phung snyil// tha snyad ji snyed de snyed snyam// snyems dang snyun med snyan shal snyi// snyom 'jug btang snyoms snyom las dang*// bsod snyoms snyugs srings snyeg sar snyogs// snying rje'i snyim pa snyobs la snyes// snyon mongs snyad 'dogs rgyal mtshan snyol// gtam snyan snyigs dus skud pa snyod// snyang snyogs sems snyoms sar btags nya'o// ༈ //gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan gzhan la brnyas// mnga' brnyes phyag brnyan brnyan po'i brnyas// gos brnyings kha brnyogs snang brnyan brnyang*// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o// ༈ //dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen rdzogs bsnyen// bsnyon can bsnyon dor bsnyon tol dang*// bsnyen bsgrub bsnyen bkur phye mar bsnyil// gtam bsnyad bsnyams nas lag pa bsnyul// phyir bsnyil mal bsnyal lhung bzed bsnyigs// lag bsnyabs bsnyung gzhis bsnyun pas bsnyengs// bsnyel med nas bsnyor yo byad bsnyungs// bsnyen sring zas bsnyod skyu gang bsnyug /bsnyems pa'i rjes bsnyegs khro gnyer bsnyer// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/// / ༈ te por te ser tal mar song*// dzā ti tang kun tig ta til// tug tug tong tong tog tog sgra// tel pa tog rtse dbyug to dang*// gtsug tor thor tor spyi tor tog /mu tig me tog tam+bu la// lo tog rtsi tog za ma tog /ting 'dzin dkon mchog ta la la// ting lo tal tsam tig tig med// yon tan zhabs tog nan tan dang*// nan tur gal te go'u ta ma// kha ton zhal ta nan tar bzang*// ta zig ta ming ta'i si tu// ti shri ta dben ta hung dang*// tā ra ṇa dang te'u shang khri// tam bu ra dang ting ting shags// nyo ti ta la tres sam dang*// shang shang te'u te te brdung*// 'on tang ling tog ta rkyang ngo*//

༈ //gtan gyi bsam gtan gtan tshigs gtam// gtun bu lag gtad gtun shing gtubs// brdung gtag gtong dang gtang rag gtang*// gter mdzod yongs gtams gtor zan gtor// nor gyi gta' ma gteng pa gta'// gtan pa med pa'i sbyin gtong gtang*// gtum po'i zhabs gtugs zad pa'i gtugs// lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod// 'bem la gtod dang dmigs pa gtod// gti mug gtol med mtshang nas gtol// khrag gtar chu gtigs se gol gtogs// bcol ba'i gtams dang grangs kyi gtams// sgo gtan gting zab mun pa gtibs// gtur bu spos gtul ri bo'i gtos// mgo gtums mtha' gtugs khongs su gtogs// gtan la 'bebs sogs gas 'phul ta'o// ༈ //sgro btags ming btags kha btags btags// spyir btang blos btang sngags btu btus// srol btod gdan bting sa bon btab// btang bzung klus bteg gsol btab btud// btags so rgyas btab bza' btung btub// spu btogs rtsa bton btags shing btul// mgrin pa bteg sogs bas 'phul ta'o// ༈ //mi rtag rtab rtab dbang rtul rtags// mi rtog yid rton rtog ldan rtogs// rtag tu rta la rte'u skyes rting*// rtol gog rting pa rtod pas bcings// ru rtas nyams rtas gnas su rtol// mong rtul rtul phod rten rten 'brel// mchod rten rta babs bya ma rta// rta thul rta dbyangs rtog ge pa// mi gtsang rtug sogs rar btags ta'o// ༈ //ltos 'gro'i ltag pa de lta bu// lto 'phye'i lte bar ltad mo lta// lto ba lto yis ltir gyis bkang*// bur ltang 'grang ltogs da lta ltos// ltar snang ltag chod lta log gi /ltung bas ltas ngan lta ci smos// lteng rgyas lteng ka ltem gyis gang*// re ltos lta zhog mda' yi ltong*// ltar ltar ltem rkyang lar btags ta'o// ༈ //ston pa'i bzhugs stangs bkur sti stobs// stes dbang mu stegs byad stems kyis// mi sto lta stangs me stag stegs// sta gon stong grogs sha stag byed// gzhogs stegs stangs stabs sta zur ston// shing stag stug khrod stobs can stag

/dgra sta sta re ste'u stor// star zhun star ga'i ston mo ster// stod la stan dang stu ma ston// ston dpyid gang stong ya stags stong*// stim byed so stor stor khung dang*// stang zil stabs gcig star brgyus steng*// stong pa stong nyid sar btags ta'o// ༈ //brtag dpyad gnas brtan kun brtags brtags// yid brtan brtad pa brtul zhugs brtan// sbubs brtol brtun pa spyi brtol brtabs// yongs 'du pa brtol brtag pa brtul// brten pa la brten phur bus brtod// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o// ༈ //bltos sa bltos chos bltar rung bltas// blta bya sku bltams gos bltab sogs// bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o// ༈ //bsti stang bstud pa'i bsti gnas bstar// thub bstan dang bstun bstod 'os bsten// bstang bas ma bzung bstan bcos bstan// thag bstungs sna bstad 'gro chas bstad// bsting tshig bstims pas mi bstongs kyang*// bstir med mngon bstod byin len bstabs// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/// / ༈ thun mong thu bo tha gru che// thu mi thor cog thor tshugs dang*// tha ma tha na thrig thrig sgra// thur dang tha mal tha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //mtho ris mtha' dag mtha' klas mthong*// mthar thug nus mthu mthun mi mthun// lag mthil mthe bong mthe'u chung*// mthon ga mthon mthing mthang gos mthug /mthar gyis rta mthur mtho gang mthud// mtho 'tshams mthol bshags mtho yor mtho// mthon po'i rgya mthongs mtha' 'khob mtha'// mthing ril mthing kha mas 'phul tha'o// ༈ //'thab mor 'thon yang grogs su 'thams// sprin 'thibs chu 'thor 'thor 'thung dang*// blo 'thums mgo 'thoms du ba 'thul// sra 'thas 'thems nan nan tan 'than// chu 'thungs sha nas 'then zhing 'thog /smod tshig 'thing slad 'then pa 'thad// zas la 'thu 'thus phye mar 'thag /zha 'theng mal gos 'theb kyis 'thum// dum bur 'thub sogs 'as 'phul tha'o/// /

༈ gzhan dring mi 'jog bka' drin dran// dril bu dri mchog dra dra phyed// snga dro phyi dro'i dri dris lan// drang don g.yung drung drang srong drug /khrims dral lcam dral zas drangs drongs// drang po'i shing drung drel dre'u rdog /mon dre smin drug ma dros mtsho// dreg nad dreg pa dri ma dang*// kha drag drag shul sa la drud// drod dang dro ba zan dron dril// dred lpags dras drubs dres mas drags// dred po dru bu'i dra bar drangs// dril bsgrags dra ma'i gnas su drongs// dregs pa drung phyung kha yi drog /nad drag dwa phrug dwa ba'i 'bru// thal ba'i drags sogs da rkyang ngo*// ༈ //gdugs med gdong pa gdugs kyis gdungs// gdon ltar gdug pa'i gdol pa gdul// gdams ngag gsal gdab gding ba gdan// gdu bu gdang dang gdung mar gdags// gdung rus skad gdangs skas kyi gdang*// gdung brgyud gdung 'dzin gsol gdab gdon// gnyer gdams bcol gdams rnyed la gdu// ming gdags snyun gdangs sa bon gdab// kha gdangs mtshon gdengs gdon mi za// da gdod sos gdal gdeng thob gda'// gdos pa thud gdar srang la gdeg /gdags pa'i bstan bcos gdam nga byed// gdengs can gdul bya dam la gdags// khyab gdal gdod nas gdags gzhi bral// gdangs can kun ra gas 'phul da'o// ༈ //bdag bden bdud bdun mdun du bdar// bde bdo zas bda' bdug spos bdug /bda' ded bdag pos bda' zhing bdas// bde gshegs bde legs bden pa bdar// gzhu bdungs bdog pa'i skyel bdar bdog /bden gnyis bdud rtsi phye mar bdar// phyag bdar phyi bdar bas 'phul da'o// ༈ //mda' mdung mde'u lam mdo'i mdos// mdun mdongs mdog mdangs mdor bsdus mdo// mdangs sang mdong gsol ra mda' dang*// mdud pa la sogs mas 'phul da'o// ༈ //mya ngan 'da' 'das 'dun pas 'dud/ 'dam khrod 'dur 'dur 'dong zhing 'dug /'dom dus rjes 'ded gsol 'debs 'don// lha 'dre shing 'drud khung bu 'dru// 'du byed 'dus byas 'dres ma 'dra// 'drul ba'i gtam 'dri yi ge 'dri// 'drid cing khrims 'dral srog 'dor 'dar// 'degs pa 'di 'dod 'dul bas 'dul// 'dam bu'i 'dab mar 'dab chags 'du// ri 'dabs 'dol sar 'dag gu 'dag

/blo 'drog zhabs 'dred 'drad cing 'drud// 'dren pas chos 'doms dge 'dun 'dus// 'do med 'doms su 'dom gang 'dogs// 'dod chags 'du shes 'du 'dzir 'dris// 'dreg mkhan 'deng phyir 'do rta 'dam// 'das po'i 'dad kyis 'khor 'dab 'dums// ming 'dogs chu 'dal skyo ma 'dal// 'dag chal go 'dun de ma 'drog /dri ma 'dag sogs 'as 'phul da'o// ༈ //grong rdal thog rdib rdo rje'i rdul// rdo rde'u rdog po rdeg kyang rdugs// rdung 'tshog pheg rdob cha lang rdob// glo rdeg rdab 'chal lus rdos che// lag rdum glo rdol dbu ba rdos// gri rdor rdol chos rar btags da'o// ༈ //mkha' lding 'brug ldir ldab ldib skad// lda ldi lde mig yod pa'i ldan// mgo ldog lto ldir ldur ldur ldugs// seng ldeng ldem ldem lder bzo'i ldebs// ldor ros ngad ldang lde gu byug /'jug ldog ldob skyen phyir mi ldog /skom ldud me lde ming gi lde// ldum ra'i ldum bu ldab ldob dang*// bcom ldan ldem dgongs dris lan ldon// bskyar ldab nyis ldab lhag ma ldas// ldan pa'i so ldeg mig kyang ldongs// ne'u ldang ldom bu stan las ldang*// ldang tshad la sogs lar btags da'o// ༈ //zhe sdang sdang mig sdigs mdzub sdig /sdar ma bde sdug dge sdig sdom// sdings kyi sdong po sdong bu'i sde// srog dang sdo zhing sde tshan sdeb// srog chags sdom sdig sder mo rno// sdom pa bsrung sdom sdod gnas sdod// sdeb sbyor mdzes sdug nor sogs sdud// sdum par mchod sdong sdom bus bskor// sder ma'i thug sdor lag pas sdom// bka' sdod sde snod sar btags da'o// ༈ //gri brdar brdeg 'chos brdung bya brdungs// kha brdar bla brdol chal brdab brdabs// rnga brdung bro brdung go byed brda// chal mar brdal nas brdul zhing brdeg /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o//

༈ //bldabs nas bldag pa bldeg cing bldad// bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o// ༈ //bsdu bya bsdu bsdus bsdur nas bsdad// nyes bsdams bsdoms nas srog dang bsdos// 'og bsdogs nyer bsdogs gzhan la bsdigs// grogs dang bsdongs bsdebs sna thag bsdogs// 'gal bsdum bas 'phul sar btags da'o/// / ༈ phan gnod gnas skabs gnang bkag gnad// gnod sbyin gnag phyugs gnam ltar gnag /gnas brtan nyer gnas gnas khang gnas// gnod byed zil gnon gna' mi gnubs// zhi gnas gnas 'gyur gnas lugs rtogs// gnangs gzhes gnam ru rkang pas gnon// zhe gnong gnad gcod gnas ngan len// gnod gnas la sogs gas 'phul na'o// ༈ //mnal gzims mna' ma 'og tu mnan// mnab rtsal dri mnam mnar med mnar// mnar sems zas mnog mnog chung ba// mnol rigs mna' bskyal na bza' mnabs// mno bsam mnos sogs mas 'phul na'o// ༈ //rnam shes rnon po'i rnal 'byor rnams// rnam rtog rnam grangs rnam pa mang*// rna gshog rtse rno rnal ma'i don// khug rna rnag khrag zhing rnang ma// tshig phrad rnam par rar btags na'o// ༈ //snar ma snron snrubs snag tsha snur// snang ba sna tshogs sna yi snabs// snam bu'i snam sbyar snal ma'i sne// bar snang snang gsal snum dri snom// lam snar sna bo'i snag dbon snang*// ltar snang sna mang snrel zhi snod// yug snam snam phran sna ma sne'u// snad yar ser sna'i snon mar snoms// rgyab kyi snam logs sar btags na'o// ༈ //brnab sems lto la brnan yang brnangs// brnag dka'i brnag pas mdun du brnur// sbas pa'i brnogs dang nges bzung brnan// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o// ༈ //gnad bsnun mtshon bsnun nu ma bsnun// srol bsnubs gong 'og bsnor zhing bsnol// mtshon bsnams dus bsnur zhib mor bsnur// mjug bsnar dri bsnams nem nem bsnems// mang du bsnan nas 'dres par bsnos// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o/// /

༈ pang par par pu pi wang 'dzin// gcig pur pir gyis pa tra bris// pu shu'i pu shud pur gyis pur// puṇ+ḍa rī ka pi pi ling*// pa shi pad+ma pa la sha /pus btsugs pog por ga pur 'thul// par ma'i po ti paṇ+ḍi ta// ze prog prog zhu 'og pag dang*// pur khang par tang po ṭa la// pu sa la dang pu shel tse// pa sangs pra phab pri yang ku// pags pa lag pod po zos kyang*// par gyis 'phar sogs pa rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dpag tshad rjes dpag dpag bya dpog /rgyal po'i dpya khral dpyang thag dpyangs// dpag med dmag dpung dpung bu chung*// dper na dpe byad dpe bya dpen// rnam dpyod rtog dpyod brtag dpyad dang*// rje dpon slob dpon sems dpa' che// dpyid dus dpral ba dpyi mgo dpyongs// shing nga dpung bcad dpung rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dpangs mtho dpag bsam shing*// dpa' bo dpa' ba'i dpang pos dpod// gso dpyad dpyis phyin dpyas mi 'dogs// dpal ldan dpang lo das 'phul pa'o// ༈ //pha spad spun zla spang bya spangs// sprang po'i spar mo'i spa dbyug sprad// spos sprin spro spros longs spyod spyod// spang spos spar spor spen spyil spro// spen tog spug gis spud pas spa// gnas spar bya spur gzhan du spags// mgo spu sprug sprugs thags kyi spun// spe'u'i gces spras spyad dngos spel// spa ma spru ma spra ba spungs// spra chal spod dang zho spris spags// 'thab mo sprad sprod spyos nas spyugs// spyi sgos spel mar 'phrin spring springs// mun sprul spong ba spongs spyod pa// tshur spyon dka' spyad chos spyod spor// spros bral sprul pa gza' spen pa// gos spo chur spyings spra tshil spyin// khe spogs spyang gi spra spre'u// spyang po'i spobs pas dge mi spyom// spyi blugs kha spub rgyan gyis spras// spyi bo rdul sprugs rdul gyi spabs// spyod pa spa bkong ri yi spo// mig gi spyan sogs sar btags pa'o//

༈ //stag lpags la sogs lar btags pa'o/// / ༈ phang par phun tshogs phun tshugs shing*// phrug gu dang phrad rdul phran phra// brgya phrag phyang phrul phyal phyang nge// phyug po'i phyir du phyogs bcur phyin// phyar dar phyi sa'i phye ma phye// phywa mkhan phongs pas phying rul phyar// phyi bdar gyis phyis phyags mas phyags// nam phyed phyen gtong phyi rdo phang*// dbang phyug dbugs phyung sgo phye nas// phyags lham phran tshegs phreng ba phrogs// phra men phrin las sa phyod che// phyugs kyi phru ma phye ma leb// phru ba'i phyir phyung phyag gis phyor// smin phrag phyag 'tshal nyin mtshan phyad// phra ma phrag dog phrag pa phral// phyin chad yid phyung sun ci phyin// phyi 'brang phyir phyogs phyin ci log /mi pham tshig phrad rnam dbye phyed// phru ma phyar g.yeng pha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //gzhan la 'phya 'phyas 'od 'phro 'phros// 'phyi ba 'phye bo dus 'phyi 'phyis// rnam 'phrul sgyu 'phrul mda' 'phen 'phangs// nam 'phang khri 'phang go 'phang 'phrog /mtsho 'phyur dung 'phyur lam 'phyug 'phyugs// snying 'phyo'i 'phyon mas phye 'phyar 'phangs// 'phongs kyi 'phag 'phag mgo thum 'phur// 'phong gis gzhan 'pham 'phal ka 'grig /'phyan zhing 'phyo lding dar 'phyar 'phral// 'phrin 'phrod 'chi 'phras sems la 'phreng*// 'phral ba skra 'phyings phyag dar 'phyag /'phyang dang 'phye ba 'as 'phul pha'o/// / ༈ bla ma'i bla na bla bre bres// byams pas byad byur byabs pas byer// bre yi bye mas brabs pas byang*// bran g.yog byes byon byug pa byin// byis pas bya ra'i bya ba byos// bram ze brag ri'i byang du byol// bya byi'u byi ba byi la'i byad// byol song brang 'gro'i brang byil byil// bla gab bla gos blus kyang bla// blun po 'dam bying blo blong blong*// bro nad thabs bral bro bor bros// byan mo'i byi bor rang byan chud// byag mkhan bro gar bye bas brel// sos blad chu blud zas brims brod// bya na'i yo byad byur bur blugs// da byid ro bro bra ba'i brun// dong brubs chu brug bru ba tsha// gos byed btso blag gos kyis byibs// bla tshe byang bur ba bla byugs// khas blangs bla thabs sa blas khyer// blo brid bla dwags yi ger bris// spu byi cha byad gzi byin bri// byi bzhin bra nyer bra phye byol// byug ris bya ba'i bye brag la// rgyal blon blo mig bde blag byed// blang dor blon 'debs bla bo la// rab byung skra bregs rna ba blags// lto gos brang breng bya dgar byin// sman bla byang chub bla na med// byin rlabs byu ru ba rkyang ngo*//

༈ //dbyen dang dbye bral chos dbyings dbyibs// dbyer med dbu ma dbung dang dbus// dbyu gu dbyig pa dbyug pa dbyugs// rdzing dbol chu dbo skar ma dbo// phyir dbyung sun dbyung mtshon gyis dbug /dbul pos dbugs dbyung nor mi dbrog /tshon dbyi dbyig mor dbyig dbyig dbur// dbon pos dbyangs dbul sma mi dbab// dbyig gnyen dbu la gdugs kyang dbub// dbang bskur byin dbab gtan la dbab// lung dbog khur dbog dben sar dbral// dbang phyug dbang ldan dbang thang dbyar// dbang po dbyig mang dpral dbyes che// dba' rlabs dbu ba skyon gyis dbags// dbre btsog kha dbri zhe sa'i dba'// dbal ni sha nyams rtse drod tog /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab das 'phul ba'o// ༈ //rab 'byams 'byams klas 'byung bzhi 'brug /'bral med dang 'brel 'bras bu 'bru// 'bring po 'dam 'bying 'brum nad 'byang*// 'brog gi 'bri 'brong rus kyi 'brom// 'byung 'gyur tshe 'byid 'dred pa'i 'byid// skra 'bal 'bel gtam sgo 'bye 'byed// 'bras chan lces 'byog chang 'byo 'byangs// 'brom ston 'byon dus 'bros shing 'brang*// 'brub khung kha 'byed 'byol zhing 'byer// mtshang 'bru'i tshig 'byin tshon 'byug 'byongs// kha 'bri chu 'brub sbyar ba'i 'byar// 'byung po'i 'byor pa 'as 'phul ba'o// ༈ //khyi rbad rbab sgril kha rbad che// nad kyi skya rbab skra rbad rbod// rbod ma skyel sogs rar btags ba'o// ༈ //lbu ba lba ba lar btags ba'o// ༈ //nor sbyin gnod sbyin sbyin bdag sbron// sbun pa sbangs dang sbang mas sbangs// sbug tu nor sba sbas sbos sbed// nyis sbrag sbra 'bubs sbrel nas sbyar// sbres nas sbur mar me sbar sbor// chus sbrus zas sbrus phyogs gcig sboms// sbrum ma lto sbos srog chags sbre// phyag sbal grog sbur sbal pa sbrul// grogs sbran sbungs sbed sbud pa'i sbubs// sbyig mor sbyig cing sbe ga sbyor// sbyag tshe lus sbrid sba 'khar sbom// sha sbrang sbrang ma sbrang dang sbrags// sbed byed gser sbram sa le sbram// sbyor ba sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs// dge sbyong gso sbyong gtsang sbra sbyor// 'doms kyi sba ba sar btags ba'o/// /

༈ ro myags myag myog nags myul myur// nyams myong myu gu'i ro myang myos// myang 'das myang myang myug myug dang*// mya ngan mya ngam ma rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dmag gi nyes dmigs dmangs rigs dman// dme po dmus long dmigs bu med// dmu rgod dmu chu 'dre srin dmu// blo dmun dmus byung bu ga'i dmig /gtsang dme 'dzum dmul dmigs pa gtod// lag dmar kha dmar kha dog dmar// nyams dmas dmod btsugs dmod pa 'dor// dmyal ba gnas dma' dmigs bsal dang*// myug myug dmyugs sogs das 'phul ma'o// ༈ //rmad byung rmugs 'dzin rmi lam rmis// rmang nas rmo rmos rmon dor dang*// rmongs rmugs khyis rmur rmugs pa'i rma// rmen pa rta rmig sga yi rmed// rmongs bu rmeg med sun pa'i rmus// seng rme bsris rme ngo mtshar rmad// rmo rmo bal rmel dris pa'i rmas// rma bya khams rmya bya rmyang byed// rmog dang dbu rmog rar btags ma'o// ༈ //sman dang sman pa'i gtam smra smros// smig rgyu smag rum zong min smar// sman ljongs sug smel smyag shad dang*// smyug ma smyi gu smyig ma smin// tshe smad sma phab smad ras smod// mgo smyung smrang dang smre sngags smras// bu smad ming smos smyan ka byed// ngur smrig rnam smin smos ci dgos// smyung gnas dus smyur smyon pa smyo// smon 'drin dri med smon lam sman// smin drug smal po smin drug bu// sme ba smug rtsi kha dog smug /sma ra smin ma sme sha can// rtsis kyi sme ba sar btags ma'o/// / ༈ tsab tsub mi bya tsog tsog bu// tsan dan tsu ta tsam pa ka /tsa ko ra dang tsi ti mo// ne tso de tsam de tsug lags// tse ne tse re tsa ri ba// tsā ru'i bza' ba tsa na ka /tsug tsug sgra sogs tsa rkyang ngo*// ༈ //gtsug tor spyi gtsug gtsang khang gtsang*// mi gtsigs spyod pa gtsug lag khang*// gtsod rus gtses shing gtser bas gtses// mche gtsigs gtsub shing gtsub gtan gtsubs// gtso bo gtsigs che gtsag bus gtsag

/gtsang phyogs gtsang chu gas 'phul tsa'o// ༈ //btsan po bka' btsan rdzong btsan dang*// btsun mor bu btsas gru btsas btsal// btsun pa mig btsums btson rar btsud// btsong btsugs btsags btsongs btsod btso btsos// gos btsems btsag dang btsod kyis btsos// btsan dug tshags kyis btsags shing btsir// btsas khyer 'bags btsog btso blag mkhan// mtho btsams rdeg btsog btsog po rdeg /btsan rgod btsan thabs gser btso ma// srol btsugs shing btsugs sgog btsong brtsongs// btsad po btsas ma bas 'phul tsa'o// ༈ //rtsa lag rtsa rtse tshon rtsi rtsing*// rtsi mar rtsi shing rtsi thog rtswa// 'thab rtsod rtsed mo rtse rtses rtsen// ldas rtsen sum rtsen rtsis rtsis mkhan// rtsib ma'i rtsa rgyus rtsid pa rtsub// kha rtsang rtse rgod rtsam rin rtseg /rtsabs gcod rtsad gcod tsher ma'i rtsang*// stobs rtsal 'bad rtsol rtsom pa rtsom// zho rtsabs rtsab mo ser rtsa'i gos// rtsig pa rtsig mkhan 'khor lo'i rtsibs// rtsangs pa srog rtsol rar btags tsa'o// ༈ //bka' stsol dngos grub stsal dang stsol// sbyin pa stsal bgyi bgyid du stsal// stsal du gsol sogs sar btags tsa'o// ༈ //brtson 'grus snying brtse brtse ba can// brtsad cing dris nas brtsam bya brtsams// khang brtsegs brtsigs shing brtsi bya brtsis// so brtse ha cang brtsengs pa'i gos// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i tsa'o/// / ༈ nags tshal skyed tshal tshi gu'i tshigs// tshogs pa'i sde tshan lus lang tsho// tshon rtsi phra tshom tshar du dngar// the tshom tsham rngams 'ju byed tshwa// khang pa'i tshoms sogs tsha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //ngo mtshar mtshan dpe mtsho dang mtshe'u// mtshe ma mtshams bcad mtshan gzhi dang*// mtshan nyid mtshon bya mtshan mas mtshan// phyogs mtshams skyon mtshang mtshan mo mtshon// mtshur ston kha mtshul mtshal dang mtshungs// rgyal mtshan mtsha' mes rta mtsha' lu// mtshar sdug khyim mtshes mtshe dang mtshan// mtshams med la mtsher dur mtshed mtshun/

mtshon cha'i phyag mtshan mtshog mar 'phyar// ming gi mtshan sogs mas 'phul tsha'o// ༈ //blo 'tshabs chu 'tshag nang du 'tshangs// til 'tshir mes 'tshig du ba 'tshubs// zas 'tshed lus 'tsho 'tsho byed 'tshengs// 'tshe med 'tshag bzang 'tshal ma 'tshal// nor 'tshol phyugs 'tsho 'tshog chas 'tshong*// brdeg 'tshog ngal 'tsho 'od 'tsher zhing*// blo dang 'tsham par skyin pa 'tshab// gdung 'tshob 'tshang rgya longs pa'i 'tshar// phyag 'tshal shes dang chog pa'i 'tshal// 'dzom pa'i 'tshag sogs 'as 'phul tsha'o/// / ༈ dza rag dza lang dza bo shing*// dza ya can sogs dza rkyang ngo*// ༈ //dpa' mdzangs mdza' bo'i bang mdzod mdzes// gnod mdzes mdzub mo mdzod spu dkar// mdzo rta'i mdzer pa mdze nad dang*// mdzol bu bsrung ba'i mdzad pa mdzod// ya rabs mdzangs sogs mas 'phul dza'o// ༈ //'dzings pas gos 'dzar lag pas 'dzin// 'dzag dang 'dzir ba'i snod 'dzed 'dzem// 'dzur zhing sgor 'dzul 'dzeg skas 'dzugs// bzhin 'dzum 'dzin pa snod du 'dzud// 'dzam gling du 'dzom nor 'dzangs 'dzad// 'dzab bzlas skad 'dzer nor ba'i 'dzol// 'du 'dzi chud 'dza' rdo yi 'dzeng*// 'khrugs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog 'as 'phul dza'o// ༈ //kun rdzob rdzun gyi rdzab rdzub dang*// phyugs rdzi'i rdzongs su rdzi'u byin// rdzing bur rdzus skyes 'dam rdzab rdzogs// rdzi phyogs rdza ma'i bu rdzi dang*// rdzi med rdzi ma zin pa'i rdzogs// mkhar rdzong nor rdzas rdzu 'phrul dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs rar btags dza'o// ༈ //gzhan gyis mi brdzi khro bor brdzus// ral pa gyen brdzes srog chags brdzis// zan brdzis yul gzhan brdzangs pa sogs// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i dza'o/// / ༈ wa skyes pha wang chu'i wa kha// 'gi'u wang pi wang 'dzum wang wang*// yid la wal le wang long dang*// wa ta yug sogs wa rkyang ngo*/// / ༈ zha bo'i zhwa mo zha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //mnyam gzhag gzhal bya gzhal med khang*// kun gzhi rnam gzhag nam gzhag gtan// gzhon nu gzhung bzang gzha' tshon gzhu// gzhogs klong bdud gzhom spo gzhogs kyang*// gnas gzhi gzhong pa g.yang gzhi gzhan// mngag gzhug khu ba gzhib la gzhol// gzha' gsang gzhongs su lcag gis gzhu// gzhi grub gzhung lugs brtag gzhig gzhug

/gzhogs kyi nad gzhi gzhang 'brum gzhil// gzhar yang gzhom med yid gzhungs gzhob// gzhis ka glu gzhas 'tsho zhing gzhes// dran pa nyer gzhag bsgrigs pa'i gzhibs// gzhen bskul nang gzhug gas 'phul zha'o// ༈ //bzhag zin bzhad gad bzhad dkar bzhi// bzhabs nas skra bzhar bzhams bsgo byed// gsol bzhi'i dgongs bzhed de bzhin nyid// bzhengs bzhugs 'byon bzhud bzhon pa zhon// bzhon ma bzho bzhos brlan bzha' bzhogs// g.yog bzhun mar bzhu bzhur nas bzhes// bzhin ras me bzhi gro byi bzhin// 'di bzhin khur bzhes dpang che bzhi// bzhi mnyam bzhag sogs bas 'phul zha'o/// / ༈ zwa tshod mi zad gzhan la zlo// sngags zlos zlos gar zla ba zlum// zla gam zlas dbye zlog pa dang*// zla grogs lo zla mya ngan zlo// bskyar ba'i zlos sogs za nyid do// ༈ //gcan gzan gzig gi gzugs brnyan gzigs// gza' skar 'od gzer gzi brjid gzi// rngul gzan phrag par gzed cing gzar// gzong gi gzeb la gzer bu gzugs// gzegs ma gzegs zan gzir bar gzas// da gzod drin gzo chud mi gzon// gzu lums gzung 'dzin gzeg cha chung*// zug gzer la gzem gzim mal gzud// gze ma tsher ma gzang ring gzan// gru gzings sha gzug zas kyi gzan// phying gzar gzar bu dgang blugs gzar// gzengs bstod gzi mdangs gzod ma'i dus// ri gzar gzugs mo byi thur gzugs// gzar thag gzungs thag gzabs kyang gzags// gzungs spobs gzungs sngags thugs gzu bo// bsgo ba rnar gzon gas 'phul za'o// ༈ //bza' ba bza' bzas bud med bza'// bza' mi bzi zhing ma bzlugs kyang*// na bza' bzang po lag pas bzung*// bzo bos lhung bzed bzed zhal bzed// bze chung mi bzad las la bzur// bzod pa tshogs bzlums sngags bzla bzlas// mi bzlog g.yul bzlog mya ngan bzla// gcig tu bzlums sogs bas 'phul za'o/// / ༈ yi rang yi chad yi dwags dang*// mda' yab rnga yab ya rkyang ngo*//

༈ //g.yor mo g.yo g.yos g.yab mo g.yabs// g.yor po g.yur za g.yan pa dgab// g.yang sa mi g.yo g.yung drung g.yang*// g.yel med g.yur za zas g.yo g.yos// g.yang gzhi g.yog g.yogs g.yer mas g.yigs// g.yi lpags g.yar nas g.yab g.yug g.yob// g.yon ma log g.yem g.yeng bas g.yengs// g.ya' sgog skyi g.ya' lcags g.ya' g.yu// g.yung mo g.yo sgyu g.yer bag g.yag /g.yas g.yon g.yul sprod g.yul las g.yog /mig g.yor kha g.yal g.yar ngo tsha// g.yar khral g.yar dam g.yar khams dang*// snang g.yel g.yer kha gas 'phul ya'o/// /

༈ ra lug rwa co rdul du rlog /mngon rlom rlom sems byin rlabs rlobs// rlon pa rlag byed 'doms kyi rlig /rlabs chen dba' rlabs rlangs pa rlung*// rlam khyer khrag rlangs rlan rlon chang*// rlag mo rlugs pa khung bu'i rlubs// dud 'gro'i rlid bu bas 'phul med// ༈ //bcom brlag tshig brlang brlag bya brlags// brla sha chus brlan ya ma brla// blo brlug brtan brling byin gyis brlabs// gdon gyis brlams sogs bas 'phul rla'o/// / ༈ lwa ni gos kyi bye brag yin/// / ༈ shar gyi shing khar shang shang shi// shul du shid zan shel gyi shubs// shed bu shed bdag shed las skyes// shun lpags sham thabs shur bus bcings// shes ldan shin tu shub bur smra// shan pa shwa 'od sha rkyang ngo*// ༈ //bde gshegs gshis lugs de bzhin gshegs// gshin po'i gshags 'byed gshin rje gshed// gshen rabs gshang dkrol dbu skra gshor// gshis ngan g.yul gshom gshung dang gshe// mo gsham gsha' ma yin du gsha'// gshor gyis chu gsho shing gshog gshags// thong gshol gsheg cing 'dab gshog gshibs// brlan gsher bres gshor 'phrang la gshor// gsham gyi spang gshongs zhing sa gshin// gshong bu la sogs gas 'phul sha'o// ༈ //mdza' bshes dge bshes lha bshos bshams// sdig bshags phyi bshol bshul lam bshar// bshum bshums bshal drud bshud nas bshags// bsha' tshe bgo bsha' ri dwags bshar// rgyab bshul pags bshus bshan pas bshas// mer bshur chus bshal bshang gci bsho// mkhar bshig bres bshar 'phrang la bshar// sbubs bshangs dpe bshad bas 'phul sha'o/// / ༈ sangs rgyas sor mo sen mo so// sil snyan sil sil se mo do// tshe srog srung zhing 'od srung sras// srid par drang srong srol tshugs srid// srod dus sa sros sre nag srab// srin po lus srul sa srung bu// srubs kyi lam srang srid du srings// yid srubs kyis sreg sring mor sred// sru mo'i sri zhu sri'u'i sri// sre mo sreg pa srin bya sram// srin bu sro ma srad bu sra// ji srid de srid sran ma srus// bsnyen sring sreg byed sreg blugs dang*// rgyal srid mun sribs rta yi srab// srub shing srub thag 'jal byed srang*// slob dpon slob ma slob gnyer sla// slob pa slo mar slong mo slong*// sle ba gyen slong slog kyang sleb// sle tres slu gu'i chu sla mo// kun slong sle yon bsad pa'i slo// slar zhing slar yang slu med slad// sle'u slog pa phyi nang slog

/sla nga'i slad rol phyogs su slon// slad mar slad nas dug ro slong*// sra brkyang bting sogs sa nyid do// ༈ //gsar bu gsar nas 'khar gsil gsor// kha gsag gsog gsob gsad bya gsod// gsang sngags snyan gsan gsung rab gsungs// gsong po'i tshig gsol gsol 'debs gson// gser mdog ne'u gsing gseg ma'i gseb// gseb dang gsa' yis gsag gsir te// shing gsom gsor gyis gsil zhing gses// gsas mo gsog 'jog gsang gtam gsong*// gso ras spu gsed gseng gi gsur// gsus pa gso phyir gsol yang gsud// so gsod lus gsig dril gsil gsum// skad gsang gseg gshang gseg ka li// gson po snyan gsang chud ma gson// 'od gsal nang gses dri chu gsil// gsal shing chud gsan gas 'phul sa'o// ༈ //sngo bsangs 'bags bsangs tshogs bsag bsags// dmigs bsal skyon bsal bsam bya bsams// bse khrab bsod nams bsod snyoms bsogs// tshe bsring bsam blo drin bsab bsabs// yo bsrang nor bsri rgyang bsring bsrings// dri bsung gis bsus bse ru bsad// bsrungs pa bsrung bya bsreg bya bsregs// bzod bsran bsro khang zho bsrubs bsres// bsod pa'i zas bsrel ring bsrel bsrings// bya ba'i bsral dang sgrib pa bsrabs// bsel ba'i bso sgra ngal bsos bu// kha bsum rjes bsubs bser bu bsil// lha bsangs me bsangs skyo bsangs dang*// blo bsrun bsam bse'u sba bsris med// bsang gtor zhabs bsil zhal bsil bsro// bslad bya bslad nas bslu bya bslus// bslang bya'i nor bslangs phyogs su bslan// bslab bya bslab pa gyen du bslangs// 'dod pa'i bsod nyams bas 'phul sa'o/// / ༈ hral hral hrul hrul mig hrig hrig /hwa shang hwags dang gos kyi hwa// rtsab hral la sogs ha nyid do/// / ༈ a ka ru dang a ru ra// u dum+bar ut+pa la// o rgyan u ma an+da rnyil// shig thog a mra e la'i 'dab// e n+ya ya na a nyid do/// /bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las// sngon 'jug sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa ste le'u dang po'o/// /

༈ da ni rnam dbye phrad la sogs// gces bsdus sil bur bstan pa las// thog mar rnam dbye drug pa yi// kyi gi gyi 'i yi rnams ni// da ba sa dang da drag dag /thob mthar kyi dang ga nga gi /na ma ra la bzhi po gyi// mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob cing*// rkang pa skong tshe yi ste dper// khyod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char// gyur kyi brag gi byang gi phyogs// dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar// gzhol gyi sa gzhi'i bdag de yi// 'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang*// rkang pa skong mi skong gis dbye// bde 'o la sogs rdzogs tshig la// 'o nyid spyi bo la sogs pa'i// ming la ba phyed wa nyid do// mtha' rten can dang brtsegs pa dang*// gug kyed can mthar 'a mtha' spang*// tshig phrad ga da ba'i rjes su// cing ces ce'o ce na cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang*// mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu// zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /sa mthar shing she'o she na shig /na ra la gsum rjes su ni// da drag thob phyir de gsum gyi// rjes su zhing sogs lnga thob kyang*// da drag nges par thob pa der// cing sogs lnga po legs te dper// rtag cing rtog ces lhag ce'o// su 'dug ce na khyod 'dug cig /rgud cing zad ces med ce'o// ci 'chad ce na chos shod cig /zab cing thob ces nub ce'o// gang rgyab ce na gri rgyob cig /byang zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o// gang gzung zhe na sems gzung zhig /snyan zhing 'dzin zhes dkon zhe'o// lha yin zhe na don zhig gnyer// 'jam zhing ngom zhes 'dzom zhe'o// dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben// dga' zhing bza' zhes 'da' zhe'o// du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig go /dar zhing 'phyur zhes 'gyur zhe'o// ci 'phyar zhe na dar phyor zhig /'tshol zhing 'chal zhes 'khrul zhe'o// gang tshol zhe na chos tshol zhig /za zhing bde zhes spro zhe'o// e smra zhe na ma smra zhig /'dus shing 'bral bar nges she'o// ci nges she na gtam smros shig

/mkhyen cing 'phral ces brgyan ce'o// cis grol ce na grol gyur cig /dri dang rdzogs tshig skabs su ni// mtha' rten med dang 'a mthar 'a// mtha' rten gzhan mthar rang rang la'o// da drag can mthar ta ste dper// bde 'am bde'o dga' 'am dga'o// gyurd tam gyurd to lta bu'o// lhag ma can gyi te ste de// na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da mthar de// ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni// mtha' rten med mthar sa ste dper// byon te bskor te nor btsal te// skyengs te gyur te don med de// rtog ste gtsang ste lhun grub ste// 'dzom ste dga' ste sems bde ste// rnam dbye bdun pa la don gyi// tu du ru su'i zhabs kyu ni// ga ba da drag can mthar tu// nga da na ma ra la du// sa su mtha' rten med pa dang*// 'a mtha' ru ste dpe rim bzhin// rtag tu rab tu shin tu dang*// steng du snod du rgyun du zo// lam du myur du 'jal du song*// rjes su 'di ru dga' ru chug /mtshams sbyor kyang 'ang yang rnams ni// ga da ba sa nyid dang ni// da drag thob pa'i rjes su kyang*// nga na ma 'a ra la yang*// mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang ni// rkang pa skong tshe yang ste dper// bdag kyang 'bad kyang don grub kyang*// byas kyang 'on kyang ma byung yang*// byon yang nam yang 'ga' yang ni// slar yang mjal yang blo'ang bde yang*// ming mtha'i pa ba'i dbye ba ni// ga da na ba ma sa dang*// da drag can mthar pa dang ni// nga 'a ra la mtha' med mtha'i// ba phyed war 'bod rnams la ba// gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper// zag pa med pa phan pa mchog /thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru// gyur ba dang ba la dga' ba// myur bar mjal bar spro ba las// lung pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis// yul pa phu pa tshim sogs dpyad// gcod mtshams 'tha' rten ga yi mthar// chig shad nga yig ma gtogs pa'i// shad gong rnams su phyi tsheg spang*// don mang bgrangs pa'i ming gi ni// mtshams dang don 'bring 'byed pa dang*// don nyung rdzogs tshig mtshams chig shad// tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mtha' dang*// lhug pa'i sde tshan rdzogs mtshams kyi// sna ru can mthar nyis shad bya// sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang*// le'u mtshams lta bur bzhi shad thob// bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/

rnam dbye dang phrad sogs gces pa sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/// / ༈ da ni 'phul dang mtha' rten mgo /med la sbyor dang yod la spong*// gdam nga can la mtha' gcig tu// 'dzin pa'i 'khrul spong cung zad bshad// rnga yab ge sar sil snyan dang*// mngon sum phun sum tshogs sogs la// gas 'phul nor ro gsha' ma dang*// gshags 'byed sogs la med na nor// sar pa lta bur gang yang rung*// skyil krung sogs la das 'phul med// dgung lo mtshan dgung long khrid kyi// dmigs bu sogs la med na nor// snyan dngags sogs la gang yang rung*// phyag dar lag dar gad mo dang*// skra shad sogs la bas 'phul spang*// bser bu skyo bsangs rgya mo bza'// phyi bdar sogs la med na nor// sngo sangs lta bur gang yang rung*// tha gru tha ma tshar du dngar// tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul spang*// mthe bo mtshe ma sngo sman mtshe// khyim mtshes sogs la med na nor// thun mong sogs la gang yang rung*// tshong dus khams dang tshogs pa tshoms// phra ma khon 'dzin khro bo khros// rim gro phra mo phongs pa dang*// phyug po sogs la 'as 'phul spang*// mtha' 'khob 'khri shing 'khur ba dang*// tshul 'chos sogs la med na nor// phrin las phreng sogs gang yang rung*// yi ge myu gu lu gu rgyud// shākya sogs la ga mtha' spang*// phrag dog phrug gur med na nor// pus mo'i lha nga sla nga dang*// sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' nor// yi dam yi rang yi dwags dang*// sri zhu sogs la da mtha' nor// ska cig lta bur gang yang rung*// se mo do la na mtha' spang*// byan mo lta bur med na nor// lha btsun bza' btung gdu bu dang*// le brgan sogs la ba mtha' nor// rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dang*// ra mnye na bza' rtsa mchog grong*// rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor// lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can// bya rgod rdo rje mtha' rten dang*// lha rten sogs la ra mtha' med// dur khrod mdor bsdus la med nor// bder gshegs sogs la gang yang rung*// snyun gyi gsos sman kha dro dang*// grwa lnga sogs la la mtha' nor// rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang*// nam mkha' go 'phang khri 'phang mchog

/bskyed rim rdzogs rim 'du shes dang*// mkha' spyod sa spyod do shal 'phreng*// nyam chung nyam thag nyam nga ba// log rtog som nyi chom rkun dang*// cho ga sogs la sa mtha' nor// lhas byin klus byin gdams ngag sogs// mang po zhig la med na nor// dri bzangs rgyud mangs go rims dang*// 'khor los sgyur sogs gang yang rung*// klad kor stod kor gdub kor dang*// pang kor than kor 'od kor phreng*// a mra sogs la sa mgo med// ngur smrig smig rgyur med na nor// yi ge zhal ta da lta dang*// la sogs tha dad ces rnams la// bar tsheg mi byed blun po'i lugs// de ltar mdo tsam bshad pa 'dis// mtshon nas shin tu rgya che'i gnas// rang rang rnam dpyod rig pas dpyad/ mtha' dag yi ger brjod mi lang*// bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las// yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong ba bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'o/// / ༈ deng sang byis pa'i skye bo rnams// brda dag 'di ko lung rigs kyis// dpyad gzhi chung zhing tshegs med du// shes snyam 'khrul pas mgo bo rmongs// kye ma shes bya pha mtha' yas// de dag re re'i ming gi yang*// rgyu mtshan nges tshig mi shes na// brda dag sbyor ba ji ltar 'byung*// so so rig bzhi sa dgu pa// ma thob de srid chos kun gyi// nges tshig shes min de yi phyir// mtha' dag sdeb sbyor su yis shes// 'on kyang phyogs re'i brda dag kyang*// 'bad pa du mas btsal bar bya// yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul na// don rnams 'khrul ba smos ci dgos// 'di ni gsung rab ma lus pa'i// phyi mor shes pas mkhas mang gi /gzhung la brten nas bdag gis kyang*// 'di nyid kho nar nan tan byas// mkhas pa du mas mdzad pa yi// brda yi bstan bcos grangs mang yang*// 'ga' zhig tshig rgyas dgos don nyung*// 'ga' zhig gnyis ka ha cang bsdus// 'ga' zhig yig rnying dang mi mthun// 'ga' zhig sum rtags sogs dang 'gal// de phyir tshig nyung don rgyas pa'i// legs bshad 'di ni bdag gis byas// 'di la rang bzo ma mchis te// tshad ldan gzhung la yang dag brten// gsar rnying brda dang rgya bod skad// la sogs zhib mor dpyad de bkod// snyigs ma'i mi rnams rnam dpyod mig

/phyogs lhung ling tog gis bsgribs nas// gzu bo'i blo yis legs bshad la// mi rtog grags pa'i rjes su 'brang*// mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma 'di ko legs bshad 'od zer stong ldan mod// blo nor ldan yang rigs gzugs longs spyod nyam chung bdag gis sbyar ba'i phyir/ rab rib blo ngan rnams kyis spangs nas blun po 'khor mang 'byor ldan gyi// nyes bshad srin bu'i kha yi 'od la rmongs pa'i mun pa sel phyir rgyug /bdag gis 'dir 'bad bsod nams dang*// gzur gnas blo gsal don gnyer pa// 'ga' la 'di yis phan srid na// de yi dge ba byang chub bsngo// ༈ bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sdom brtson mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag byang pa 'tsho mdzad kar+m+ma 'od zer ba'i gsung gis bskul te/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde zhes bya bas/ rnam 'phyang gi lo tha skar zla ba'i gral tshes bco lnga la spyan ras gzigs karma pa'i sgar chen du grub par bgyis pa'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅// bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos ngag sgron gyi 'grel pa tshig gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// chos don nges tshig spobs pa'i gter// kun mkhyen sangs rgyas la btud nas// gsung rab 'jig rten tshul la yang*// yi ge'i sbyor bas 'jug phyir dbye// 'dir bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos ngag sgron bshad pa la 'jug go / na mo bud+dha ya sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// byang phyogs bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bye brag gsung rab las 'byung ba'i yi ge'i sbyor ba gsal zhing go bar byed pa mkhas pa'i gsung gi bstan bcos tshigs su bcad nas tshig le'ur byas pa shes bya la mkhas pa'i ngag gi rang bzhin sgron ma lta bu zhes bya ba'am sgrog pa/ yang dag pa phyin ci ma log par gsung ba po gnyid sad pa ltar ma rig pa sangs shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma bye ba ltar shes bya ma lus par mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyab nas rgyas pa la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo// mthong na skyes bu dam par mtshon pa mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i gzi byin gsal ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba'i sku dang*// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rtsol rtog med par 'doms pa chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrog byed lha'i rnga chen po lta bu'i gsung dang*/

ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes rgya mtsho lta bu gting dang mtha' med pa ldan pa'i thugs mnga' ba// thub pa yin la chen po yang yin pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa ni tshangs pa la sogs pa'i yang phyag gi bya ba 'jug pa'i gnas yin no// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa kun gyi mkhyen pa dang thugs brtse ba chen po gcig tu spungs pa'i phung po cig car dus mnyam du/ /skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa'i yid kyi nam mkhar 'gog pa'am sgrib pa med par gsal ba'i gzugs can sgyu ma lta bu// 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i 'od dkar po kun tu spro ba legs par bshad pa'i bsil zer mnga' ba can// 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba'i mgon po smra ba'i zla ba mchog tu gyur pa der gus pas 'dud do// ye shes kyi bdag nyid sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul lta bu mdzes shing sdug pa'i sku la brten pa'i rnam 'gyur yid 'jo zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang// rna ba'i yul gyi sgra dang dbyangs dpag tu med pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'byung gnas rgyud mang bsnun pa las byung ba'i sgra snyan cing 'gyur bag dang ldan khyad par gyis// gdul bya'i snying la zag pa nyon mongs pa med pa'i bde ba ster ba mo lhag pa'i lhar gyur ba// dbyangs las byung ba can ma lha'i bu mos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo yi mchog dam pa sbyin par mdzod cig /srong btsan sgam po'i sngon du med pa bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs brtsams pa'i ngo mtshar du snang ba brda sprod rnam brgyad mdzad pa gsung rab bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i// legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag gis rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs bod du grags pa chos med mun pa'i gling lta bu 'dir// shākya thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa po sam+bho ṭa ste bod bzang po la sogs pa// rgya dang bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la bka' drin dran nas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal khang pa bdag ni skyes thob kyi blo gros mi rno bar rtul zhing rig pa la sbyangs pa'i mthu chung bas rtsom pa'i rgyu dman pa ltar snang yang // tshad ma dang ldan pa khungs ldan gyi mkhas pa thu mi la sogs pa'i legs bshad yi ge'i sbyor ba la brten nas// ngag gi 'khrul ba'i mun pa chen po drung rtsad nas 'byin pa go brda sprod byed kyi// bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar byed pa brtsam par bya'o// 'dir brjod par bya ba'i don sdom du byed na kā li ka phreng sum cu tham pa la// rkyang pa 'phul dang mgo gsum med pa dang 'phul byed ga da ba ma 'a lnga gang rung can dang mgo la ra la sa gsum yod pa can dang /

dbyangs nga ro'i rnam pa a i u e o lnga can dang ya ra la ba bzhi'i smad 'dogs can dang*// rjes su 'jug pa ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu yang 'jug bcas ji ltar 'thob pa'i dpe dang sogs pa phrad rnam dbye'i sbyor ba dang 'khrul ba spong tshul te rim pas bstan par bya'o//

(ka) ༈ shes bya'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen pa shākya shing shā kar gnas pa'am phod pa nus ldan te ston pa'i rigs yin la mang bkur gyi rgyud karma las sam 'phrin las pa// ka ra mngar cha'i khyad par ka tan ras dkar zhig ka shi ka gsal ldan te yul dang de'i ras// nags klung shing nags mthug po chu klung gtsang po dang rgyug chu dba' klong chu rlabs sam klong 'khor klu dud 'gro'i bye brag /ka gdod ma nas dag pa stong nyid klong yangs khong yangs pa'am rgya che ba klong du gyur par don rtogs pa dang dbang du gyur pa// ka ku bha ya phyogs khyab ste shing zhig ka dam+pa tshogs can te chu skyar dang shing zhig /ka sha gsal byed de rtswa zhig dang rdeg pa ku sha sar nyal te rtswa mchog ka ma la chu'i rgyan te pad+ma// kun+da ldum zhig gi me tog dkar po ku mud sa mos sam sa dga' ste zla bas kha phye ba'i me tog dkar po king+shu ka kiṃ shu ka rgya skyegs shing yin ne tso'am ci zhes pa'i don// ka ra bī ra lag pa'am sor bzhad de re lcag dang mya ngan gyi me tog dmar po ke ta ka shing dang nor bu ste gnyis kas chu rnyog dwangs nus// rlung sman shing kun dang a krong sngo sman dar ya kan zhang zhung gi skad de bdud rtsi'am sman yin so so'i gsang sman dang grangs brtsi rgyu'ang yod// ka ped biwa pho ku ba biwa mo sdong ring gzar bu sogs byed btub kim pa dug shing de'i 'bras bu mngar la zos na 'chi ba// kaṇ+ḍa ka ri tsher ma can sman stag tsher g.ya' kyi ma sngo sman 'khor lo rtseg pa 'dra ba yod// na rī ke la mi mo rtsen te be ta'i 'bras bu ka ko la pho rog dang sman zla ba'i bye ma dang dug rigs dgu'i bye brag /ke la sha gangs ri dang ka liṅka ka liṅka yul ci mtshan/ ko shām+bi mdzod ldan nam rtswa ku sha dang am+ba 'dus pa can te grong khyer zhig dang ko sa la yul dge ba can/ yul ka ma ta ste 'di bzhi rgya gar gyi yul ming dang ko'u shi ka rgya skad la kau shi ka yod pa sgra zur phyin pa'i ched sna ru gcig gi dod 'u sbyar ba sngags kyi klog thabs dang bod skad nyid la'ang mi chung la mi'u thung dang 'dab chags chung ba la byi'u sogs chung ba'i don lta bu la 'jug pa yod pas khyad par shes par bya ste don// dbang chen gu gul 'ug pa dang*// sbrul 'dzin rnams la kau shi ka

/zhes sogs la 'jug /kā t+yā ya na ka ti'i bu ste 'phags pa rko ṇ+ḍi n+ya thab ldan ma'i bu ste lnga sde'i ya gyal// ke'u tshang brag phug gi ming du go glang la sogs pa'i ko ba pags pa dang lham gyi krad pa rdog pa dang // yungs kar 'bru'i khyad par ka ru kha dog dkar po thod le kor ha shig ste ri mo dod pa'i rdo dkar// ku shu shing tog gi khyad par gur kum kuṅkum kha che sha skam lta bu ka ca spyad dngos rgyu nor kun thams cad// bsags mod kyang rgyan sdud kyi sgra 'thab krol 'thab mo phung krol phung byed rlag byed kyi rgyu/ /kye ma zhum pa mya ngan snying rje'i brda kyi hud mya ngan gyi brda kye ho rab bam ngo mtshar bod pa'i brda kwa dang kwa ye bod tshig /kye kye bod tshig lan gnyis smos pa kyong kyong dang kong kong gnyis gshong gshong du go /sgra dang mi sogs krog krog mig sogs krab krab 'khrab tshul mgo kyog kyog kyog po 'khyog po// krong krong tsog tsog kog gis myur bas ker ke re langs nas/ /ku re rtsed mos do ker thor tshugs ko sko ma mchu'i 'og gi cha 'degs pa// ku co skad che ba kyal ka rtsed mo klan ka rtsod pa'i rgyu// 'on kyang yin na yang lan kan pu shu mda' yab chu skyor nyen kor nye 'khor du go /ka lan ta ka bya mchil ba co ka byi'u zhig dang// bya ka la piṅka la sogs pa'i kyur kyur ni skad 'byin tshul// ki 'u sgog pa kun dong btsong kag lo'i bar chad ki kang sa bdag gi khyad par// sku stod thad kyi 'od kor dang yi ge'i steng klad kyi thig kor ram rjes su nga ro klad gong ngam steng ngam thog ma'i don dang // ke sha 'greng bu dang rna ru nyis rtseg zhabs kyu u yig lcags kyu mchil pa'am kyo bas btab pa// kar kar ni zug langs tshul bad kan nyes pa gsum gyi gcig ste smug po lta bu chu'i// ku ya sprin 'dra ba sogs mthug srab las tsha grang gi nad 'byed kan gung mdzub kyi 'og tu rtsa kyal kyal 'phar tshul// rus krang sha med rus rkyang krang nge krong nge rdo rje skyil krung 'dug tshul zhig bcas pa bzos pa// 'byams klas dang mtha' klas gnyis bsam gyis mi khyab mthas klas pa mthas gtugs pa yang yin klog 'don byed kyang yi ge klag pa klog pa'i ming tsam// ston ka zla ba gsum dpyid ka zla gsum nyin mtshan gnyis ka gnyi ga'i dus// glang chen gnyis 'thung lag ldan thal kar mdog skya bo dkar shas che ba ber ka dbyug pas brdungs pa// tshogs dang mdongs sgro gser ska dang*// rgyan dang dong bar ka la' pa sgra dang sham+bha la'i pho brang yang yin pa yis kla klo ta zig sogs bcom pa// ka ba gdung 'degs ka tsa lin+da lha'i gos kyis klubs g.yogs pa dang skul tshig

/kar+ṣa pa ṇa kar+ṣa pa ṇa zho yi dong rtse ke ke ru nor bu ser po// dur bya kang ka ste rgyab dkar 'di ko 'di ni'am 'di tsho klag cor ku co che ba// keng rus sha med rus pa cha tshang ka pa li ka pā la ste bde skyong thod pa'i nang gi klad pa kha la za// kun nas thams cad nas kun tu thams cad du'am yang dag par pags pa kab kob gyong po mkhregs pa// ku hu khu byug dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin pa la sogs pa kong bo pra ka ra ṇa ma thos ka med de ka shes na ka lta bu ka rkyang pa 'thob par snang ngo // (dka) dkar chag tho yig 'thems byang gong 'og ma dkrugs pa ma 'khrugs pa dkor nor gyi spyi ming mdzod sgo phye nas dkrogs pa mchod sbyin byed pa'am 'jug pa// lha'i dkyil snying po 'khor len pa zla dkyil sogs kyang dkyil dbus thad du lha dkrong skad cig gis bskyed pa dka' ba khag po dka' las// chos sogs la dka' las thub pa dka' ba spyad pa dkon cog dkon mchog dkon pa dkon mo// mdog kha dog dkar po dkyel che pa khong yangs pa spyan mig dkyus srid du ring ba// dkyus ma phal pa'am rang bzhin pa'i ming dkor ni dad zas dang nor spyi dri ma dku dri nga ba mchi ma dku mchi ma 'dzag pa// dkos thag nyam thag pa kun nas dkris pa nyon mongs pa gos kyis lus dkris pa dkri ba// dku gsus pa'i skabs mtshams te sta zur dku grod pa zlum po ril ril dku dku ma rnyongs rked pa ring thung 'tsham pa// mkha' la sprin dang rdul dkrigs pa 'khrigs pa zho dkrogs pa srub pa rol mo sil snyan lta bu dkrol ba 'khrol ba// dkar po'i yol go ste btung snon dang gas chag dkrum pa bcag pa dkyu ba'i sar rta dkyus pa ste rgyug sar rgyug pa// go dka' ba'i don 'grel pa 'grol ba dkrigs phrag grangs gnas shig dkan gyen gzar po// phan tshun phra mas dkrugs pa mi mthun par byed pa dang dkyus mo dkre sogs sngon 'jug das 'phul ba'i ka'o//

(bka) bkra shis dge legs bkrag ni mdangs yin tshon rtsi bkra ba khra bo ngo mtshar mdzes pa bsam mi khyab bkram pa 'grems pa// bka' gsung sogs bsgos pa gnang ba khral dpya bkal ba khal khur bkal ba srad bu skud pa bkal ba 'gel ba'am 'khal ba// pho nya bang mi bkye ba ston mo zas sogs bgye ba 'od bkye ba sprul pa bkye ba gtong ba'am spro ba// dgongs pa bsam pa'i don bkral ba 'grel ba dang dpya khral bkral ba so sor bgos pa'am phye ba dgongs pa bkrol ba dgrol ba bcings pa mdud pa sogs bkrol ba bshig pa// dri ma chus bkru ba dang bkrus pa gnyis 'khrud pa bkren ser sna dang dbul ba la 'jug cing pho ba bkres pa ltogs pa// logs su bkar ba bton pa'am bkol nas thag pas bkyigs pa 'khyig pa bcings te tshe srog bkums pa 'gums pa gsod pa bkrongs pa bsad pa'i zhe sa// bkad sa g.yos khang gral zas za ba'i khang par go snod spyad bkang ba dgang ba thugs dgongs dam pa bkang ba dgyes par byas pa// bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bkur sti rim gro'am mchod pas gral gong du'am gtsug tu bkur ba 'khur ba rtsi ba// khang pa sogs kyi bzo bkod dang bka' bkod legs pa bde ba'i sar bkod pa bzhag pa zur du bkol ba bton pa dang // shing sogs bkug pa 'gugs pa bkas pa dgas pa dum bur gses shing g.yog tu las su bkol ba spyod pa 'khol ba// gnang ba bya rung ba bkag pa bya mi rung ba ste 'dul ba'i brda sman gyi khu ba bku ba 'byin pa bkus pa byung ba'am bton te bor ba dor ba sman snyigs kyang*// gos dang thog sogs bkag pa g.yogs pa gzhu la mda' sbyar nas bkang ba 'then pa dang shing gi rtsa ba dang shog bu sogs bkog pa dgog pa bton pa// bka' drin phan btags pa bka' btags pa khrims bsgrags pa bka' la blo sems bde ba ste chos ston gyi tshig la dga' ba// bka' bkyon dang brgyad bkag gnyis spyo ba khon du bkon pa 'khon pa 'dzin pa// 'gro lam sogs bkag pa 'gegs pa spa bkong pha rol po zhum par byas pa rgyal po sogs kyis bkrabs pa mang po'i dkyil nas gdams pa// lus gan rkyal du bkan pa bstan pa lag pa bkan pa lag mthil gyen du bstan pa sogs bkros pa 'dams pa'am gdams pa nas bkri ba 'khrid pa// mdo sde bklags pa klog pa dang yi ge'i mgo bkad dam skra lhas ma yin snyam mgo 'dzugs zhes kyang snang dpyad thags kyi bkad sgyur ba dang 'ur rdo lhas pa'i bkad lta bu// bkyal ba'i ngag ngag 'khyal dang bkyed pa bkrum pa sogs bas 'phul ka'o//

(rka) mi sogs kyi rkang pa dang lag pa rka yur ba ldan pa'i zhing ngam rkang bzhi yod pa ltar na dud 'gro rkan dkan yang rung ste ya rkan dang rkub tshos te 'phongs// chom rkun rku mkhan dang zangs sogs kyi rkyan snod dang phye rkyal rtsam rkyal sman rkyal sogs rku ba ma byin par len pa// rkong pa pags nad chig rkyang gcig rkyang pa sa dang par sogs rko ba dang rkos skul tshig /gan rkyal gan kyal yang rung ste kha sbub min pa rked pa nu ma dang dpyi gnyis kyi bar lta bu dang lag sogs rkyong ba brkyang ba rkon pa rnyi 'dzugs pa// rka yur ba'am chu lam gyi mgo'i chu la rkyal rtsed pa rgyab pa ri dwags kyi bye brag rkyang drel 'dra ba// nyer len gyi rgyu dang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang rang rkya thub pa rkom la sogs pa rar btags pa'i ka'o// (lka) lkog phag tu gyur pa mngon gyur min pa lkog ma og ma lkog shal ske nas sha leb 'phyang pa dang/ ngag lkugs pa kha lkugs pa la sogs pa lar btags pa'i ka'o// (ska) ska ba dpal brtsegs dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis skal pa dang ldan pa las 'phro can dang nam mkha'i skar ma spyi ming skag skar ma'i khyad par dang rgya tshos// chos sogs kyi sku lus sam phung po skem pa skam pa snum rtsi lus la skud pa 'byug pa dang bal gyi skud pa srad bu skyol skyel ba'i skul tshig dang sgrim pa// skyo ma lde gu mig skyag phra ma'i don skyag pa phyi sa dang bya skyung ka lcung kas skyud pa mi dran par rjed pa// ska rags rked chings skyer kha ser po skya bo dkar shas che ba sogs skyu ru ra sman// skyes bu gang zag dang zhal sogs skyems btung ba nyid kyi don la 'jug skom rlan rlon dang ro bro skyur mo dang me la chu skol ba// gos skon gyon du bcug pa g.yog pa skyen yang ldang ba yang ba'am rtsal che ba dang chu la skyur ba 'phen pa 'dor bas sems skyo ba nges 'byung yid 'byung*// skem byed skem pa po dang gdon zhig skul byed dge sogs la skul ba po skor ba byed pa gnas skor mtha' skor mgo skor sogs// skyu rum zas kyi ro gsal byed tshod ma skyu mtshon nam zan gang dang kha nas mi gtsang ba'i zas skyugs pas kha skyengs pa ngo tsha ba// skran nad kyi khyad par dang skyigs bu g.yig pa'i ming tsam mam de'i nad dang bad kan skya rbab nad dang skrangs pa sbos pa// ri skyegs ri skegs kyang rung ste bya dang glang chen chu skyar mthing ril skya ga mdog nag cing glo dkar po can gyi bya'i ming skad sgra// skun bu kong bu dang slo ma skam pa 'dzin spyad dang gru'i skya ba lung rigs kyi skya bar nas bton zhes pa lta bu sogs dang snod skyogs zhu skyogs sogs// dge skos sam yang na dge bar sko ba pos bro skrab pa 'khrab pa ḍa ma ru skrog pa rdung ba// skud po chung ma'i ming po dang sring mo'i bdag po skyo sngogs 'khrug long rtsod pa zhi zin pa slar slong ba snyan skyo skyo ma phra mas sam yang na skyos pa nyams pa skrag pa 'jigs pa bred pa// rgya skyegs rgya tshos skag skyed mos tshal ldum shing ra ba skyer pa zhes pa'i shing zhig skas tha them skas// lus kyi ske mgul pa dang og skor og ma chu skyegs kha la skyugs pa'i sngon du byung ba'i chu skyur dang shing dang bu sogs skyes pa skye ba// skyi g.ya'i don skrag pa skyon nyes pa mtshang dang ngan song las skyob pa srung ba dang rten nam skyabs su 'gro ba re ltos 'cha' ba dang tshig yang yang skyor ba ldab pa// mas bu 'tsho zhing skyong ba bskyang ba re ba skong ba bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa skyin gor dbyid de stobs skyed sman gangs sbal sogs dang mar gyi skogs pa 'thums byed dam shun pa// srab skyogs rta srab bam srab kyis skyogs shing sgyur ba skyes rten nam rigs bzang po rgyal gyi don la 'jug pa'i lkugs rgyal 'gugs byed// bya skyibs char mi 'bab pa'i brag skyibs sogs skar ma mthong ba'i thog khung rab gsal yang skor tsher skabs rer bde zhing skyid pa spro ba skyid po// skyel ma skyel mkhan skyes bu chen po skyes mchog skyos ma rten nam skyes skrod pa gegs sogs mthar skrod btang ba snyil ba// chu sogs skyom pa g.yo bar byed pa zho skrog pa srub pa rtsis kyi skyeg bar chad// ji skad ji lta ba lung 'dren pa'i tshig 'di skad 'di ltar dang yin skad zer skad sogs kha skong pa kha tshang bar byed pa tshe skabs go skabs skabs rnyed gnas skabs sogs// sa gzhi skyong ba sa skyong pa rgyal po skyang nul zhal ba skam pa rlon pa min pa re skan mna' skyel ba// yun thung ba'i ska cig ma skad cig ma mgo'i skra mgor nyal skyes pa skye ba shing sogs skrus pa kong kong 'dru ba'am gcod pa// sbas pa'i don can gyi skungs shig dbus kyi mtha' nas skor ba khor yug skobs su chud pa gnas sam bar du tshud pa ste bya dka'i skobs su chud bya dka'i gnas su tshud lta bu// rang gi skal ba bgo skal sogs dang shes pa skye zhing mched par byed pa ste mig sogs bcu gnyis thugs dam skong ba dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa'am mnyes par byed pa// bya 'dzin byed skon pa rnyi skyi ko ba'i phyi dkar po ko ba mnyes ma skye tshe'i don ni 'bru zhig

/skyo ma snga btsan phra ma bcug pa skyil krung 'dug stangs kyi khyad par skyod pa g.yo ba 'gro ba// skya rengs skya mda' zhal skyin zhal ras dang skyes pa rtsig skyabs rtsig skyor skum pa skyi ba skye bo skyas 'degs pa sgog skya re skon sogs sar btags ka'o// (brka) 'dod pa'i yon tan la brkam pa brkams pa chags pas brku bya brku ba ma byin par blang bya gser sogs brkus pa ma byin par blangs pa ste brku rku brkus rkus lta bu byed 'brel bdag gzhan dus gsum dang ma 'brel ba'i dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'ang rtags 'jug las shes dgos tshul 'di gong 'og gi bya tshig gzugs 'gyur mi 'gyur thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o// 'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun las bag yangs dang 'brel ba sra brkyang gi gzhi ste gtan pa yang zer lag pa brkyang ba rkyong ba brko bya par dang sa sogs brkos pa rko ba// brkyangs pa brkams pa sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o//

(bska) byug pa snum sogs bsku ba dang bskus pa skud pa 'byug pa lag pa sogs bskum pa dang bskums pa tshur skum pa sdud pa// 'phrin cha bskur ba 'gan khag bskur ba dbang mnga' bskur ba skur ba sprod pa chos sogs la bskul ba skul ba byed du bcug pa// nor gser sogs bskyi ba dang bskyis pa skyi ba g.yar ba dang bskyin pa skyin tshab bskyal ba skyel ba 'phen pa// gos la sogs pa bskon pa skon pa g.yogs pa rta dang thab la sogs par bskyon pa skyon pa 'jog pa'am 'jug pa'am rgyab pa bskyar ba skyor ba ldab pa bzlas nas phyir bskrad pa skrod pa 'don pa// gcom bskyungs nga rgyal bcag pa'am sgra chung ngur byas pa skyung ba 'dor ba zas bskru ba slong ba bskyed pa skyed pa spel ba'i don la 'jug cing dge rtsa dang par sogs bskrun pa skrun pa skyed pa gsog pa bzhengs pa bzo ba// dus kyi bskal pa bar bskal sogs kyi mes mtsho dang shing sogs bskams pa skem pa chu sogs kyi sna ma btang bar bskyil ba skyil ba 'khyil ba bskyams pa skyom pa g.yo bar byed pa// yul dus rang bzhin gyis bskal ba lkog gyur ram bar chod pa'i don dang bskungs pa skung ba sbas shing 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa skyob pa bskyangs pa skyong ba 'tsho ba// gnas gzhan du 'pho zhing bskyas pa bskya ba spo ba rgyang ring du bskyur ba skyur ba 'dor ba bya ba bskyungs pa skyung ba bshol ba// mi dgag tshig bskyod pa skyod pa g.yo ba bskor ba mtha' nas skor ba dang tshig skor ba rgyal po'i sar bskos pa bsko ba bzhag pa byed du bcug pa// zas kyi ro bska ba a ru ra'i ro lta bu dang bska sla'i bska ba ste gar ma kha bskang ba skong ba tshang bar byed pa thugs dgongs dam pa bskangs pa skong ba rdzogs par byas pa// gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa lta bu'i sems bskyed pa skyed pa rgya khyon bskyed pa cher btang pa dang dran pa med par brjed pa'i don can gyi bskyud pa skyud pa dang*// bskyang ba bskyang ba sogs bas 'phul ba'i sa mgo ldan pa'i ka 'thob pa'o//

(kha) ༈ go khrab go cha khri phrag stong phrag bcu khrag khrig grangs gnas shig gi ming khur ni 'khur ba ste 'das pa dang skul tshig yin// khong nas khro ba zhe sdang khon du 'dzin pa gnod sems 'chang ba khro bo khro ba po khros pa khro ba'i 'das skul// khro dang khrol ma'am tshags ma 'tshag byed khrud pa 'khyud pa'i ming khu bas khrus 'khru ba'i ming dang skul tshig dang 'das pa// khong pa tsho dang khong du chud pa dang khong nas sam zhe nas khro ba sdang ba khon du 'dzin pa mi mthun par 'dzin pa gnod sems mi gtong ba khro bo zhi ba min pa'i khro ba po khros shig pa'am 'das pa// khong ba'i zungs khrag sogs khrag khrug khrag nad dam 'khrugs pa khrung khrung bya'i bye brag khyu rigs mthun pa'i tshogs// nyes spyod sdom pa sogs kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims bsil ba 'thob pa khris 'jags chings byas pa ltar gnas pa khrims lugs kyi ming khral dpya sogs// 'jal byed khru gang sor nyer bzhi'i tshad sogs khrun dkyus ring po khram kha ri mo'i khyad par khra bo kha dog sna tshogs pa// khrom tshogs pa khrod gseb bam dkyil gdan khri'i steng gtsug lag khang sogs mi khyim sgo dang 'khor gyi khyams// phug ron sogs gsod byed bya'i khyad par khra dang khyi yis khyer zin dang khyer cig bsnyim pa gang la khyor ba do'i tshad byed pa lta bu khre 'bru'i bye brag /kho ra khor yug mtha' skor khron pa'i chu khrems thim pa dang 'grems pa'i skul tshig /sil khrol lcags kyi rol mo 'dod gzugs gzugs med kyi khams rnam pa gsum po khram pa ham pas zhe khrel ba gzhan la 'dzem pa// dur khrod ro bzhi yan skyel sa lam gyi sna khrid pa lam mkhan khrums stod dang khrums smad gnyis rgyu skar zhig /khong khro ba'i gnyer ma khwa ta 'dab chags shig dang khams khong rnam pa khyed khyod khud pa khong du chud kha khris ma khegs khal sogs kha rkyang ngo //

(mkha) rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang las kyi mkhan pos sa las byas pa'i mkhar rdzong mkhrang ba gyong bo grims pa mkhregs pa sra ba mkhyen pa shes pa// mkhyud pa'am sbas nas spyad pa gsang ba'i man ngag dpe cha mkhyud pa ser snas tshos kyi gnad mi ston pa zhu mkhan 'dri mkhan nam tshos gdan nye bar mkho ba dgos pa// ma mkhal ma mgal mkhal ma nang khrol zhig bzhin gyi mkhur tshos 'dzum pa dmul ba shes bya la mkhas pa dran dbang*// sngo mkhan pa'i khrod mkhos phab pa bde bar gnas pa snga mkho sngar bzhin sngar ltar// nam mkha' rgyu skar gyi lam dang mnyam pa mkhris pa'i nad med par mkhyen pa shes pa// chu mkhris rta gdong gi me lag pa'i mkhrig ma dang mkhur ba spo ba sogs mas 'phul ba'i kha'o// ('kha) blo 'khums pa sems zhum pa zhe nas 'khon pa bkon pa 'dzin pa 'khang ba sdang ba'i don yin zhing 'khu ba sdang ba dang ser sna// 'khyags pa 'khyag pa'am grang nas yul mtha' 'khob chos med pa'i gnas 'khyar ba 'khyams pa'am zhig pa'am 'chi zhing 'khyams pa 'phyan pa// rgas pa la go ba'i 'khogs pa lon song ba 'khos ka chung ba nus pa chung ba rkang pa 'khum rang bzhin gyis skum pa 'du ba 'khyog pa drang po min pa// gom pa 'khyor ba mi brtan pa 'khyom pa g.yo ba 'khar ba lag rten dang chu btung snod dang snod kyi mthil du zas tshig pa lta bu go bar byed cing yab yum 'khril ba sbyor ba shing la 'khris pa sbyor ba dang chags zin pa lus la 'khyud pa sbyor ba// 'khrig pa 'dod pa'i dga' ston gyi tshig sprin 'khrig sogs ngag gam gtam 'khyal ba bkyal ba 'chal ba 'thab pa dang 'khrug pa don gcig cing gong 'og 'khrug pa sogs kyang go 'khrul pa nor ba g.yo ba// shing sogs la 'khri ba 'am chags zhen 'khru ba bkru ba dang bshal ba chus 'khrud pa gzhan la 'khri zhing sbyor bar byed pa'i shing 'khrungs pa skyes pa// nyi gdugs sogs 'khyir ba 'khor ba zhabs bro 'khrab pa rdung ba'am skrab pa 'khar ba'i rnga 'khrol ba dkrol ba// sems chu ltar 'khol ba rnal du mi gnas pa sems sogs 'khrugs pa 'dzings pa 'khyug po mgyogs po dang mig sngar 'bab pa 'thun par go 'khyus pa 'bros pa rgyug pa// khur po 'khur ba bkur ba dpya khral 'khri ba phog pa nyi 'od 'khyims pa 'od skor ba chu sogs 'khyil ba skyil ba// 'khor ba rang nyid skor mkhan med par 'khor ba ste srid pa sogs mang po la 'jug par mthong zhing 'khren pa chags shing zhen pa 'khras pa chags shing 'khar ba zhen pa 'di gsum don 'dra// thag pas ma 'khyig pa ma 'ching ba dang skul tshig ma 'khyer ba ma 'khur ba snum du btsos pa'i 'khur ba bzhes spro 'khur ba 'khyer ba// las sne sogs ma 'khyur ba ma bskyur ba'am ma brjes pa bred pa'i 'khrims pa 'jigs pa 'khams pa brgyal bar go dgos shing nad sogs kyis ngag 'khun pa'am 'khun bu'i sgra thon pa// gser sogs kyi 'khor lo 'khod pa bkod pa'am gnas kyang gtso bo g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa 'khobs pa khyab pa rgya che ba// g.yog tu 'khul ba ma bskul bar g.yog las byed pa g.yog tu 'khol ba bkol ba srad bu skud pa 'khal ba bkal ba// 'khra ba chags pa'i sar ma 'khyol ba ma bskyal ba'am ma son pa 'khrid pa bkri bar 'jug 'khums pa go ba'am shes pa thos pa// rus kyi bye brag sa skya'i gdung la 'khon ces pa'ang mi mthun pa'i don yin 'khob pa la gong du 'khur 'khor sa sogs 'as 'phul kha'o//
