(ga) ༈ grub pa'i mtha' dpyad pa'i mtha' ste chos lugs grub pa thob pa mthong lam sogs la reg pa grangs ka med pa grangs gnas shig dang grangs su thebs mi nus pa grol ba thar ba mdud pa zhig pa yal ba// ral gri mtshon cha'i khyad par gro ga shing stag pa'i shun pas shog bu dang rbab sogs rang bzhin gyis gril ba zhes grag lo grag zer gsum gyi grag /grul bum gdon zhig grang ba'i nad bad kan sogs grum bu nad cig gis grongs shi ba dang skul tshig /mon gru dang nam gru dang gre dang gro bzhin 'di bzhi rgyu skar gyi bye brag /chos kyi grwa chos ra bla'i grwa bzo grwa chos gos kyi grwa grwa pa'i gral rim du rim gro bkur sti dang zhabs brtan nam sku rim la sogs pa'i ming grabs sta gon// yul gru yul khyon nam yul gru zur bzhi gru gzings kyi kha na yod pa'i grong khang pa'am khang pa'i tshogs// gra ma shing zhig spu gcod pa'i gri spu gra ltar yang 'dug gru 'dzin pa'i ri ste po ta la'i ri// mon lug gla sgang sngo sman zhig gro 'bru'i bye brag sbang ma'i glum glum sbang*// snye ma'i gra ma dang sog ma'i phub ma rgya gro ma sogs mon sran gre'u khre'u// grod pa gsus pa gron 'gro can thugs gron snag shog gron du zad lta bu 'gro song ngam chud zos grung po spyang po dang sa bon grung po'i don yin zhing sku dang rig pa sogs grims pa mi lhod pa'i don skul tshig kyang yin// gram pa zhes pa'i don chu rgyug shul gyis chu grog chu grang la bye btab pa'i sman gre ba mgur ram mid pa'i don grogs po rogs sam zla bo// shing gi grib ma la sogs par bya ba legs nyes kyi gros byed pa gleng ba bshad pa re ba gron du med pa re ba chud mi za ba// ri dwags gla ba'i lte bar yod pa'i rtsi sman gla las byas pa'i rngan pa glud tshab ltar glen pa blang dor mi shes pa// dzam+bū zur chag pa'i 'dzam bu'i shing yod pa'i gling chu'i bar du chud pa'i gle bar glegs ma'i bam po ste po ti gling bu rgya gling la sogs pa'i ming glu rdo rje'i glu sogs// nad pho ba glang thabs dang pags nad glang shu bas bldag glog pa zhes pa'i nad// glo ba nad khrol zhig dang glo ba dga' zhes pa yid dga' ba'i don glo lud pa dgog pa bkog pa dbyibs leb mor glebs leb leb byed pa mnan pa// glang po chen po lag ldan glo yis phab pa gzhogs phab pa bde bar gnas pa kha glod pa lhod po byed pa bkrol ba'am btang nas seng ge glal ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang kha g.yal ba// rtsig pa'i glo logs 'bur ba glo bur nges med dam 'bral du rung ba glo rdeg mgyogs pa glo bur nam mkha'i glog rnam gsal// glags skabs rnyed pa thob pa bzang ngan gyi lan glan pa 'jal ba gos kyi lhan pa glan pa dgab pa// khang pa'i sgo glegs sgo 'phar chos gos kyi glegs bu tshal bu dang pod chung dang spring yig la sogs pa'i don grwa zur dang sde sogs// gla gor zho sha shing sman zhig gtan gyi mdun ma sogs gleng ba gros byed pa bshad pa// bya'i khyad par glag ces pa lu gu sogs gsod mkhan grog ma srog chags mig med grib mi gtsang ba grib gnon gdon zhig

/grog po ri'i sul la sogs par go lag pa'i gru mo dkar yol chag cing grum pa dkrum pa grubs zhes snang yang dpya don grub yin nas med// thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub grub pa gru char char pa 'bebs par 'jig rten na grags pa// ri dwags sha ba'i khrag rwa sogs la 'jug pa'i gwa dor dang gru gu tha gru bya gag gya nom gyi na gang bu sogs ga rkyang ngo // (dag) sna gcig spyod pa sogs kyi dge bsnyen pha ma spang bya bcu spong ba'i dge tshul pha ma sems dga' ba thugs dgyes pa mnyes pa dgod pa gad mo shor ba// dgung gnam sngon po dgu tshigs gnam gyi ska rags lus rgyab tu phyir dgye ba'i don yin zhing mdun du dgu ba gug pa// nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i dgung dkyil lam phyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge grogs yod dgu yod do cog gam yod tshad dgug pa bkug pa// dge sbyong sangs rgyas lta bu dge slong pha ma spang bya thams cad spangs pa dge 'dun dge slong bzhi las mi nyung ba'i tshogs grangs dgu yis// nyon mongs sogs gnod byed kyi dgra bo bcom pa dang dgongs pa bzhed pa'am bsam pa dgrol ba bkrol ba'am bkral ba yi ger dgod pa bkod pa// mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa sun 'byin pa 'thad pa'i cha sgrub pa snod dgang ba bkang ba dgon pa dben par go dgar ba bkar ba// ri dwags dgo ba yis pha ba dgo dgo me med du ba ste khrag gcod kyi sman dgas pa bkas pa// khal dgal ba bkal ba gos kyi lhan pa dgab pa bkab pa dang dgog pa bkog pa// skye dgu skye bos dge ba legs pa'i don bde ba 'byin byed kyi dge ba sgrub pa dgos pa nyer mkho yod med sogs// dgongs mo phyi dro sogs zong btsong bya'i dngos po smar min dgram pa bkram pa me tog thang ga sogs dgram pa bkram pa// dgun dung can chu med pa'i gnas nyid du dus dgun ka sdod/ /dgung gnam lo dang dgam pa dgrung ba la sogs das 'phul ga'o//

(bag) bka' bgro ba gros bya ba bgro bya'i gtam gleng pa 'chad pa bgyi ba bya ba bgyid pa byed pa bgyis pa byas pa gyis shig byos shig /go cha lus la bgos pa gyon pa bgegs bar chad gegs kyis bgrod pa 'gro ba'i lam bgags pa bkag pa// dus tshod bgyangs pa phyis pa tshod bgam pa nyams tshod len pa bgo bar bya ba'i gos bgos pa gyon zin pa// sku bgres po bgres pa rgan pas mig gnyis bgrad pa bsgrad pa gdangs pa bgrang bya brtsi bya'i phreng ba bgrangs pa brtsis pa// bgrus pa shun pa'am sbun pa phud pa'i ming 'bras sā lu bgos pa bgo bsha' byas pa gad mo ga zha bgad pa dgod pa// rkang pa'i gom pa bgoms pa 'gom pa gom pa spos pa dang steng nas bgoms shing chu rnyog ma bgrungs pa dwangs bar byas pa// bgo bya'i skal ba rang skal bgrod pa bgor ba la sogs bas 'phul ga'o// (mag) lus sogs kyi mgo bo yan lag mchog gtso bo mgur ba mgrin pa dang gsung mgur mgul ba ske mgrin pa gre ba mgar ba lcags bzo dang blon po mgar lta bu rus ming mgon po skyob byed sems mgu ba dga' ba// mgal dum shing tshig dum mgal me'i 'khor lo gtor ma sogs kyi mgron du bos pa mgron po'am gsar 'ongs kyang mgyogs pa myur ba// ya mgal ya le ma mgal ma le sogs mas 'phul ga'o// ('ag) gzhan du 'gro ba phyin pa 'greng ba langs pa rgyal khams 'grim pa 'gro ba myul ba 'grul ba 'gro ba 'grul pa yang 'gying pa sgying pa 'gying bag rnam 'gyur 'gros 'gro tshul rta 'gros kyang 'gran pa bsdur ba// zas kyis lto ba 'grangs pa gang ba 'gengs pa bkang ba 'gag pa bkag pa 'gog pa bkag pa 'gog bden nyan thos 'gog pa lta bu 'gags pa bkag pa dum bur 'gas pa bkas pa'am yang na 'ga' zhig gis zhes pa'i don 'grib pa mi snang ba sgrib pa// dus 'gyangs pa phyis pa 'gor ba yun ring thogs pa so sor 'gyes pa 'bral ba grol ba bshes gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs pa sdeb pa sten pa dgongs pa 'grel ba bkral ba ste bstan bcos 'grol ba bkrol ba// 'gyel ba sgyel ba 'gril ba sgril ba 'grongs pa 'chi ba 'gum pa 'chi ba 'gal ba mi mthun pa zhe 'gras pa zhe sdang ba mi dga' ba sngar byas la 'gyod pa phyis gdung*// 'gol ba dben pa'i sar gdong gi 'gram pa ldan pa 'gul ba g.yo ba nor rdzas 'gye ba dang 'gyed pa bkye ba gtong ba// 'gan khag 'khur ba 'gong po'i gdon gzhan la 'go ba'i nad cham pa sogs 'gos pa sbags pa'am 'byar ba lta bu// gong du 'phel ba dang 'grib pa nyams pa rgud pa 'gyur ba mi brtan pa dang skad 'gyur ba sogs 'gyus pa rgyas pa dang sems 'gyu ba mi 'gong ba mi skrag mi zhum zil gyis mi gnon pa dang // lam gyi 'gron po 'grul pa 'ga' zhig kha cig 'gugs pa bkug pa rtseg pa'i 'gram gzhi'am rmang 'gram chu 'gram nye 'gram sogs kyang 'god pa bkod pa 'bri ba dang 'jog pa// brtson cing 'grus pa 'bad pa 'go ma thog ma'i chu 'grems pa bkram pa don sogs 'grub pa grub pa// mgo bo 'gems pa 'joms pa bkas pa gzhan la rigs 'gre ba kha spo ba tshos kyi 'grib pa tshos nyes pa// 'thab mo 'gyed pa 'khrug pa byed pa dang 'gel ba rigs 'gres pa 'gyu ba 'gang ba 'gums pa la sogs pa 'as 'phul ba'i ga'o//

(rga) blo rgod po sna tshogs dran nus sam grung po sogs rgya che ba'i mtsho chu'i phung por go chu dang la sogs rgal ba'i phyir rgyu ba 'gro ba// gna' gtam gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa sngon gyi lo rgyus phreng ba'i rgyud phreng thag gam phreng ba rgyud pa yang rgyud mang po can sgra snyan mdzes byed kyi rgyan sogs// bya rgyal rgod po rgan po rgas pa dang bslab pa rgan pa rga ba na tshod yol ba sogs shi ba lta bu'i rgud pa nyams pa// phas kyi rgol ba pha rol gyi rgol ba gnod byed rgol phyir rgol sogs rtsod byed rgyang 'phen pa phyi rol pa thams cad dang chad smra'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mgo bo la rgyob cig snun cig /rgod ma rta mo'i ming rgyab lus kyi rgyab sogs rgyas pa rgya che ba 'phel ba bye ba spros pa rgyas par bshad pa sogs rgyang thag ring po rgyug pa mgyogs por 'gro ba dang rgyug che ba sogs// rgya bo gdong la rgya yod pa dmu rgod mi srun pa phyag rgya phyag dam dang phyag rgya bzhir go rgyo 'khrig pa'i dngos ming*// rgya tsha tshwa'i khyad par rgyam tsha tshwa'i khyad par rgyags lto phogs kyi phye'i rgyugs dpe rgyugs ja rgyugs sogs// rgyu mtshan sgrub byed dam go byed rgyu lo rgyus gtam rgyus bying ba rig pa gsal cha med pa rgod pa sems mi gnas par 'phro ba rgyu skyed byed dang 'jog byed kyi rgyu// bdud bzhi las rgyal ba khe thob pa bcom ldan bla ma'i rgyud rgyun chags te rgyud sde bzhi sogs rgyal po gtso bo mi bdag lta bu rgyu ba'i skar ma rgyal stod dang rgyal smad de skar ma'i bye brag /shes pa sems kyi rgyud rgyun rgya yis btab pa mi 'da' ba'i rtags bkod pa nga rgyal dregs pa zas dang rigs sogs kyis rgyags pa mtho bar sems pa// rdo rje rgya gram bsnol ba rgyan po sho sogs rgyan dang rgyal gnyis skugs// rgun gyi 'brum pa rgun shing gi 'bras bu rgya shug shing gi khyad par nya rgya dol lam rkon par go rgyu ba 'gro ba// lus kyi rgyus pa rtsa rgyus dang rgyus skud lta bu rgyu ma nang khrol lu gu rgyud bar ma chad pa// ko gru rgyongs shig pa ste grur spyad dngos sogs bkang ba'am gru nyid cher btang ba'i skul tshig rgyang byed kyi shing cher gtong byed kyi shing yin la rgyang shing zhes pa ltar na rgyang bar byed pa'i don smig rgyu bye ma nyi 'od rlung gsum tshogs pa las chur snang yang don la ma grub pa chu la sogs pa'i rgyun bar ma chad pa// rgya gar rgya nag gi yul rgya khyon che ba lto rgyab zas gos skyid// dgra las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma g.yul las rgyal ba rgyal kha thob pa dang rgya ma rgyang shel rgyus shig chu rgol cig rgyag pa gad rgyangs rgyab pa mi rgod rgod pa la sogs pa rar btags pa'i ga'o//

(lga) la mgo can gyi lga ni lgang ba gcin snod la 'jug pa gcig pur nges so// (sga) sgom pa 'dris pa goms pa bsams don yang yang yid la byed pa chen po blo gros sgam po zab pa sgrin po mkhas pa dang 'gran por go sgrun pa sdur ba 'gran pa// lcags kyi sgrog chings lcags thag sgor mo dbyibs gor gor te phyi sgor rgya sgor lta bur go skud pa dang rig pa sogs sgrim pa mi lhod par byed pa'i don yin zhing rbab dang shog bu sogs sgril ba lta ba dril byed pa// sgyid pa skyur ba snyom las byed pa sgyid pa lug pa don gyi le lo ste bya ba rlabs chen la zhum par byed pa dang rkang pa'i sgyid khug sogs kyang sgyed bu thab sgyed sa la sgyel ba snyol ba// sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi g.yo slu ba sgyu sems gya gyu'am thabs kyis rang yon sgrog pa sgyu ma mig 'phrul snang la rang bzhin med pa sgrung gna' gtam sogs// sgam dang sgrom shing sogs kyi snod yin chung ba la sgam chung dang sgrom bu zer sgro ba pags snod rta sgro lta bu dang rlig pa sgye mo ras sogs kyi snod sgye'u sgye mo chung ba// sgyug mo chung ma'i ma'am zla bo'i mas sgo nga bya sgong ri'i sgog pa ki ru zos nas rgyags pas sgregs pa kha nas gsung pa// sdig pa mi dge ba de kho na nyid la sgrib par byed pa nyon shes kyi sgrib pa lta bu chu bo las sgrol ba rgal bar byed pa chos dang chu sogs kyi sgra rna yul sgrogs pa 'byin pa'am klog pa sgrogs shig pa yang*// bya yi sgro gshog pa sogs la yod pa spu lta bu bshad pa'i sgros tshul mchu sgros kha mchu gral sogs sgrigs shig pa ste mthun par byed pa// rgyab kyi sgal ba'i tshigs pa sgul ba ni skyod cing g.yo bar byed pa sga smug sga skya sga ser sge'u gsher sman sga rlon// sgren mo gcer bur go khang pa'i sgo rnam thar sgo gsum smra ba'i sgo thabs tshul sogs kyi drung du sgeg pa mdzes pa mo sgug pa ma yong bar du mi 'gro bar sdod pa phebs sgug zhu lta bu// rkang pa'i sgyid par gos sogs sgab pa 'gebs pa sgro gu dru bus sgrog pa 'ching ba// dbang du sgyur ba gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po dkar phyogs la dga' ba 'khor lo sgyur ba gling gcig gnyis sogs kyi rgyal po sgyur byed sgyur ba po// lag pa rgyal mtshan sogs sgreng ba gyen du slong ba zas zan sgong ba ril mor byed pa bu ram dang bzhes spro sogs sgor ba btsos pa'am bskol nas sra bar byed pa'i don yin nam snyam sgor cig pa yang*/

sgar gur tshogs stod sgar chos sgar dmag sgar sogs kyi nang du rta sogs la bstad rgyu'i gser dang ko ba sogs kyi sga yis sgron ma'i me snang byed sgrib pa mi mthong bar byed pa// srid sgrub skya bseng bu lnga'i ya gyal brgya byin gyi bu 'phags pa klu sgrub zab mo lta ba'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon sgrol ba ma rje btsun ma sgrub pa sgrub byed sgrub thabs sogs// mna' sgog pa mna' skyel ba sgyogs rdo 'phrul 'khor gyis 'phen pa'i rdo dang 'ur rdo me sgyogs sogs kyis sgu do lus smad 'ur rdo yod tshad gcog pa bcag pa// da sgos da cha sgos su sger du rtsig pa sgron pa kha gso ba rgyan sgron zhib sgron sogs// sgu stegs stegs bu dang sgog chos sgang pa mtho ba mdo khams sgang drug lta bu gshongs sa dma' ba tsha sgo ba tsha can// sgrob 'gying tshugs sam dregs pa'am mi chen gyi tshul byed pa dang sgrom gsob dang khog gam tshugs sgrom chen mgo sgrom lta bu dang sgrog sgongs sgrig sgrims sgrubs sgongs sgoms sgod sgre bo sgro 'dogs sgros gtsang rigs sgre sgres la sogs pa sar btags ga'o// (brga) brgal ba rgol ba brtsad cing brtag pa dpyad pa brgal ba brtsad pa'i lan rtsod lan brgyad cu dang brgyad grangs ka /phreng ba grangs brgya phrag gam tham pa skud par brgyus pa brgyu bas brgyan pa spras pa'am mtshan pa// chu brgal ba rgal ba 'o brgyal ba dka' las sam ngal dub dran pa med par brgyal ba 'khams pa rmongs pa// lung sogs brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'am gcig nas gcig tu 'brel ba lta bu lam gyi rgyags phye brgyags pa rgyags pa spyad pa spyo ba'i don gyi brgyad bkag ste brgyad pa dang rgyad pa'ang 'thad snyam// le brgan dar dmar gur kum tshos gad mo brgyangs pa ngar skad bton pa smra ba'i gtam brgya ba rdzun smra ba zhal brgya byas zhal ba rgyas zhes zhal shob gsungs pa// brgyugs pa chu sogs rgyug pa'i don yin par rtogs shing brgyungs pa gzhungs pa sgal ba'i klad par go brgyud ma bar ma chad par tho brgyab pa rgyab pa// brgyag brgyags brgyang brgyugs brgyab sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ga'o//

(bsga) bu ram sogs bsgar ba sgor zhing bsgrags pa grangs su bcug nas bsgongs pa sgong ba// rgya chos bod du bsgyur ba sgyur ba mdog dkar po dmar por bsgyur ba sgyur ba bka' gsung bsgo ba dang bsgos pa gnang ba bslab ston byed pa// chu sogs las bsgral ba sgrol ba chos sogs bsgrags pa sgrog pa zhi lhag gi ting 'dzin bsam gtan sogs bsgoms pa sgom pa// mgo bsgres pa mgo mtshungs byas pa rigs bsgres pa rigs 'gre byas pa rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs pa sgreng ba// mna' bsgags pa sgog pa lam sogs su bsgugs pa sgug pa seng ge lus bsgyings pa 'gying tshugs bstan pa// gnyis snang sogs kyi bag chags bsgo ba dang bsgos pa bzhag pa'am 'gos pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sgrig pa// sgron ma'i 'od sogs bsgribs pa sgrib pa blo rig sogs bsgrims pa sgrim pa srad bu skud pa bsgrims pa sgrim pa// sgrub pa dang bsgrub bya gnyis sgrub byed kyi yul bsgrun pa sgrun par mi nus// bsgrin pa sgrin pa 'gran par mi phod pa dang bya ba la 'jug pa'i bsgang bya ba'i dkyil lam byed bzhin pa// bsgyel ba sgyel zhing sgra skad bsgrags pa sgrog pa skar rtsis sogs su gnyis kyis gsum bsgyur bas drug lta bu sgyur ba// gzhan nam pha rol gyis mi bsgul ba mi g.yo ba mi sgul ba mi brdzib nor gyis bsgang pa phyug pa'am 'gengs pa// bsgre bsgreng bsgug bsgrag bsgrubs bsgangs la sogs bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ga'o// (nga) (dang) ༈ snyan pa'i dngags ni snyan ngag ste dpag khri sogs dang tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos kyang zil dngar bdud rtsi'am sbrang rtsi tshar du dngar ba gral du sgrig pa// gser rin chen dang po dang dngul rin chen gnyis pa dngom che rtsa chen rin thang che ba sogs dngos po 'dus byas sogs dngos po med pa 'dus byas su ma grub pa// mchog thun gyi dngos grub dngos gzhi ma gzhi'am rtsa ba mchod pa sogs dngos su bshams pa dngos ngom rgyu dngos dngos btags dngos shugs dngos ming sogs// dngangs pa sngangs pa skrag pa dngan 'then gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi sprod pa 'bab chu'i dngo chu ngogs sam chu kha// gcod byed gri yi dngo rno so dang ro dngar dngang ba sogs das 'phul nga'o//

(ngam) mnga' ris mnga' ris skor gsum dang 'bangs mnga' zhabs mnga' 'og chab 'bangs mnga' thang dbang thang mnga' ba yod pa'am gsal ba// mnga' mdzad dang mnga' bdag dbang po'am gtso bo mngag gzhug bran g.yog gam pho nya 'phrin mngags pa btang ba sogs// dbang po sogs kyi mngon sum tshad ma dang mngon sum du mthong dngos su mthong sogs mngon gyur rang mtshan dang yon tan sogs mngon du gyur pa mngon mtshan mngon gsal che ba bun skyed sogs mngal bu snod// mngon spyod drag las mnga' brnyes pa dbang thob pa mngan mi bgrang ba skyon mi brjod pa// dam chos mngon pa'i sde snod lha'i mig sogs kyi mngon par shes pa lnga'am drug mngar ba'i ro dngar ba yang 'thad// thugs la mnga' ba ldan pa yod pa gsal ba 'dzin pa mngar cha shing mngar yin par mngon mngag pa sogs mas 'phul nga'o// (rnga) ri dwags rngon pa po khyi ra ba'i ming rnga ma las byas pa'i bsil yab brdung bya'i rnga chen sogs rnge'u rnga chung // rngam pa zhes pa'i don bkres pa chags pa rngab pa ltogs pa chags pa rnga mo tsher mar dga' ba'i dud 'gro zhig rnge'u rnga mo chung ba'am rnga phrug /rngom brjid gzi brjid che ba'am ngo mtshar rngam pa khro ba'am 'jigs tshul pags nad rngo bag can za 'phrug can// dbugs dang chang sogs rngub pa 'then pa zug rngu zug gzer dang mde'us rngod mkhan sha sogs rngod pa po lus rngul ba dang rngul gzan rngul nag sogs// rngo yis khyer ba ham pas khyer ba dre'u rngog grum tse las kyi gla byis pa'i rngan pa gsol ras lta bu dang // rnga ma mjug ma rngog ma ze mthug po'i don can gyi rngam ste rngams kyang snang rngo mi thogs pa mi nus pa mi phan pa ngo mi tsha ba// rngan chan brnyas thabs sam mi rtsi ba rtswa sngon dang btsas ma rnga pa gcod pa rngu ma mig skyo'am mig skyag dang // rus kyi bye brag la 'jug pa'i rngog ste rngog lo chen po sogs dang rngom bag can rngos rngab rwa rngam po sogs rar btags nga'o//

(snga) zhal snga spyan snga'am klu'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad ces sam zhal nyid spyan lnga mig snga'am drung snga so mdun nam snga mar snga sor yang snang sngon ma snga ma sngon dus sngon 'gro /gsang ba'i sngags yid skyob pa'i don sngags pa sngags 'chang mdog mkha' ltar sngon po sngo ba sngon po'am sngon por byed pa// snga dro nyin phyed tshun sngas mgo gzhag sa la sngur ba gnyid sgra che ba// snga ma'i dus sngon dus skyo sngogs 'khrug long mon gyi sran ma snge'u sran chung zhig /snga ma dang phyi ma sngon rjes sngun sngon nam mdun du go sngo ba spel ba'am sbyin pa'am sgyur bar byed pa// mtshang skyon nas sngog pa 'bru ba kha sngog pa dang gzungs sngags smre sngags rnam par sngos shig sngogs shig sogs sar btags nga'o// (brnga) brngan pa mchod pa'am rngan pa ster yang brngams pa brngab pa ste ltogs pa'am chags nas btsas ma lo tog brngas pa rnga ba// bud med sogs brngod pa 'drid pa'am slu ba dang rngon pa gshor ba'am ri dwags gsod byed kyis brngon pa ri dwags bshar ba// chang sogs brngubs pa rngub pa dang brngo brngos brnga brngam brngub sogs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o// (bsnga) lus sems kyi sdug bsngal ba mi bde ba bstod pa'i don can gyi bsngags pa yon tan brjod pa bsngo bya'i dge bas bsngos pa sngo ba// rnam par bsngos pa sngon por gyur pa dang mtshang nas bsngog pa sngog pa dang bsngogs mdog bsngo sogs// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o/ / (ca) ༈ rgyu mtshan nam dgos pa ci'i slad dang ci'i phyir gnyis gang gi phyir ldan pa'i don ston byed kyi can te mig can rgyan can rgyu can lta bu dang khyed can khyod drung sogs// bdag cag nga cag kho bo cag nga tsho'am rang cag 'o skol spyi cer skra med spyi ther sum cu dang// drug cu dang bdun cu dang brgyad cu rnams grangs kyi khyad par// lhan cig dang thabs cig gnyis chabs cig mnyam po bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma sogs dus kyi tshad tsam// khyed cag khyed tsho khyod cag sems can sems ldan yod do cog yod tshad shes so cog yin no cog sogs dang 'dra cog kyang*// can ce can ne'am phor par go cab cob za ba'i sgra chang sogs co re rngub pa'i sgra'am blug pa'i sgra// ha cang shin tu'am thal che ba cas cus tshugs shor ba mi brtan pa mi drang ba bab col ma brtags pa'am byung rgyal mang // ci ste gal te'am ci phyir cung zad nyung zad phyin ci log pa yang dag min pa'am nor ba// cang ci yang shes pa ste mngon shes cig shos gcig po'am ngos bzung ba'i ya ste mkhas pa'i cig shos mi mkhas pa legs pa'i cig shos mi legs pa lta bu ci nas kyang gang nas kyang ngam nges par// co to dang co ni skra'i ming thor cog thor tshugs cod pan dbu rgyan dang // rgya cang ska rags kyi bye brag be con dbyug pa de lta ci smos ci bshad dam bshad ci dgos// ca co sgra'i tshogs sam ku co cal col bab col lam mi brtan pa'am gtam nyog mu cor don dang mi 'brel ba'i gtam mam rgyu mtshan ltar snang dang // co 'dri ba gnod pa'am 'gran pa cig car dus mnyam cam dal gyis 'jog pa// cog pu gur chung bar go car re bcar ba'i tshul mig ce re lta tshul dang ce re long lta bu// lan cig lan ma gcig tshar cig cis kyang gang gis kyang ngam ci nas kyang yul ci ru yang ma grub pas blos cir yang mi rtog gang du yang mi sems// kha cig 'ga' zhig cang gang yang mi shes kyang cong rol mo// cang gshang dang cang te'u ḍa ru chung ba ci yang gang yang brdung // smyug cu gang sogs sman zhig cung zhi cong zhu ste rdo sman zhig cur nis phye ma tsūr+ṣ+ṇa'i zur chag yin snyam kha la za// ce spyang gcan gzan khyi spyang brag ca sgra brnyan gyis ci zhig bya gang zhig bya dgos med dam mi nus// cog tse mdun cog la sogs par go tho co rtsing po ste tho co'i spyod pa spyod pa rtsing po lta bus cung peng changs bu cung peng ltar na thug pa kha la za/
ci ga ci zhig gam ci yin nam ji ltar dang klag cor ku co cag cag cing ces ce'o ce na cig 'dra cog la sogs pa ca rkyang ngo //

(gca) gros gcom pa gros byed pa gcong nad nad rnying gcad bya shing lta bu gcod pa 'thub pa 'dreg pa 'gog pa sel ba// khon gcugs pa yid mi mthun pa yid gcugs pa mdza' ba yid mthun pa gcen spun che ba sngon skyes dang gcung spun chung ba rjes skyes// gcud la bor ba gtan la phab pa 'dul ba lag pa yon por gcus pa sgril ba lta bu phug tu gcur ba 'jur ba 'dul ba'i don yin zhing gcun pa 'jun pa 'dul ba// mi ldan sogs rnam par gcod pa dgag pa yongs su gcod pa sgrub pa ste rnam gcod du sbrul yin pa bkag na yongs gcod du thag khra sgrub pa lta bu zhal lce khrims dang chad pa sogs gcod bzhin pa// gcong rong ngam grog gcong skad gcong nad can gyi skad dam gcong rong gi skad dam skad ngan gcin pa dri chu gci ba dri chu'am dri chu gtong ba lta bu// the tshom sogs gcod bzhin pa da lta ba 'jal bzhin pa yang gces 'dzin med pa gces spras dang gal che'am dgos lta bur yang gces 'jug phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bshad sogs// gcam bu bcos ma'i ngag gam bcos bstod dam bcos ma kha gcang kha snyan nam kha gsag gcugs pa mthun pa med pa gces dgos// tshar gcod pa 'pham par byed pa 'joms pa gcu gal do gal lam khag yid la gcags pa yid la 'jags pa// sgra gcan gza' zhig gcan gzan stag gzig sogs la gcan pa la tshugs pa'am la'i sho gam pa// phyogs gcig mtha' gcig gam logs shig tu gcal du bkram pa chal mar brdal ba grangs kyi khyad par gcig gnyis// bu ram dang snang sems sogs ro gcig pa khyad med pa rdzas dngos po'am rang bzhin gcig pa tha mi dad pa gcer bu sgron mo gcog pa bcag pa// gci'u ni chu sogs 'then gtong byed pa'i smyug sbubs lta bu yin la des bshang lam du gtong ba'i sman dang gcag gcom skyung kha tshon gcod nad gcod thag gcod sogs gas 'phul ca'o// (bca) bdud bzhi bcom pa 'joms shing yon tan drug dang ldan pa sangs rgyas nyon mongs sogs kyi dgra bcom pa 'khor dang bcas pa yod pa'am ldan pas zhabs kyis 'chag sar bcags pa mnan pa'am phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa// dam bca' ba khas len pa bsgrub bya khrims bca' ba bzo ba bcas pa bcing ba 'ching bas bcings pa bkyigs pa// shing sogs bcad pa gcod pa rlan gsher bcir ba btsir ba bcar yang snang bca' bya'i nas kyi yos sogs sos bcem pa bcag pa'am blad pa// tshigs su bcad pa tshig rkang bzhi sogs bca' ba bzo ba'i gzhi bka' yi zlas phye ba'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i gsung ngam 'chos skyob kyi cha nas bka' la'ang 'jug bcang ba lag tu 'chang ba// logs sam zur du bcar ba nye bar phyin pa sku bcar ram bcar sogs bca' sga sman sga bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga'i ro bcud bcud len dang bcud can lta bu// mig dang sgong sogs bcar ba btsir ba lta bu phyir phyi rol tu bcil ba bton pa'am spangs pa'am bsal ba chu bcu ba chu 'dren pa'am len par go bcug pa las la sbyar ba nang du bcug pa'ang*// nor dang bu lon sogs bcal ba 'jal ba lag pa bcangs pa bzung ba 'chang ba 'dod spyod kyi lag bcangs kyang chags bcag pa snam bu chu nang du mnyes pa las bcol ba las byed du bcug pa dang gtams pa'i bcol yang*// bcar ba rta ra'i ming rtar bcibs pa 'chib pa zhon pa zhal lce dang chad pa sogs bcad pa gcod pa// rgol ba tshar bcad pa gcod pa blos bcal ba 'jal ba shes pa'am rtogs pa bslab pa bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba bcabs pa gsangs pa 'chab pa// rdo sogs bcag pa gcog pa shing sogs bcer ba spungs pa gros bcom pa gros byas pa bcam yang snang bcum pa chung ngur btang ba// bcu dang bzhi bcu dang lnga bcu dang // dgu bcu dang bco lnga dang bco brgyad rnams grangs kyi khyad par bcos pa bzos pa phyir bcos nad bcos sogs// bcos bu bcos ma'i ras dang bcas bcos bcun bcur bcus bcab bco bcib sogs bas 'phul ca'o//

(lca) mnyen cing lcug pa mi gyong ba lcug phran yal ga gsar pa lcang ma shing rgya lcang la sogs pa'i lcag skul byed de thal lcag rta lcag skul lcag sogs// me tog sogs kyi mgo lcogs dud pa dang dog pa yin nam dpyad ches cher lci ba yang ba min pa blo yis lcogs pa khom pa'am nus pa// gnam kyi lcags dang lce 'bab pa gnyis thog gam rdo rje'i me me'i lce gyen du g.yo ba lta bur lceb pa rang gis rang srog 'dor bar byed pa chu sogs su lceb pa lta bu// lcang lo can gsang bdag gi gnas khyad par can gyi ming lcags kyi ri bo rgya mtsho'i mtha' nas bskor ba ste khang pa'i lcags ri sogs kyang mtshon lcog lcags ri sogs kyi steng du yod pa'i khang chung lta bu// nya lcibs nya phyis sam chu nang gi ral ba lta bu'i sngo sbal ba lce med lcong mo chu'i srog chags lcung ka bya skyung ka'i ming lce ro 'dzin sogs// re'u lcag shog rgyu'i sngo lca ba sman rtsa ba lnga'i ya gyal lcam pa sman nyi dga' lcum pa sman zhig /lag lcibs lag pa'i dri ma gzhan la mi 'go bar byed pa'i lag phyis tsha lcibs snod sogs tsha bas mi 'tshig par byed pa'i ras sogs sgo lcibs sgo yol lam sgo yi lcibs phur sogs dang // spyan lcibs mig spags sam mig shel lcam mo sring mo dral po ming po chos skyong lcam dral rtsa lcam dral lam zung skra lhas pa'i lcang lo ral ba lta bu dang lcang ma'i lo ma// dud 'gro'i lci ba lci bas 'byug lcib mer 'dud lta bu lcag pod ska rags shig srus lcag snye ma'i srus te srus cag kyang snang lcig pa rdung ba'am 'jal ba// tshig gi 'bru ma lcibs pa sgrig pa gshibs pa dang lcigs lcibs zhes pa 'dzin pa phyi ba skyob pa sgrig pa'i don yin snyam de lta bu sogs lar btags ca'o// (cha) ༈ chem chem sgra sgrog tshul lam 'od chags tshul chal chil chu rlabs kyi sgra lta bu chos 'dzin pa'i don te shes bya lam sogs chu nyal 'gro ma'am dag byed nam mkha'i char pa sprin gyis gtor ba'i chu sogs// chags pa dang bral ba dgra bcom sogs rnyed pa ji yod kyis chog pa rung ba'am 'grig par shes pa sems pa ste byed chog mi chog sogs kyang cho ga sgrub pa'am bya ba byed tshul la sogs pa'i don ched dgos pa'am dmigs bsal te dgos ched dam ched du byas dang byang chub la ched du 'bad lta bu// go cha ya lad mtshon cha gri mdung la sogs pa'i ming cha lugs cha byad chos shig pa ste bcos pa'i skul tshig yin// byang ba dag pa'am spangs pa'am sangs pa chub pa rtogs pa'am rgyas pa byang chub gsum dang khog chud pa yang bar chad bya ba'i bar du gcod pa bgegs sogs cham la phob cig tshar chod cig gam gtan la phob cig

/rin pa'am gong chen po rin po che ste sga ltar na dga' rgyas sam rang rigs kyi gtso bo'i don chun po 'phreng ba'am bam po chabs cig thabs cig phyogs gcig chur cig ces gcur ba dang dul ba'i skul tshig gam chur ba dul ba chur ba shong ba// chu srid dam dkyus zheng kha che chung sogs kyi cha mnyam pa cha mthun pa'am cha mtshungs chem me ba 'od 'bar tshul lam sgra sgrog tshul// chibs pa bzhon pa cha zung de chibs shig ches pa zhon cig la 'jug ste bcibs pa'i skul tshig chogs shig bcags pa dang snam bu bcag pa'i skul tshig /srog dbang chags pa gnas pa'am ldan pa chag chag btab pa ste sa la chu gtor nas rdul mi ldang bar byed pa chal ma thang mar brdal ba bkram pa// cho lo sho dang gos zhig dang sngo cho los che ge mo gang zag gi spyi ming la 'jug pa'i brda cha rkyen mthun rkyen chad pa bar ram rgyun chad pa// khrims kyi chad pa bka' nyes lus chad rgyu chad sogs kyis chod cig gcod pa'i skul tshig yin la chung ma khyim 'dzin ma'am mdza' mo chol cig nor bcol ba dang sems 'chol ba'i skul tshig /chang chems chang khang dang chang bzi rgya sogs che ba yangs pa chung ba nyung ba lta bu thugs su chud pa don rtogs pa bar du chud pa phrad pa gnas su chud pa shong ba// mthar chags rim pa snam bu chags su chogs shig bcag pa'i skul tshig chir gyis bcir tshul chir cig bcir ba'i skul tshig /chab 'og mnga' 'og chom po jag pa'am rkun ma ches cher shin tu thal ches pa lta bu yang chun cig gcun pa dang dul ba'i skul tshig /choms shig bcom pa'i skul tshig dgra choms pa dgra dul ba chings shig bcings pa'i skul tshig dang mdud chings chings sgrig chings ma 'ching byed kyi thag pa lta bu chab sgo khang ba'i sgo chog cig gcog pa'i skul tshig dang cho ga bsdus pa'i grong chog sngon chog da chog sogs dang ma chog pa ma tshang ba// rgol ba tshar chod cig gcod pa'i skul tshig gros sogs kyi thag chod cig gcod pa'i skul tshig thag chod pa nges pa rnyed pa chab srid kyi 'og mnga' 'bangs chug cig bcug pa'i skul tshig dang yin du chug yin du rung*// cha cho don rtsad ma chod pa ha ma go ba cha rgyus med pa chas pa song ba cha ba 'gro ba rtsom pa// zan la chang gi ro bro ba yod pa'i kha zas shig 'bras dang nas sogs kyi chan 'bras sogs btsos pa chab chu chab gtor chab bran nas chus shig lag gcus dang chu bcu ba'i skul tshig

/cha lang rol mo mal cha nyal chas sogs che zhe sring mo che ba'am phu mo'i ming chas cha lugs// cho 'brang ma'i rus te rigs kyi don chud zos pa chud gsan pa cham pa 'go ba'i nad cig /chab shog bka' shog gam spring yig gam shog bu kha zhal chems 'chi pos smras pa'i 'phrin chig rkyang gcig pu chong zhig bcang pa'i skul tshig /bag shul lam cung zad chags pa gnas pa'am nyal ba bod skad kyi nges tshig 'di ltar 'thad dam dpyad sgra ltar na rjes su nyal ba'am gnas pa'i don cho 'phrul rdzu 'phrul lta bu cho nge ngud mo 'don pa ngu ba// cha ga pa dbyar dus su sgra dang bcas te cung zad 'phur nus pa'i srog chags phra mo zhig dang chab chob chen ma chun ma dogs chod cha shas go chod pa chag changs chub chungs la cha rgyan cha ches sogs cha rkyang ngo*/ / (mcha) mchog rmad byung ngam mtho ba'am rab tu go skyabs su mchi ba 'gro ba'am yong ba mchis pa dkon pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun gsum mchod pa bstod pa 'bul ba bzhes pa bkur ba// mchis pa gnas pa'am 'dug pa'i mal gnas dug sbrul gyi mchil ma rtsa sngon la gos pa las skyob pa'i rkang lham ste lham spyir yang go mchig rang 'thag sogs kyi mas gtun mchig gu yas gtun// sku las mched pa skyes shing 'phel ba'i zla bo ste spun zla dang grogs mched rdo rje'i mched po sogs kyang mchan dpung 'og gam nye 'gram gyi don mchis brang chung ma rgyan gyis mchor pa mdzes pa gzabs mchor mchor po mchor chas// mchi ma mig chu'am spyan chab mchil ma kha chu'am ljags mchil mcher pa sngon po dang mchin pa dmar po gnyis don lnga'i khyad par// zhal lam kha'i mchu sgros gnyis kar go kha mchu kha'i yas mas kyi mchu'am 'khrug pa'i don bka' mchid 'bel gtam mam spring yig mchid ces pa gtam mam bshad pa mchis pa yod pa'am song ba// rnam shes tshogs drug skye zhing mched par byed pa mig dang gzugs sogs bcu gnyis lta bu mching bu mdog sna tshogs shing ljid med pa'i nor bu phal pa rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i mching dkyil lam dbus// rtswa mchog ku sha'am rtswa yi rtse mo me mched pa 'bar ba'am 'phel ba mchil pa byi'u nas zan nam 'dab chags bcu gcig pa'i don mchongs pa rtsal gyis 'phags pa'am 'phar te 'gro ba// gzhu yi mchog ma ni rtse mo sgyu ma mkhan la sogs pa'i mchan bu slob bu mchan bu gzhung gi dkyus dang nye bar don gsal byed kyi yig chung*// mchil pa lcags kyu mchims rus kyi bye brag dang bsam yas mchims phu dang mche ba mchod bya'i mchu sogs mas 'phul cha'o//

('cha) chos gzhan la 'chad pa bshad pa khrims sogs 'cha' ba bca' ba zhabs kyis sam rta sogs 'chag pa'i sa der 'chag pa bcags pa/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir tshul khrims ltar 'chos pa sogs 'chos pa bcos pa ste nyon mongs 'chos nad 'chos rgyud 'chos lta bu gar 'chams pa 'khrab zin pa srog dbang 'chad pa 'gag pa rgyud 'chad pa cha rkyen 'chad pa sogs kyang 'chi ba srog 'dor ba dang me mnal ba sogs// 'dod pa la 'chums pa chags pa'i don gnas 'cha' ba 'dug sa bzo ba 'chel pa zhen pa'i don yin par snang 'chur ba gnas su gcur ba// 'chal pa gtad so med pa'am mi brtan pa'am khungs med pa'i don shes rab 'chal ba tshul 'chal 'chal bo sogs sems kyi 'char ba'i sgo 'char tshul lam dran tshul mi 'chags pa sdig pa mi bshags pa 'chab pa bcabs pa'am sbed pa// nyi ma dang dus sogs 'char ba shar ba'am yod pa'am 'byung ba ste 'char ka 'char lo sogs chu sogs 'chor ba rtol ba'am shor ba las ka gzhan la 'chol ba bcol ba'am byed du 'jug pa nor rdzas 'chol ba yang 'chun pa stobs kyis gcun pa// gros 'choms pa 'dun gros byed pa kha yis 'che ba khas len pa'am zhal bzhes 'ching ba bcings pa'am 'khyig byed kyi zhags pa 'chang ba bcang ba'am 'dzin pa// gtam 'chol ba 'khrul ba dang go rim 'khrug pa dang 'chus pa yo ba'am 'khyog pa yid ka 'chus sogs dang khas 'ches kha 'cham 'chams 'cham 'cham 'gro 'chag pa rus pa dang khyab mtha' dang dam 'cha' gar gyi 'cham dang 'chal ba sogs 'as 'phul cha'o// (ja) ༈ chos nyid dam gnas tshul ji lta ba phyin ci ma log pa'am dpe'i sgra yin chos can nam snang tshul ji snyed pa ji tsam mam thams cad ji lta ba bzhin yang dag par gzigs pa mig gis lta ba'am shes pa// ji ltar gang ltar ram dpe sgra ji srid dus ji tsam mam dus tshad 'dri ba ji skad ji lta ba'am ji ltar 'di ltar smra// jo jo jo lags sam phu bo'i don jo mo btsun mo'am gsang yum mam gtso mo jo bo gtso bo ste jo bo shākya mu ni lta bu dang rje'u rigs kyi rje bo'i don yang ja ljon 'dab cig ste rgya ja bod ja lta bu// je zhig re zhig gam go rim ston pa'i sgra jag pa chom rkun rngu bo rdob 'phangs pa/

ja hong dmar ser ja ril thod pa zhig gam ja 'dab ril bur byas pa je 'thor song ba rim gyis mtho bar gyur pa je rgyas je rgyas je bzang je bzang sogs/ je ni dang po'i don dang je dbyangs kyi don dang je zhes pa ci gang sogs ltar spyi khyab kyi sgra ste ji yod ji legs ji ldan ji lta bu sogs dang ja ma sogs ja rkyang ngo // (mja) mjal ba thug pa'am 'phrad pa lus kyi mjing pa ske dang mjug ma rnga ma lus mjug las mjug mjug bsdu mje pho mtshan nam 'doms mjug /mi mjed pa bzod pa ste nyon mongs bzod pa'i sems can 'byung ba'i zhing dang mjal bgo ba'am mthong ba dang mjal kha sogs mas 'phul ja'o// ('ja) 'jag ma rtswa'i bye brag 'ji ba dang 'jim pa gnyis 'dam gyi ming 'jags pa gnas pa'am bcags pa'am brtan pa yid la 'jags pa khris 'jags pa// 'jig rten phung po lnga'am 'khor ba 'jig pa 'gag pa'am nyams pa'am bshig pa'am zhig pa'i don 'jigs pa skrag pa 'joms pa bcom pa'am nyams par byed pa// 'jus pa 'dzin pa'am rgyab pa'am bsnun nas sha dang shing sogs gris 'jog pa gzhog pa phra mor byed pa 'jar ba bcar ba'am nye bar phyin nas 'jabs pa gab pa'am gsang ba'am ma tshor ba// 'ja' ba zhum pa nyams pa zha ba rkang lag sogs 'jas pa'i don yin zhing 'jungs pa ser sna'i don skyon dang dri ma sogs 'jil ba bcil ba sel ba 'joms pa 'jem pa mkhas pa'am legs pa'am 'thad pa// 'ju ba khyi zhig khrag sogs 'jib pa mchus 'then pa zas sogs 'ju ba zhu ba'am bzhu ba 'jang ba 'khru ba'am yul zhig /'jud pa 'gro bar mthun pa ma smad 'tshong ma 'jol 'jol gos ring bo'i dbyibs sogs 'jol ba ring ba 'jol po yod 'jo ba yid 'phrog gam 'dren cing sgeg pa dga' ba 'phel ba'i rnam 'gyur 'jog pa 'god pa sgrub byed gsal byed gtong ba sa la gzhag pa sogs// 'jor bu tog rtse dbyibs 'jong mo 'jong 'jong sgo nga lta bu 'jur ba gcur ba'i don yin zhing 'jun pa gcun pa// lus sogs 'jam pa mnyen pa rtsub min 'jog pa po klu rgyal zhig mtsho 'jing dkyil dbus 'jug pa 'gro ba zhugs pa bcug pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs ye shes me long snyan pa la 'jug pa'i 'jebs pa ste yid du 'ong ba dang mdzes pa dang legs pa yang ting 'dzin sogs la mnyam par 'jog pa gzhag pa// mngon rjes kyi blo tshad mas 'jal ba bcal ba dpog pa ring thung sogs kyi tshad 'jal ba khru bre srang gis 'jal ba bcal ba 'dod pa 'jo ba ster ba'am 'byung ba 'o ma 'jo ba yang*// khrims 'jags khrims ji ltar bsgrags pa ltar gnas pa 'ja' sa rgya nag gi go sa zhig 'ja' mo khral dang yul zhig dang // 'ja' brdeg khang pa'i rtsig skyor ram 'degs byed kyi rten 'ja' tshon dbang po'i gzhu srad bu skud pa la sogs pa'i 'jur pa 'jur bu 'jur gong sgrim ches nas mdud pa ltar gyur pa dang 'jur mig kyang*// srod dus kyi 'jing srod dkyil sha dang sems sogs 'jums pa sha rid pa'am zhum pa'am dman par byed pa rtsa 'jing ni gnyen nam rtsa lag yin// thob kyis 'jal ba rnyed phyir gzhan la mngon sum smod pa ste log 'tsho lnga'i gcig dang 'jab bu 'jibs pa 'ju 'jen sogs 'as 'phul ja'o//

(rja) rje btsun gco bo ste dad sgrol gyi don rjes su 'jug pa rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje phyag mtshan dang pha lam sogs mi phyed pa'i don rjes rtags sam shul lam mtshan ma rkang rjes sogs// rje dpon gtso bo'am dpon po lha rje 'tsho byed sman pa rjed pa bkur sti'am mchod pa'i 'os// sa rjen pa sa rlon nam sa sgren sha rjen pa sha rlon nam sha sgren rjen pa sgrib byed sogs med pa'i don rjen ne yang rje ngar rkang pa'i ngar gdong rdzud pa rid pa'am rgud pa// brjod bya'i don rjod par byed pa ming tshig brjod pa snying thugs rje brtse ba duḥkha 'bral bar 'dod pa'i don lag pa'i rjes phyag rjes gzhan phan gyi lag rjes sogs dang*// thugs rje snying rjes rjes su bskyangs pa sogs yongs su skyong ba rje'u'i rigs rigs bzhi'i gcig /til gyi dang nas sogs kyi rjang pa bang ba'am 'khor dang rje bo rjes ma rjed byed rjen phye rje ba sogs ra btags ja'o// (brja) brjed ngas mi dran par brjed pa brjed byed gdon zhig gzi brjid gzi byin nam 'od dam zil lam nus pa brjid pa 'bar ba'am mdzes pa// brje ba dang brjes pa bdag gzhan sogs rje ba ma brjed pa dran pas ma bskyud pa brjod bya bshad bya'i don sogs brjod pa bshad pa'am gtam gyi ming dang*// brjid chags rngom brjid sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o// (lja) yul gyi ljongs gnas sam yul sde ljang bu ljang pa smyu gu'i don ljan ljin mi gtsang ba nyal nyil khrod// ljon pa'i shing rkang 'thung ljid ces pa lci ba'i don dang lci yang gi ljid lta bu sman skye ba'i ljongs yul lam gnas ljang gu kha dog gi khyad par// ro drug 'dzin pa lce la 'jug pa'i ljags dang ljags mdud ljags rtsom ljags lung ljon pa sogs lar btags ja'o// (nya) ༈ nyams myong cha'am myong ba'am nus pa'am rang bzhin nam ro ste sgom nyams rang nyams nyams can sgeg nyams sogs rtogs pa shes pa nying yang khu khu ba'i yang khu ba'am khu ba'i khu ba ste nying 'khrul nying lag sogs kyang sgra don sbyor nyag ma rkang ngam rdog ma zegs ma gcig bu nyab pa lag pas len pa'am reg pa'am 'dzin pa// nya ma slob ma nyag mo a phyi'am bud med nyis 'gyur nyis ldab nyis brgya nyis ldan sogs nyung ba nyung ngu nyung zad// spu dang skra sogs nyag ma rkang ngam rdog ma nyal nyil ljan ljin nya yi lto za ba pa lū hi ba dang nya pa sogs// nyam thag cing nyes par gyur pa ste nyes skyon kun nas nyon mongs pa ngal bar byed pa ste nyon mongs las skye ba'am tshe'i kun nyon gsum dang dka' las sam 'o brgyal nyam nga ba nyam thag par go nye ba thag ring min pa dang yod pa dang mtshungs pa// nying sha bsad pa'i nyin gyi sha 'am nye du'i sha'i ming nyod pa zas sam kha nyod pa nyes pa skyon 'byung ba nyen gyong ngam nye ba'am mnar ba// nyam chung ba dang nyam thag pa gnyis 'khos chung ngam stobs chung nyin mo nyi ldan gyi dus mtshan mo zla ldan gyi dus nyal ba gnyid log pa'am gnas pa// nyams su dga'i ba yid dga' ba'i don nying dgos dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'am dgos pa'i dgos pa'am dgos pa'i gtso bo'am ched du bya ba ste gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nying dgos nye ba thag mi ring ba'am legs par go nyon cig ste rna bas nyon kha la nyon lta bu// spos dri'i byug pa nyug pa 'byug pa lag nya ster mkhan med par len pas chos sangs rgyas las nyan cing gzhan la thos par byed pa nyams pa mi mthong ba rgud pa lhung ba mnar ba mi nus pa// pho nya bang chen nam pho mo'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan pho nya mo sogs nyi ma nyin byed dang nyi ma'i gnyen dang nyi 'od la sogs pa'i don nyen kor nye 'khor du go

/nya ser mig mi 'dzum pa'i sha māṃs nya ga 'jal byed dam tshad nyi shu grangs ka nyos pa rin gyis nyo ba dang nyos shig kyang*// nying tor nges par mtha' gcig chu sogs nyog pa mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba nye bar reg pa ste khrus kyi khyad par nyang rus shig dang yul zhig dang ro myong la yang bshad// nye ba'am drung na gnas pa ste slob ma sogs nyug rum btsun mo'i 'khor rlig phyung nyan cing rna gtod pa pho nya sogs nyid kho na nges gzung gi sgra'am tshig phrad de gzhan ldan sogs gcod pa'i sgra// nyag phran mda' nya rgyas zla ba nya gang ba dang nyar ma nyag phra bka' nyes byas nyes nyes ltung bag nyal nyungs sogs nya rkyang ngo // (gnya) rgyab dpung gi gnyen pa rtsa lag ste mgon skyabs dge ba'i bshes grogs kyi gnyen pa nye ba ste bla ma sogs gnyis grangs kyi khyad par gnyen pa phan byed nye du rtsa lag /gnya' bar dgal ba'i shing rgyab khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gnya' shing gang tsam lta bu gnyer pa don nam rdzas gnyer mkhan khro ba'i gnyer ma dang rgas pa'i gnyer ma sogs dang // bka' gnyan pa'am po bka' btsan pa'am po gnyan bur sogs kyi nad dang gnyan kha yang dud 'gro'i bye brag gnyan zhes pa ri dwags shig /gnya' bo dpang po don du gnyer ba 'dun cing 'jug pa'am len pa gnyan dang gnyags dang gnyos 'di gsum rus ming ste gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra gnyos kha rag sgom chung lta bu// gnyid dbang po nang du sdud pa gnyid mthug lta bu dang nyal ba gnyis kyi ming gnyen po spong byed dam 'joms byed zhi byed gnon byed la sogs par 'jug gnya' ba ske'i rgyab cha ltag pa rke rgyab kyi steng cha dang gri ltag ltag chu gnyul ba 'tshol ba'am so bcugs pa'am bya ra byed pa// gnyi ma nyi ma'i gzer zer gnyig gcig tu lus sogs gnyong ka stobs sam sran chung // gnya' ba rengs pa lang shor ram dred pa'am gyong ba gnye ma nang khrol rgyu ma zhig nyag po dma' mor gnyag pa dma' bar byed pa'am za ba'i don gnyeg ltar na dma' ba nyid// gnyug ma ma bcos pa so ma rang bzhin rnal ma gnas lugs gnyug sems gnyug gnas la sogs pa'i don dang gnyig gnyis ka sogs gas 'phul nya'o//

(mnya) mnyan pa gru pa'am skya ba 'dzin pa thugs sems mnyes pa dgyes pa'am dga' ba rna bas sgra mnyan pa nyan pa// mnyed pa dang mnyes pa gnyis 'phur ba 'dzoms pa rdung ba sbrus pa mnyen par byed pa shing sogs mnyen pa snyi ba 'jam pa dul ba mnyan du yod pa gnas kyi khyad par zhig ste 'dir ston pa lo nyer bzhi bzhugs// ting 'dzin la mnyam pa mtshungs par gzhag pa 'jog pa mnyam pa 'dra ba'am zla med pa mtshungs pa'i don can gyi mnyam pa skyon yon ring thung lci yang sogs mnyam pa// ra mnye sman rtsa ba lnga'i gcig yid mnyes pa'am snyi zhing gshin pa ste mdza' ba'am grogs dang zhan pa'i mnyam pa mnyel ba sogs mas 'phul nya'o// (rnya) 'dam dang chu sogs kyi rnyog ma nyog ma mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba dang 'dam gyis rnyog pa rnyed pa nor rdzas dang 'thob pa bkur sti rjed pa'am mchod pa'am dam par byed pa'i don gsar pa'am so ma rnying pa'am ma yun lon pa'i dngos po rnyed pa 'thob pa// so yi rnyil so'i sha rnyang ma mi gtsang ba'am rlag mo rnyong 'khru ba dang gal dang rlag mo dang rnyi ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rgya// lcang lo sogs tsha bas rnyid pa rnyis pa rlon kyang min par skam shas ldan pa ma rnyob pa lag pas ma snyob pa an+da rnyil rin chen dbang sngon te in+d+ra nī la'i zur chag /rkang pa dang lag pa rnyong pa rkyong ba dang dku ma rnyongs rnyogs sogs rar btags nya'o// (snya) go snyod sngo sman zhig snying po sra ba brtan pa gtso bo sba ba rnam g.yeng rang bzhin snyid mo pha'i sring mo'am zhang po'i chung ma'i don snying nang khrol zhig gam sems// spu snyol ba khro ba skyung ba chang myos 'gyur snyol ba nyal du 'jug pa'am bsnyal ba dang snyol cig snye ma 'bru dang 'bras bu'i dog pa 'bru phung dang ri rtse snyil ba 'joms pa bshig pa zhig pa skrod pa dang snyil cig /tha snyad ming ngam shes brjod 'jug pa'i yul lam kun rdzob ji snyed ci tsam de snyed de tsam snyam pa sems pa'am rtog pa'am ltar// snyems pa nga rgyal dang skul tshig dang snyun pa nad dman pa dang skul tshig med dgag tshig snyan shal rna rgyan nam rna shal lam snyan dar snyi ba 'jam pa'am rgya'am dwags po'i rus// cha snyoms par 'jug pa dgu sogs mnyam par gzhol ba'o chags sdang bde sdug 'du byed mi byed btang ba spangs nas snyoms pa mnyam par byed pa ste bar ma'am spang blang med pa'am nyon mongs med pa sogs snyom las le lo'i bye brag bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa dang // mchog dman bar ma'i bsod nams snyoms pa mnyam par byed pa ldom bu'am slong mo snyugs yun nam rgyun srings ring ba'am byos shig dang snyugs tsha snyugs grang yang rjes su snyeg pa 'jug pa'am 'gro ba'am 'brang ba'i sar snyogs shig snyeg pa'i skul tshig gam grub mtha' snyogs pa yang*/

snying rje thugs rje'am cung zad dam snying sdug lta bu'i ming snyim pa khyor ba do'i tshad dam thal mo snyobs shig lag pas snyob pa'i skul tshig snyoms la 'jug min dpyad snyes pa sngas sogs la nyal 'phres byed pa// snyon mongs nyon mongs sam nyon mongs par byed pa snyad ka skyon nam khag 'dogs pa btags pa rgyal mtshan sogs snyol ba bsnyal ba'am skyel ba// gtam rna bar snyan pa 'jebs pa'am rna ba snyigs ma tshigs ma'am rnyog ma'i dus dang snyigs shig skud pa gtam zas snyod pa ring du gtong ba 'chad pa zas kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blad pa lta bu// snyang snyogs byed pa nyag nyag byed pa'am rmugs pa lta bu yin nam sems snyoms pa mnyam par byed pa'am 'bring ngam bde bar gnas pa dang snyom gcin snyi snyul snyung snyig snyob snyen snyer snyug snyor sogs sar btags nya'o// (brnya) me long gi gzugs brnyan pa'am po g.yar ba'am po dang tshab sgra brnyan yang de bzhin te brag ca gzhan la brnyas pa rngan chan byas pa dang brnyas thabs// mnga' dbang brnyes pa thob pa phyag brnyan lag g.yar ram tshab ste g.yog 'khor brnyan po g.yar po'i don brnyas pa g.yas pa'am g.yar ba// gos sogs brnyings pa rnying ba kha brnyogs pa kha 'dris pa'am lang shor dang chu rnyog snang brnyan sku 'dra'am 'dra cog bsnyan pa g.yar ba brnyang ltar na rnyong ba dang brnying brnyog brnya sogs// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o// (bsnya) dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas dang bsnyen rdzogs te spang bya lnga brgyad thams cad spong bar mnos pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yin bsnyen pa nye ba phyi ma la rdzogs bsnyen du yang 'gyur bsnyen pa bsten pa nye bar byas pa 'grogs pa// bsnyon can bsnyon mkhan bsnyon dor ming tsam dang bsnyon btsugs pa bsnyon tol ming tsam ste bsnyon pa yin pa la min pa'am min pa la yin par brjod pa dang // bsnyen pa dang nye ba'i bsnyen pa bsgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag bzhi lta bu bsnyen cing bkur ba zhabs tog sogs phye ma zhib mor bsnyil ba snyil ba 'thag pa// gtam bsnyad pa snyod pa bshad pa bsnyams pa snyoms pa mnyam par byas nas lag pa bsnyal ba bsnyul yang snang ste bkrus pa'i don// phyir phyi rol du bsnyil ba bskrad pa'am bton pa mal du bu sogs bsnyal ba snyol ba lhung bzed bsnyigs pa snyig pa snyigs mar byas pa'am lhung bzed gdams pa'i lhag mar byas pa// lag pas bsnyabs pa snyob pa reg pa bsnyung ba na ba'am nad kyi gzhi yis bsnyun pa snyun pa na bar 'gyur ba'am na zin pas bsnyengs pa 'jigs pa// bsnyel pa brjed pa med pa nas dang nyes can bsnyor ba snyor ba rdung ba'am bshig pa yo byad spyad dngos bsnyungs pa snyung du btang ba// bsnyen pa nye ba'am nye bar byed pa sring ba ring ba'am ring bar byed pa zas bsnyod pa snyod pa kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blad pa lta bu dang byin pa'am gso ba skyu gang mtshon gang bsnyug pa skyugs pa'am 'byug pa// bsnyems pa snyems pas rjes su bsnyegs pa snyeg pa khro ba'i gnyer ma bsnyer ba bsdus pa'am bstan pa dang bsnyeg bsnyig pa bsnyang bsnyags bsnyam bsnyab rjes bsnyags kyang snang bsnyem sogs// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya'o//

(ta) ༈ te por sra ba dam pa drag pa shin du legs par ti se gangs rir go tal ma de ma thag pa'am ma thogs par go song bzhud// dzā ti sman gyi khyad par sna ma tang kun sngo go snyod 'dra zhing dri zhim can tig ta ti k+ta'i zur chag ste sum tig sogs til dkar nag til la snum lta bu// tug tug dang tong tong dang tog tog ces pa'i sgra byung na de dang de zer// tel pa ste'u dang me tel tog rtse 'jor bu dbyug to dbyug pa'am phyag mtshan zhig dang // dbu yi gtsug gtor spyi tor thor to thor tshugs spyi tor gtsug tor tog dpal te rtse mo phud mchog dang sgra zhig kyang*// mu tig rin chen zhig muk+ti'i sgra nyams pa me tog pad+ma sogs sam bsod snyoms sam zla mtshan tam+bu la zas shig gam so rtsi// lo tog lo thog rtsi tog rtswa thog za ma tog rin chen gyi snod dam mngar cha'i snod dam ga'u// ting nge 'dzin pa mnyam par 'dzin pa rdo rje lta bu sogs mdo dkon mchog ta la la sgron me'i don yin// ting lo zan kong tal cung zad dam yid tsam tig tig nges nges med// yon tan skyon min dge ba legs pa khe dang lci yang sogs zhabs tog bsnyen bkur ram drin can la phan pa nan tan do gal lam nan tar ram brtson pa dang // nan tur khrims kyi chad pa'am chad las gal te gal srid brtag pa mtha' gzung gal te na go'u ta ma rigs rgyud kyi khyad par ram thub pa// kha ton kha 'don gyi ming tsam zhal ta kha ta'am bran g.yog nan tar ni bzang po dang nan tan// ta zig kla klo'i yul zhig ta ming rgya nag gong ma ta ming lta bu ta zhes pa rgya nag gi skad de chen po'i don te tā'ang snang ta'i si tu dang*// tī shri dang ta dben dang ta hung bzhi rgya nag gi go sa'i ming dang phyi ma dar dmar la'ang 'jug pa dang / tā ra ṇa rta babs te gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i phyi na yod pa'i ka ba rgyan can sogs dang te'u shang shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri// tam bu ra sgra snyan nam rgyud mang dang ting yon chab kyi snod ting shag rol mo zhig ting shags kyang snang*// nyo ti dang ta la gnyis shing gi bye brag tres sam phye ma'i ming zhang zhung gi skad dang // shang shang te'u bya shang shang chung ngu'am phrug gu te te brdung bya'i rnga brdung // 'on tang 'on kyang yin mod ling tog mig sgrib byed dang 'on te ta thā ga ta gal ta su ga ta tur gyis dran lhag bcas kyi te sogs ta rkyang ngo //

(gta) gtan nam gzhag rgyun gyi don bsam pa dmigs yul la gtan du bar gnas pa gtan du gnas pa las mi 'da' bar byed pa'i tshigs mtshams su gyur pa sgrub byed dam rtags sogs gtam brjod pa gtam pa bshad pa// gtun bu mas gtun lag pa la sogs par gtad pa gtod pa byin pa bkal ba phog pa gzir ba mthu gtun shing yas gtun gtubs pa dum bur 'thub pa// brdung gtag rdung 'tshog gtong ba rgyab pa'am sbyin pa dang gtang rag legs 'bul gtang pa sbyin pa// gter 'byung gnas sam nges par 'dzin pa mdzod nor khang yongs su gtams pa gang ba bcol ba gtad pa bshad pa gtor ma 'byung gtor sogs zan dang chu me tog gtor ba 'thor ba bkram pa kha 'thor du 'jug pa// bu lon len pa'i nor gyi gta' ma dang gteng pa dang gta' gsum bu lon gyi tshab lta bur bzhag pa'i dngos po// gtan pa sgo gtan nam sgo glegs kyis bkag pa med pa'i sbyin pa bar ma chad pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang gtang ba gnyis ster ba 'dor ba glod pa rgyab pa// gtum po khro rngam can nam gdol ba'i don zhabs rkang pa la spyi bos gtugs pa reg pa'am thug par byed pa'am bsten pa zad pa'i don can gyi gtugs pa 'dzangs pa klas pa thug pa yang*// lha chen la go ba'i gtogs 'dod dbang phyug gzhan la rdzas sogs gtod pa gtad pa// 'bem mda'i dmigs yul lta bu la gtod pa gtad pa gzir ba dang bsgom byar dmigs pa bsam pa gtod pa gtad pa rtse gcig tu sems pa dang gtod cig kyang*// gti mug ma rig pa rmongs pa gtol cha rgyus gdeng nges pa thabs med mtshang skyon nas gtol ba 'bru ba// khrag gtar ba gtsag pa 'don pa chu dang snum gtigs pa thigs pa 'bas tu 'jug pa se gol gtogs pa rgyab pa// nor bcol ba'i don la 'jug pa'i gtams pa gdams pa dang grangs kyi khyad par gtams dkrigs// sgo'i gtan pa gdan bu'am sgo 'phar gting dbus kyi mtha' 'am dkyil zab mo dpag dka' ba mun pa dang sprin sogs gtibs pa bkrigs pa tshogs pa// gtur bu snam sbyar sogs kyi snod spos reng sogs gtul ba sbar ba'am bdug pa ri bo la sogs pa'i gtos che chung gi tshad dam bong*// mgo bo sogs gtums pa g.yogs pa mtha' la gtugs pa zad pa thug pa bkag pa bkar ba khongs phyogs su gtogs pa 'the ba 'dus pa brlan pa// gtan du gnas pa la 'bebs pa don gnas dang mthun par byed pa dang gtum mo gtar kha gti thug gtong ba sogs gas 'phul ta'o//

(bta) bya sgro mda' la don du med kyang sbyar ba ltar med pa la yod par btags pa sbyar ba bzhag pa 'dogs pa ming btags pa brda'am tha snyad sbyar ba 'dogs pa kha btags lha reg gam dar dang pham par byas pa btags pa g.yogs pa bcings pa brgyan pa 'dogs pa// spyir btang ba dmigs kyis ma bsal ba'am thun mong du btang ba'am thun mong blo sogs kyis btang ba gtong ba dor ba sngags me tog btu ba dang tshad ma mngon pa bslab pa mdo kun las btus pa gnyis 'thu ba sdud pa// srol btod pa lugs ka dod du 'jug pa'am 'dzugs pa gdan dang gzhi bting ba 'dings pa 'grems pa rkyong ba 'dzugs pa sa bon skyed byed kyi rgyu btab pa 'debs pa rgyab pa// btang bzung ni klu zhig dang ri btang bzung gis don gnyis la go bteg pa 'debs pa gyen du slong ba 'jal ba 'gro ba gsol ba zhu ba btab pa phul ba 'debs pa btud pa 'dud pa dgu ba'am phyag 'tshol ba// btags so tha ga pa'i 'thad spyad kyi bye brag rgyas btab pa rtags kyis mtshan pa bza' bya'am bza' ba zas btung bya'am btung ba skom btub pa bla'am rung ba dang gtubs pa// me tog dang spu btogs pa 'thog pa 'then nas tha dad du byed pa rtsa ba sogs bton pa 'don pa 'byin pa bkog pa bkol ba btags pa phye dang thag 'thag par shes dgos shing btul ba bkol ba'am las su rung ba dang pham par byas pa 'dul ba// mgrin pa gyen du bteg pa sgreng ba 'degs pa dang btog btag btang snyoms sbyin btang bya btang sogs bas 'phul ta'o// (rta) mi dgag tshig rtag pa brtan pa 'gyur med rgyun pa mi nyams pa rang bzhin zad med rgyu mi 'chad mnyam nyid rtab rtab brel brel tshabs tshabs skrag tshul rtab rtab po yang sbyar dbang po rtul ba mi rno ba brtul ba dang rtul po rtags skyos ma mtshan ma rgya sgrub byed mtshon byed shes byed// mi rtog pa ye shes dang gnyid kyi shes pa dang dbang shes sogs te mi sems pa'i don yid rton pa cha 'jog pa'am yid ches pa yid brtan pa rtog pa dpyod pa dang ldan pa rtogs pa shes pa dang nges pa// dus rtag tu rtag par rta mgyogs 'gro la rte'u rta phrug gam chung ngu skyes pa rting ma rjes ma phyi ma// rtol gog glang dang mdzo mo 'dus pa'i bu rtol pho'am mo rting pa rkang ba'i phyi rting rtod pa 'ching bas bcings pa rtod thag rtod phur sogs kyang*// ru rta zhes pas sman bye brag pa zhig go bar byed nyams shed mo rtas pa rgyas pa gnas su rtol ba sleb pa'am 'byor ba dang rnag rtol ba// mong rtul blun po rtul phod snying stobs che ba'am pha rol gnon pa rten gzhi yan lag can gnas pa skyos ma skyabs sogs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba stong nyid yod pa dngos po ltas// mchod pa'i rten brgyad lta bu rta babs tā ra ṇa bya ma rta bya rta min pa'i myur 'gro ste pho nya'am bang chen// rta thul lnga sde'i gcig rta dbyangs slob dpon dpa' bo rtog ge pa rtog pa po'am dpyod mkhan te so skye lta bu dang rtog ge sde lnga'am 'bar ba yang*// mi gtsang ba la grags pa'i rtug pa skyag pa dang rtug dri dang rton pa bzhi lha rten rnam rtog so sor rtog pa rtogs pa brtan pa'am dbang du bya ba rtul ba sdud pa 'jam pa 'dul ba dpa' ba zhan pa mi rno ba rtul cig rten cig sogs rar btags ta'o//

(lta) lto bas 'gro ba brang 'gro sbrul lto 'gro'i sgra yang 'thad ltag pa ske rgyab kyi steng cha de lta bu mtshungs pa// lto bas 'phye ba 'gro bas bdag gi khyad par la go ba'i sgra lte ba lus kyi dbus cha sa sogs kyi dkyil ma gzhi ngo mar go ltad mo gzigs mo lta ba blta ba'am grub mtha'i lta ba// lto ba grod pa pho ba mngal dkyil lto zas sam bza' bya yis ltir gyis ltem gyis te bkang ba'i tshul// bur bu ram mar tshos sogs kyi ltang tshe rkyal pa'am snod 'grang pa rgyags pa ltogs pa bkres pa da lta dus kyi khyad par ram myur ba ltos shig lta bar byos dang ltos pa zhu ba dang gcig la gcig ltos pa// dngos ltar du snang ba mngon pa yang dag min pa ltag chod sun 'byin ltar snang grub mtha'i lta ba phyin ci log gi /ltung ba lhung bar byed pa ste ltung ba sde lnga sogs kyis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa mi legs pa lta chos lta zhog srid kyang mi shes zhes pa'i lta lta bu ci smos// lteng rgyas 'od srungs kyi bye brag gam lteng ka rgyas pa lteng ka char chu 'khyil ba'i gshong bu ltem gyis ltir gyis gang pa// re ba'am ltos pa blo gtad byed pa dang ming tsam ja lta phar zhog chu yang med mda' yi ltong ka gzhu rgyud dang sbyar rgyu'i kha// ltar ltar dbyibs sam mngal gyi gnas skabs shig ltem rkyang ngam ltem kyang mi brtan pa'am mtho dma' dang lteb ltab ltos grub ltar da ltar ltag gong steng yan la 'jug pa sogs lar btags ta'o// (sta) bstan bya ston pa bstan pa dang ston po'i don bzhugs pa'i stangs ka 'dug tshul bkur ba'i yul du sti ba gnas par byed pa ste mchod pa stobs shig byin cig rol cig byos shig /stes sam stes dbang stabs legs mu stegs byed dam pa phyi rol pa byad stems mthu gtad kyis// mi sto mi skyon lta stangs lta tshul me stag me'i tsha tsha'am lo stegs bu gtor stegs sogs// sta gon 'og grabs stong ba phan pa'i grogs rogs sha stag 'ba' zhig gam kho na byed// gzhogs stegs zur mig 'jo sgeg mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur stangs stabs gom pa 'dor tshul sta zur dku'am dpyi ston pa bstan pa// shing stag pa gro ga'i shun can gyi shing stug po mthug po sra ba gar ma'i khrod stobs nus pa'am ye shes can stag gcan gzan zhig

/dgra bo 'joms byed kyi sta re mtshon sta re shing gcod byed ste'u sta re chung ba'am tel pa stor ba 'bor ba'am rlag pa// shing star bu'i zhun ma sman ltar thog gi khaṇ+ḍa star ga'am ka kham bu zhig la go ba'i ming ston mo dga' ston shing ston sogs ster ba sbyin pa// lus sogs kyi stod dkyil yan chad la grags stan gdan dang stu mo mtshan ma dgag tshig ston pa bsten pa'i rten pa'i bye brag gam 'grogs pa dang sten cig ston yang snang*// ston ka dang dpyid ka dus kyi khyad par gang ba 'phel ba'am gtams pa dang stong pa 'grib pa'am 'bri ba ya stags mdos yas dang stags grong tshig stong phrag brgya tsho bcu// stim pa thim du 'jug par byed pa so sto so zing so thags mi bzang bar go stor khung mi gtsang ba khrus chu sogs 'bab pa'i khung bu dang // stang zil dngung rdo stabs gcig gom 'gros gcig lhan cig gi stabs cig la yang 'thad snyam stabs 'bul stabs ka sogs star phreng brgyus pa brgyu ba steng ma thog ka gong bla// stong pa zom stong khang stong lta bu snod nang du dngos po gzhan med pa'i don sogs stong pa nyid rang bzhin med pa rten 'byung sogs dang star ba sgrig pa rgyud pa phyi dor byed pa nyams su len pa gzabs pa dang cha sta steg chos 'phang stod stongs stangs ka stud stibs sogs sar btags ta'o// (brta) brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis rtog dpyod de 'jal ba'i don yul dang bslab pa'i gnas su brtan pa gnas pa mi ldog pa kun tu brtags pa blos bzhag pa gnyis snang lta bu ngo bo nyid gsum gyi gcig brtags pa rtog pa dpyad pa// yid brtan yid rton nam yid brtan po brtad pa glo bur ba brtul ba bsdus pa spangs pa zhugs pa 'jug pa len pa ste spyod pa brtan pa'am po rtag pa byang sems sam 'gyur ldog med pa// sgo nga'i sbubs sogs brtol ba rtol ba bshangs pa brtun pa brtson pa rtun pa spyi brtol phod pa'am ngo tsha med pa brtabs pa 'jigs pa rtab pa// yongs 'du sa brtol dpag bsam shing sa brtol sa phug ste shing brtag pa rgyud kyi dum bu brtag pa gnyis pa dang so gnyis pa sogs dang brtag pa brgyad brtul ba rtul ba// brten pa rten gyi cig shos la go brten pa rten pa gnas pa ltos pa 'grogs pa sogs phur bu phur bas brtod pa rtod pa bcings pa// brtas brta brtab rtog byed kyi brtag bya sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o//

(blta) bltos pa ltos pa'i sa thub dbang dang pha sogs bltos pa ltos pa'i chos slob ma dang bu sogs blta bar rung ba 'os pa mig gis bltas pa lta ba// blta bya mig yul sogs sku dang rdzing bu bltams pa skyes pa dang gang ba gos gdan gzan bltab pa lteb pa ltab pa nyis ltab sum ltab byed pa dang bltabs blta mtshan ma de 'di la bltas zhes sogs// bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o// (bsta) bsti stang mchod pa dang gnas bstud pa mthud pa'am 'dud du 'jug pa'am brgyud pa bar chad du ma bcug pa bstud ma brgyud ma zhes pa'i don bsti ba ngal gso ba'i gnas gnas chen sogs bstar ba star ba// thub dbang gi bstan pa chos dang bstun pa stun pa mthun par byed pa bstod pa bsngags pa dang 'phang stod pa la 'jug par 'os bsten pa sten pa// bstang ba phan pa'am mgon grogs dang bcas pas ma bzung ba don med kyi bstan bcos sogs dgu lta bu bstan pa ston pa bshad pa// thag dang gos sogs kyi ring po bstungs pa nye ba'am thung du btang ba blo'am gdong sna bstad pa kha phyogs pa'am gtad pa sogs 'gro chas 'gro ba'i grabs bstad pa gshom pa sga bstad pa sga rgyag pa// bsting ba'i tshig 'phya tshig bstim pa stim pas mi bstongs pa mi phan mi stong mod kyang // bsti ba ngal gsor med pa mnar med mngon par bstod pa bsngags pa'am mngon par dga' ba byin len dang yo byad bstabs pa stob pa dang bstis pa bstab pa bstims pa bstung ba sogs// bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o// (tha) ༈ thun mong spyi thun thu bo rgan pa'am gtso bo phu bo tha gru yul gru'am rgya khyon che ba// thu mi sam+bho ṭa'i rus thon mi zhes pa thon yul gyi thu mi bsdus pa 'dra thor cog dang thor tshugs gnyis do ker dang // tha ma dman pa phyi ma chung ngu tha ma na chung ngun thrig thrig lham gyi sgra// thur gyen min pa'am thur ma dang tha mal phal pa rang bzhin dang thul thar thang theg thogs thum po thig le thug thugs thon thub pa thu ba thal 'gyur thod pa thal ba sogs tha rkyang ngo //

(mtha) mtho ba mthon po'i ris phyogs sam rigs mtha' dag pa thams cad mtha' klas pa mtha' yas sam mtha' gtugs pa mthong mig gis rig pa mthong lam sogs// mtha'i char thug pa mtha' la reg pa nus pa'i don can gyi mthu ste stobs dang ngan sngags mthun pa mtshungs pa gcugs pa 'byor ba mi mthun pa snga ma'i ldog phyogs// lag pa snod sogs kyi mthil lto ba'am 'og gi cha'am dkyil lam gzhi lta bu mthe bong ngam bo sor mo sbom shos mthe'u chung sor mo phra shos// mthon ga dang mthon ka dang mthing ga sngon po'am sngo ba ste ming mtha' ci rigs drang zhing mthing kha lta bu la mthing gi kha dog bsdus kyang 'gal ba med la tshul 'di rigs mthun kun la sbyor mthang smad gos gyon pa mthug pa'am bo stug po srab min// mthar gyis rim gyis te mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba lta bu rta'i mthur mgo mthur thag mtho sor bcu gnyi'i tshad sogs gang ba kha tshang ba mthud pa bar sbrel ba mi 'chad par byed pa// mtho 'tshams pa 'gran pa'am gnod pa byed pa mtho btsams pa mthol ba mi gsang bar smra ba ste sdig pa bshags pa mtho yor mi 'greng lta bu'i rdo rtseg sogs mtho ba mi dma' ba mchog /mthon po mtho ba'i ming tsam la go ba'i sgra rgya mthongs rgya cher mthong ba'i gnas sam dkyil khang pa'i rgya mthongs sogs yul dbus kyi mtha' la 'khob pa khyab pa'am gnas pa mtha' don drug la 'jug rtag chad kyi mtha' sogs// mthing ril chu bya zhig mthing kha sngon po dang mthon ka chen po mthos mthong ga mthas klas pa mthu bo che mtheb mthar chags sogs mas 'phul tha'o// ('tha) 'thab mo 'khrug par go zhing 'thab pa yang 'thon pa bton pa'am 'gro ba 'go 'thon 'thon phyag lta bu dang 'byung ba'i don yang yin grogs dang rta sogs su 'thams pa 'khyud pa 'dzin pa bdag byed pa spyo ba shi spar 'thams pa lta bu// sprin dang rig pa 'thibs pa 'khrigs pa mi gsal ba chu dang nor 'thor ba gtor ba 'bor ba kha 'thor ba 'thor zhing 'thung ba khrus shig dang // blo dang lus 'thums pa gtums pa mi gsal ba mgo 'thoms pa 'khor ba mi shes pa du ba dud pa 'thul ba 'phyur ba gtul ba tshos pa// sra ba'i don can gyi 'thas pa 'khregs pa shin tu zhen pa 'thems nan zhes pa nan tan gyi don 'thems pa mi 'phyug pa chad lhag spong ba kha tshang ba mnan pa 'than po brtan po nan po// chu sbrang rtsi ja 'thungs pa btung ba 'thung yang 'thad sha spu nas 'then pa tshur 'dren pa tshan gyis 'khrid pa lta bu'i don yin zhing me tog spu 'thog pa gtogs pa// smod pa'i tshig dang 'thing slad gnyis don gcig 'then pa rngub pa 'thung ba 'jog pa phyir 'then pa 'thad pa rigs pa 'os pa rung ba 'dod pa// skyid zas sogs la 'thu ba dang 'thus pa 'du cha rgyab pa btu ba 'grig pa tshogs pa 'the ba phye ma zhib mor 'thag pa btags pa 'joms pa thag 'thag rang 'thag

/zha ba yan lag nyams pa 'theng po gyol po rkang pa ring thung mi mnyam pas 'theng nas 'gro mkhan te zha zhing 'theng ba yang mal gos nyal chas 'theb pa lhag po lhag pa nyid kyis 'thum pa gtums pa g.yogs pa// dum bu tshal bar 'thub pa gtubs pa dang 'thabs pa nan chags 'thems 'than pa nan tan byed pa'am brtan pa sogs 'as 'phul tha'o// (da) ༈ gang zag gzhan gyi dring zhes pa tshul lam 'dren pa'am lugs la re ltos mi 'jog pa ste gzhan la rag ma las pa bka' drin sku drin zhes pa phan btags pa'am byas pa dran pa mi rjed pa'i sems pa// dril bu dril chen dril chung dri sna'i yul mchog bzang po ste kha che skyes lta bu dra ba dra phyed mchod rdzas kyi khyad par// snga dro zhogs pa phyi dro dgongs ka'i don dri ba zhu ba gtam 'dri ba'i ming tsam dris pa'i lan zhus lan dri ba byas pa'i lan// gdul bya 'ga' zhig zab don nam bstan pa la kha drang bar bya ba'i don can gyi gsung ste nges don min pa g.yung drung 'gyur med rtag pa dang bkra shis pa'i mtshan ris drang por srong ba thub pa sogs drug grangs ka zhig /khrims ngo tsha chu dral ba 'jig pa 'joms pa ral ba lcam mo dang dral po ming sring zas thug sogs drangs pa drang ba 'brim pa drongs shig ces pa drang ba'i skul tshig nges pa drongs pa nges pa rnyed pa// drang po bshan po mi 'khyog pa bden pa'i don shing dang zhabs kyi drung rtsa ba nye ba zhe sa'i brda rdung 'khor drung yig sprun drung drel dud 'gro dre'am dre'u dre'u rdog stan khra bo par tang grum tse don gcig /mon dre dang smin drug gnyis rgyu skar gyi bye brag ma dros pa mi dro ba'am bsil ba ste klu rgyal zhig yin de gnas pa'i mtsho// dreg ni nad kyi khyad par dreg pa nag po chags pa'i dri ma'am ljan ljin dri ma dreg pa dri nag dang nyon mongs sam skyon dang // kha drag pa kha mkhas pa'am kha btsan pa drag zhan sku drag drag po'i shul ldan pa khro ba'i rnam 'gyur lus ngag tu dod pa sa dang mo mtshan sogs la gzan dang pho mtshan drud pa 'drud pa sbyar nas 'then pa'am 'phul ba lta bu drud cig kyang*// drod dron mo bsil drod dang dro ba tsha ba dros pa zan zas dron mo dro po g.yos zan dril ba sgong ba sgril ba sdeb pa ltab pa// dred mo gcan gzan zhig lpags pa pags pa gos ming dras pa gri sog gis 'dra ba'am gshags 'dra ba drubs pa 'tshem pa'am rma kha gso ba dres ma thag pa sogs bya rung ba'i rtswa zhig thag pas drags pa sdom pa drogs shig sdoms shig

/dred po gyong po ma dul ba chos dred zhabs dred dru bu sgro gu'i don dra ba skud pa 'brel ba'i snod nya rgya lta bu dra phad sgyu dra dra mig rtog pa'i dra bar go drangs pa 'dren pa// dril chen bsgrags pa khrims bsgrags pa sogs dra ma mkhas pa ya rabs phul phyin legs pa'i don gnas su drongs 'dren pa'i skul tshig gam tshogs pa// dregs pa rgyags pa khengs pa drung pa rtsa ba'am rtsad nas phyung ba bton pa sun phyung yid phyung kha yi drog kha skyid pa 'tshengs pa tshim pa// nad drag nad las grol ba dwa phrug pha ma med pa'i bu dwa ba sman dang rgya gro ma lta bu zhig la go ba'i 'bru 'bras bu// thal cha che ba'i don can gyi drags pa ste bshad drags pa che drags pa chung drags pa dang dred drus tshem drub dor do gal drang ba drag pa mkhas pa btsan pa shugs che ba mtho ba mchog 'grig pa dris shig sogs da rkyang ngo //

(gad) gdugs nyi char sgrib byed med pa gdong pa bzhin ras kha mdun gdugs nyin par ram nyi ma'am nyin byed kyis gdungs pa gdung ba tsha bar byed pa'am mnar ba// gdon mi min gyi gnod byed ltar dpe sgra gdug pa ma rungs pa mi bzad ba'i don gdol pa dmangs rigs kyi bye brag gdul ba btul ba// gdams bya'i ngag phan pa'i ngag gsal gdab pa btab pa brjed du mi 'jug pa gding ba dge tshul slong gi yo byad cig dang mal gding dang bting ba gdan stan gdan bu gdan 'dren gdan sa// lag rkang dpung pa'i gdu bu mdzes rgyan gdang gos sogs 'gel sa dpyang thag dang dre gdang sogs dang gdung ma ka ba'i gdeg byar go gdags pa btags pa// gdung ni rus sam 'phel gdung skad sgra'i gdangs dbyangs 'dzeg pa'i skas kyi gdang bu skas rim mam skas them// gdung rus pa'i zhe sa brgyud pa bar ma chad pa gdung rus sam rigs 'dzin pa po 'tshob pa po gsol ba gdab pa bdag cag la dgongs su gsol bar zhu ba gdon pa bton pa// gnyer ba dang gdams pa gnyis gnyer gtad byed pa yang na gnyer bar gdams pa bcol ba dang gdams pa gnyis gtams pa rnyed pa nor la gdu ba zhen cing chags pa thug pa gdu ba gar po byed pa// ming tha snyad gdags pa btags pa sbyar ba snyun nad gdangs pa drag pa sa bon skyed byed gdab pa btab pa// kha sogs gdangs pa phye ba bgrad pa mtshon cha gdengs pa 'phyar ba gzas pa gdon mi za ba the tshom med pa nges pa// da gdod da gzod de da lta lta bu'i rjes kyi dus sos gdal bde bar gnas pa'am snyom las gdeng nges pa spobs pa tshad yid brtan rgyu mtshan rtsis thob pa rnyed pa gda' 'dug gam mngon// gdos pa gru'i rna ba'am rlung g.yor te gru'i dar po che thud gdar mar chur bsres pa'i thud gru bzhi lta bu mar gdar yang srang 'jal byed la go gdeg pa bteg pa 'jal// gdags pa'i bstan bcos mngon pa sde bdun gyi gcig ste mo'u gal gyi bus brtsams pa'am bsdus pa gdam nga 'dam ka byed pa// gdengs ka yod pa can klu rgyal sogs gdul bya sems can nam rta lta bu dam la gdags pa btags pa gzhag pa// khyab gdal gnas lugs dang yongs grags gdod ma thog ma nas ming gdags bya'i gzhi gnas te bdag gi phung lnga lta bu bral med pa// khyim bdag gdangs can thub pa'i sbyin bdag yin la des phul ba'i kun dga' ra ba dang lag gdub sor gdub gdub kor gdab pa gdal ba gdas pa sogs gas 'phul da'o//

(bad) bdag nga'am nged tha mi dad kyi gcig rang bzhin dbang ba bden pa rnal ma ngo ma mi slu ba drang po bdud 'chi byed gnod byed bar chad bdun grangs shig mdun gyi phyogs nyid du bdar ba gral sgrig pa// bde ba skyid pa dga' ba sim pa bdo ba dar ba 'phel ba zas thug sogs bda' ba ro zhim pa me la bdug rgyu'i spos bdug pa bdug bya dang bdug byed pa// bda' ba dang ded pa gnyis rjes su 'ded pa'am ming tsam bdag pa po dbang ba po gtso bos bu lon phyugs sogs bda' ba 'ded pa'am dbang med pa'i don yin zhing bdas pa ded zin pa// bde ba legs pa'am bzang bar gshegs pa song ba'am rtogs pa ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bde zhing legs pa dge legs bden pa mi slu ba bdar ba bshad pa// gzhu mda' stan bdungs pa bkug pa'am bkang ba bdog pa yod pa dang nor rdzas la sogs pa'i ming skyel bdar skyel gla phebs skyel byas pa'i rngan pa bdar ba sbyin pa bdog pa yod pa'am 'dug pa// kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa yod pa gnyis dang bden bzhi sogs bdud 'chi ba rtsi 'joms byed kyi rdzas te mi 'chi ba'am 'chi med kyang zer phye ma zhib mor tsan+dan sogs bdar ba brdar nas phye mar byed pa// phyag bdar 'phyag pa'i ming ngam phyag cing bdar ba phyi bdar phyi ba'i ming ngam phyi zhing bdar ba dang bdugs bdag nyid bdag gi ba bdag lta sogs bas 'phul da'o// (mad) mda' nyag phran nam lung pa'i mtha' me mda' mda' tshad ma skar mda' mdung mtshon cha zhig 'phang mdung sogs mde'u mda' chung ba me mda' sogs kyi mdel lam bzhi dang sum mdo 'dzoms 'gag gnad ka'i don mdos yas stags// mdun drung sdun nye ba mdongs sgro thig gam dpral ba'i thig le mdog kha dog gam bkrag mdangs tshon sogs kyi bkrag gam gzi byin mdo nyung ngur bsdus sdud pa mdo sdom pa dkri ba mdo sde mdo phyogs mdo sngags// mdangs kha sang mdangs dgongs dang mdang zhes kyang 'thad sang nyin mdong gsol ngo dga' bstod pa 'dun pa ra mda' rogs sam dpung dang // mdud pa bcings pa gos mdud mdud pa bor ba dang mdag ma mig mdongs mdan pa la sogs mas 'phul da'o//

('ad) mya ngan sdug bsngal 'da' ba dang 'das pa gnyis rgal ba 'chi ba zad pa dang phyi ma 'di dus gsum gyi gcig 'dun pa don gnyer 'dod pa gus pas 'dud pa btud pa// 'dam pa 'jim pa 'dam skyes khrod nang 'dur 'dur 'gro tshul 'dong pa 'gro ba'i ming yin zhing 'dug pa sdod pa gnas pa yod pa mngon pa// sgra dang bya ba sogs nang 'dom pa dus sam phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa 'dzom pa rjes su 'ded pa bda' ba skul ba gsol ba 'debs pa gdab pa zhu 'bul byed pa 'don pa bton pa lag nas 'don pa sogs// lha 'dre mi ma yin 'byung po shing 'drud pa drud pa khung bu bu ga 'dru ba drus pa rko ba sngog pa rtol ba// 'du byed las sam rtsol ba dang dngos po sogs 'dus shing byas pa mi rtag pa dngos po rgyu 'bras 'dres ma 'dres pa'i ming tsam 'dre ba chu 'o mnyam du 'dus pa 'dra snyam pa mtshungs pa dras pa// 'drul pa rul ba'i don gtam gleng mo 'dri ba dris pa dri ba byed pa yi ge 'dri ba 'bri ba// 'drid pa slu ba mgo skor ba'i don la 'jug cing khrims dang chu ngo tsha 'dral ba dral ba srog sogs 'dor ba gtong ba spong ba 'bor ba dor ba 'dar ba 'gul ba 'phrig pa// 'degs pa bteg pa 'di thag nye ba dang da lta ba chos 'di pa 'dod pa khas len pa chags pa dga' ba mos pa 'dul ba 'dul byed dam 'dul po dang sde snod gsum gyi gcig dang 'dul sbyong gis 'dul ba btul ba gdul ba// 'dam bu 'dam rtswa'i ming 'dab ma lo ma gshog par go 'dab ma gshog pa chags pa ldan pa ste bya 'du ba 'dus pa tshogs pa nor// ri bo'i 'dabs ri ngogs sam logs 'dab kyang 'thad 'dol sa sa gshin po'am legs par go 'dag gu skyo ma'am spags 'dag pa lces ldag pa dang 'dam// blo dang rta sogs 'drog pa dogs nas 'dzur ba dkrogs pa khur drags pa zhabs rkang pa 'dred pa dred pa rdog stabs shor ba lta bu 'drad pa drad pa brdar ba sen mos 'drud pa la thob cing 'drud pa drud pa// 'dren pa po thub pa lta bus drang bya drangs chos bslab bya 'doms pa gdams pa ston pa 'chad pa slob pa dge ba la 'dun pa don du gnyer ba'am tshogs pa yang na dge ba'i tshogs 'dus pa 'du ba'am tshogs pa// 'do med bzo med dam gnad mi shes pa glen pa lta bu 'doms gsang gnas su go 'dom pa khru bzhi'i tshad gzhu 'dom gang ba kha tshang ba 'dogs pa btags pa gdags pa// 'dod pa chags pa'i yul dang yul can 'du shes bsam pa'am mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'du 'dzi g.yeng yul lam chung ma la sogs par go 'dris pa goms pa rgyun du 'grogs pa// skra 'dreg pa gcod pa bzhar ba'i mkhan po'am byed po 'deng ba 'gro ba'am gzhan du gtong ba'i phyir ched 'do ba rta'i 'dam pa 'dam ka byed pa// 'di las 'das pa po gshin po 'chi po'i don 'dad pa sems la 'phreng ba'am chags sems sogs kyis 'khor 'dab 'khor nye du bcas 'dums pa mthun pa tshogs pa 'grig pa sdom pa 'dun yang snang*// ming bla dwags 'dogs pa btags pa chu sogs 'dal ba dal ba dal po'i bya tshig skyo ma dang snag tsha 'dal ba khyab pa dal gyis 'gro ba// 'dag chal khrus rdzas sam 'dag byed kyi rdzas ba byang go 'dun sna tshogs pa de ma 'drog de ma thag gam de blo 'drog ma song*// dri ma sogs 'dag pa dag pa sbyong ba dang 'dun sa 'dren ma 'dri ba 'dum pa sogs 'as 'phul da'o//

(rda) grong rdal grong gis khyab pa'am grong khyer mthar grong thar thor ram ljongs thog dang mthil rdib pa phyi nas nang du 'bur ba'am lhung ba lta bu rdo ba'i rje bo pha lam la sogs pa'i ming rdul spabs zla mtshan skyon grangs can pa'i yon tan gsum gyi gcig rdo rje'i rdul gnam lcags// rdo ba sbed byed rde'u rdel rdo chung ngu dang nad kyi khyad par dang rtsis rdel rdog po rdog ma ril bu'am gong bu nyag ma 'bru rdog po gcig lta bu rdeg pa rdung ba bcug pa 'dres pa sogs kyang go rdugs po thogs pa thabs rdugs po lta bu// rdung 'tshog rdung rdeg dang rdung ba dkrol ba snun pa gtubs pa 'khrab pa mnyed pa rgyab pa pheg rdob rol mo zhig dang lag pa rdeb pa'i ming tsam pheb rdob kyang snang cha lang rol mo zhig rdeb pa brdab pa dkrol ba sprug pa rgyab pa// glo rdeg mgyogs pa sogs rdab cing 'chal ba gtad med du 'gyel ba'am 'gag rdab pa lus po rdos gtos sam bongs tshod che ba// lag pa dang mjug ma sogs rdum pa med pa'am chad pa glo lto ba rdol ba rtol ba 'thon pa brdol ba dbu ba lbu ba rdos pa thon pa thogs pa// gri sogs rdor ba rno 'don pa bkan nas 'drud pa brdar ba rdor cig kyang rdol chos rtsing chos sam spyod rtsing dang rdab pa rdul phra rab rdul phran rdal ba rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin sogs rar btags da'o// (lda) nam mkha' la lding ba 'phyo ba g.yo ba bya spyi dang khyung 'brug sgra brgya ldir ba sgra 'byin pa ldir skad sgrog pa ldab ldib mi gsal ba gsang po med pa'i skad// lda ldi mchod rdzas shig lde mig sgo lcags 'byed byed yod pa'i don can gyi ldan pa bcas pa mthun pa 'grogs pa// mgo ldog mgo mjug log pa'am phyin ci log pa lto ba grod pa ldir ba 'bur ba ltug pa rgya che ba ldur ldur shin tu tshos pa sil bur gyur ba ldugs pa blug pa bcug pa// seng ldeng shing ngam sman zhig ldem ldem mnyen lcug gam g.yo tshul lder bzo 'jim bzo'i don ldebs logs pa leb ma shog ldebs sogs// ldong ros tshon nam sman zhig ngad dri sogs kyi shugs sam nus pa ldang ba 'thul ba lang ba lde gu sman sogs ldir ba'i skyo ma'am bag zan sla ba lta bu byug pa 'byug pa// rjes su 'jug pa 'gro ba'am len pa ldog pa 'dor ba mi mthun pa log pa'am med pa ldob pa'am ldobs pa ni slob pa skyen pa myur ba ste shes par sla ba phyir slar mi ldog pa mi log pa brtan pa// skom btung ldud pa blud pa sbyin pa me dang nyi ma lde ba sro ba'am tsha bar byed pa ming gi don can gyi lde dpal lde skyid lde 'od lde khri srong lde'u btsan sogs// ldum bu sngo'am tshal gyi ra ba tshal zhing dang skyed tshal lta bu'i ming ldum bu rtswa sngon nam sne'u ldab ldob mnyen pa'am snyi ba dang /

bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ldem po 'khyog por dgongs pa bsam pa mtha' drug gi gcig dris pa'i lan ldon pa 'jal ba 'debs pa// bskyar ba dang ldab pa gnyis yang yang dang zlos pa nyis ldab nyis 'gyur sum ldab ldab log sogs lhag ma lhag po ldas pa las pa'am lus pa// ldan pa kha'i 'gram pa mdan pa'i sdeb kyang rung so tshems ldeg pa g.yo ba blad pa za ba mig lta byed kyang ldongs pa long ba mdongs kyang rung*// ne'u na tshod chung ngu'am na tshod ldang mnyam pa ste na mnyam na zla ldom bu bsod snyoms ldom bu ba bsod snyoms pa stan gdan las ldang ba lang ba// bstan bcos dang gos sogs kyi ldang ba kha tshang ba'i tshad dang ldag pa ldem pa lding thag ldad pa lde'u mig lder so rjes su 'gro ldog gzhan sel gyi ldog pa la sogs lar btags da'o// (sda) zhe gting nas sdang ba khro ba gnod pa sdang ba'i mig mig log sdigs mo byed pa'i mdzub mo sor mo zhig sdig pa gshe ba 'jigs su 'jug pa 'ben la gzir ba// sdar ma dpa' min nam snying stobs chung ba bde ba dge 'bras sdug bsngal mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dang skyid sdug dge ba legs spyad bcu lta bu sdig pa mi dge ba bcu sogs dang ngan pa sdom pa spong ba sdud pa sre ba 'ching ba sdom tshig lta bu// sdings gting ngam zhe dang dkyil dbus sogs kyi don sdong po yal ga gyes pa'i rten nam ljon pa'am rtsa ba sdong bu sdong po chung ba'i don sde mang po'i tshogs sam tshoms rang sde gzhan sde sde bzhi lta bu// tshe srog dang sdo ba brje ba sdur ba srog gtong ba'i don yin zhing sde tshan dum bu bam po tsho sdeb pa sbyor ba sdom pa 'grogs pa sgrig pa// srog chags sems ldan chung ba'i bye brag sdom pa'am ba rgya byed mkhan sdig pa dngos dang sdig srin sder mo gcan gzan sogs kyi sen mo rno ba rnon po// so byang sngags kyi sdom pa spong ba spyod pa mi 'da' ba bsrung bya'i sdom pa dge bsnyen sogs sdod gnas 'dug gnas sdod pa bsdad pa gnas pa sdod cig

/sdeb sbyor rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig dang rig byed kyi yan lag drug gi sdeb sbyor rnam dbye dang yi ge'i sbyor ba sogs mdzes pa'i don can gyi sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sdug gu yang nor dang chos sogs phyogs gcig tu sdud pa bsdu ba gsog pa sdom pa tshogs par byed pa// sdum pa khyim mam khang par 'jug mchod sdong mchod pa'i rten dang mchod sbyin gyi phyugs 'dogs pa'i ka ba sdom bu khang chung gis bskor ba// sder ma snod spyad kyi khyad par rag sder la sogs pa'i sgra thug pa skyo tsha la gdab rgyu'i sdor sha tshil sogs lag pa sor mo lnga bas sdom pa 'dzin pa// rgyal ba'i bka' gsung la sdod pa gnas pa chos skyong sogs sde snod gsum ste bre bo che'i don ltar bshad dgos sdong ba sdos sdum pa sdus sdur ba sdoms sdug po sdigs sdig to can sdang po sogs sar btags da'o// (brda) gri mtshon brdar ba rdor ba brdeg cing 'chos pa brdung zhing bcos pa sogs brdung bya nyes can lta bu brdungs pa rdung ba// kha brdar ba gtam mang bshad pa bla bo gtam brdol ba byung rgyal du thon pa ste bab col lam nyid gtam chal mar ram cha lang brdab pa dang brdabs pa gnyis rdeb pa'am rdab pa// rnga brdung ba rdung ba snun pa bro brdung ba rdung ba 'khrab pa go byed la 'jug pa'i brda lag brda go brda// chal ma thang mar brdal ba rdal ba bkram pa khyab nas g.yab mo sogs brdul ba g.yob pa dang btul ba'i don yin zhing brdeg pa rdeg pa// chu brdol snod brdol brdung ba sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o// (blda) bldabs pa bskyar ba ldab pa bzlas nas bldag pa ldag pa lces 'byog pa bldeg pa ldeg pa la thob cing bldad pa ldad pa zhib mor blad pa'am rmur ba// bldab pa sogs bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o// (bsda) bsdu bya nor sogs bsdu ba btu ba bsdus pa btus pa sdud pa bsdur ba sdur ba mnyam par byed pa 'gran pa bsgrun nas bsdad pa sdod pa 'dug pa// nyes spyod sogs bsdams pa sdom pa spangs pa bsdoms pa sdom pa bsdus nas srog dang bsdos pa sdo ba// 'og bsdogs 'og grabs sam sta gon nye bar bsdogs pa nye bar brtsams pa sta gon bsam gzugs kyi sngon 'gro gzhan nyes can dang 'phen lta bu la bsdigs pa sdig pa gshe ba sogs// grogs rogs dang bsdongs pa 'grogs pa mnyam du 'gro ba sdong ba bsdebs pa sdeb pa sbyor ba sogs sna la btags pa'i thag pa dang gru gu bsdogs pa bsdus pa dril ba brtsams pa sdog pa// 'gal ba mi mthun pa bsdum pa sdum pa mthun par byed pa chings sgrig pa gros byed pa dang bsdig pa bsdeb pa mdor bsdus sogs bas 'phul sar btags da'o//
