(na) (gan) ༈ phan pa bde bar byed pa gnod pa mi bde bar byed pa mnar ba gnas pa yod pa 'dug pa'i skabs go'am tshul lam thabs sam dus te gnas tshul dang 'phral ma'am mthar thug min pa dang gnas thabs gnas dus gnang ba ster ba'am sgrub pa'am byed du rung ba bkag pa dgag pa byed du mi rung ba ste 'di gnyis 'dul ba'i brda gnad gsang ngam mdog gam rtsa ba gnad ka don gnad lugs gnad sogs// gnod sbyin gdon nam lha'i bye brag gnag nor ram 'bri g.yag sogs phyugs dud 'gro rta lug sogs kyang go gnam rgyu skar gyi lam ltar dpe sgra gnag pa nag po'am nag po'i bya ba// gnas brtan bcu drug gam 'od srungs chen po sogs nye bar gnas pa gam du sdod pa thag nyer yod pa gnas kyi slob ma gnas pa 'dus sa'i khang pa khyim gnas pa sdod pa yod pa brten pa mi 'gyur ba 'os pa// gnod byed 'tshe byed rlag byed zil gzi brjid kyis 'og tu gnon pa mnan pa zhum par byed pa gna' sngon nam snga ma'i mi smra zhing don go ba'i gang zag gnubs rus shig ste sangs rgyas ye shes sogs// bying rgod zhi nas dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste bsam gtan sogs sngar gyi gnas skabs dor nas gzhan du 'gyur ba ste chu rnyog ma dwangs pa lta bu yin la gnas yongs su gyur pa yang zer don la gnas pa'i lugs ka gshis lugs ngo ma gnas tshul stong nyid rtogs pa shes pa// gnangs sang gi phyi nyin gzhes gnangs kyi phyi nyin gnam ru gzhu mda' stan rkang pa zhabs kyis gnon pa mnan pa kha gnon log gnon rnam gnon// zhe gting gnong ba nongs pa ste skyon gyis zhum pa'am 'gyod pa'am nongs 'khur ba gnad gcod 'chi nad lta bu gnas ngan pa len pa skye gnas mi legs par skye ba'am yang na sgo gsum gyi gnas ngan len las su mi rung ba'am bag chags lta bu// gnod pa'i gnas yul lam dzam+bha la dang gnas gnas min gnos shig bka' gnang gna' bo gnod bya la sogs pa gas 'phul na'o//

(man) mnal gnyid log pa gnyid 'chi ba gzims pa gnyid log pa mna' ma bu'i chung ma bag ma 'og tu mnan pa gnon pa mi 'tho bar byed pa// mnab rtsal kha za dri sna'i yul mnam pa snom pa'am bro ba dang dku ba mnar ba gzir ba de las lhag po med pa ste dmyal ba zhig mnar ba gzir ba gnod pa nyen pa// kun nas mnar ba 'tshe ba gnod pa'i sems bsam pa zas sogs mnog pa zhim pa mang ba gya nom pa mnog khe'am spogs dang phan chung ba phran bu// mnol ba grib bam mi gtsang ba'i rigs rgyud dam gras mnol ri ltar na ri rtseg mna' bro bskyal ba bor ba'am sgog pa na bza' gos mnabs pa mnab pa gyon pa gon pa gsol ba// mno ba dang bsam pa gnyis bsam blo gtong ba'am bsam blo mnos pa mno ba bsams pa thob pa len pa dang mna' chu gnol cig sogs mas 'phul na'o// (rna) rnam par shes pa sems sam shes pa rnon po rtul min nam mchog gam rno ba'i ming tsam rnal ma gnyug mar 'byor ba sbyor ba sgom pa ting nge 'dzin thabs shes zung 'jug rnams mang tshig ste sangs rgyas rnams lta bu// rnam par rtog pa kun rtog sems kyi 'char tshul rnam dbye rtog pa nyon mongs rnam grangs dbye ba'am rnam pa ming don gyi rnam grangs sogs rnam pa rnam grangs mdzes pa rnam 'gyur rang bzhin mi rtag pa'i rnam pa sogs mang ba nyung min// rna ba sgra 'dzin nam nyan byed kyi gshog pa 'dab ma ste 'bag sogs kyi rna chas gshog pa lta bu'am snyan gshog rtse mo dang po rno ba rnon po'i bya ba rnal ma gnyug ma bden pa ngo ma'i don brjod bya sogs// rdul dang khug rna lho bur ram du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu zhig rnag ces pa khrag rul nas dkar por song ba zhing lo tog skye ba'i sa gzhi'i rnang ma chus khyab pa'i ched du mu'am sa sgang 'then pa ste don zhing chu ma// tshig phrad kyi bye brag rnam par ni yongs su zhes pa lta bu ste rnam par dag rnam par bshad pa sogs ra la don dang rnam mkhyen rnam 'grel rnam pa'i phra mo rnam kun rna dbang rna chas rna shal rna rgyan sogs rar btags na'o//

(sna) snar ma dang snron dang snrubs gsum rgyu skar gyi bye brag snag tsha yi ge 'bri byed kyi rdzas dang snag gi tsha bo ste gnyen zhig snur ba 'dul ba ldur ldur byed pa zhib mor 'thag pa// snang ba gsal ba sgrub pa mngon pa yul mthong ba cha sna kha tha dad dam dbye ba'am du ma tshogs pa 'dus pa sna snom byed thog ma rtse mo yi don snabs sna'i lud pa'am zag chu// snam bu zheng chung la chu ring ba bal gyi gos sogs dang 'dod pa'i snam bu'i don snam phran sbyar ba'i gos te chos gos gsum gyi gcig snal ma gos rgyu'am snam bu'i spun nam skud pa'i don sne mo rtse mo 'go ma thog ma zur// gnam sa'i bar gyi snang ba mthong ba bar snang du 'phur ba lta bu snang ba dang gsal ba gnyis mun pa med pa'am 'od chags pa sgron ma snum 'bru mar rtsi mar sogs dang snum pa snum po mdog mi skya ba'am sang seng med pa dri dang mtshon snom pa tshor ba dang thogs pa// lam sna lam ston nam sna 'khrid par go sna bo gtso bo thog mar dpon po'i don snag nye du zhig dbon po spun nam tsha bo snang yod dam mngon// yang dag pa lta bur snang ba mthong ba ste dngos min pa yang dag min pa mngon rjes sgrub pa sun 'byin ltar snang lta bu sna kha rigs mi 'dra ba mang po snrel zhi 'tshol ba'am go rims su mi gnas pa dang 'phred snod snod spyad dang snod du rung mi rung sogs// yug snam btsag gam rdo zhig dang yug tshang ba'i snam bu snam phran snam sbyar gyi snam phran nam snam bu chung ba sna ma dzā ti'am dzā ti'i me tog dang srin shing sne'u sngo'am sngo dri 'gags sel ba dang rtse chung*// snad yar rmas pa'am skyon zhugs pa snad pa'i ming tsam ser sna dam du 'dzin pa'am 'jungs pa'i don snon ma kha skong snon khar go snoms shig snom pa'i skul tshig snol ltar na bsnol ba// rgyab kyi don la go ba'i snam logs rgyab bam ngos sam zur dang snun pa snon pa snar ba snor ba snur cig snang byed snub pa snad pa sogs sar btags na'o//

(brna) brnab pa chags pa'am gzhan nor bdag gir 'dod pa'i sems bsam pa lto zas sogs la brnan pa nan tan byed pa'am do gal byed pa'i don yang yin brnangs pa chu rtsam sogs gre bar 'gags pa// brnag pa bzod pa'am bsam par dka' ba mi nus pa'i don brnag pa bzod pa'am bsam pas mdun gam du brnur ba 'then pa'am tshur 'dren pa// sa la sbas pa'i don can gyi brnogs pa gab pa dang nges gzung la 'jug pa'i brnan pa dmigs su bzung ba'am bkar ba ni sgra'i 'jug yul lta bu// brnang brnog sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o// (bsna) gnad gsang du bsnun pa snun pa rdeg pa mtshon cha lag cha bsnun pa snun pa rgyab pa nu ma 'o 'dzin nam nu zho bsnun pa snun pa nu ru 'jug pa'am blud pa// srol ka bsnubs pa snub pa nyams pa'am nub par byas pa gong 'og ltag 'og bsnor ba snor ba nor du 'jug pa dkrugs pa brje ba lta bu'i don yin zhing bsnol ba snol ba brje ba dang phan tshun nam bla 'og rim min du sbyor ba'am rtseg pa seng ge mjing bsnol dang rdo rje rgya gram lta bu snol mar byas pa// mtshon cha bsnams pa thogs pa khyer ba bzung ba snom pa dus phyi bsnur phyi bshol snur ba 'then pa'am nye ru btang ba zhib mo zhib par bsnur ba snag tsha sogs snur ba// mjug ma rnga ma bsnar ba snar ba brkyang ba dri sna'i gzung bya bsnams pa snom pa bro bar byas pa bsnoms kyang mthong nem nem snem pa'i tshul bsnems pa snem pa mnan pa'am nem nem byas pa// mang po dang yang yang du kha bsnan pa snon pa snon ma bcug nas 'dres pa bsres pa'am legs par go bsnos pa sno ba brdzis pa mnyed pa 'phur ba sbrus pa// bsnam bsnom bsno bsnad pa sogs bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o// (pa) ༈ pang pa pang pa'am thu ba ma pang bu 'jug lta bur go par bu snod kyi bye brag mar par zhag par sogs pi lbang sgra snyan nam rgyud mangs 'dzin pa 'chang ba// gcig pu grogs med pa rkyang pa reng bur go pir ri mo 'bri byed dam tshon 'byug byed la go ba'i don can gyis ngos la pa tra shing lo'am ri mo bris pa 'bri ba// pu shu mda' yab lan kan spen rgya'i don pu shud 'dab chags shig pur gyis 'phur tshul pur ba 'phur ba mkha' la 'gro ba// puṇ+ḍa rī ka gdugs dkar chu skyes dkar po stag dang phyogs kyi glang po dang bur shing gsum gyi bye brag pi pi ling pi spa lī zur chag pa ste grog ma dang dbyibs mdog 'dra ba'i sman zhig yin pas grog sman yang grags// pa shi bod kyi btsun pa rgya nag tu phyin pa'i ming pad+ma 'phyo ba 'dam skyes pa la sha rgya skyegs kyi shing bal sha yang zer// pus mo sgyid khug gi mdun cha pus tshigs pus lhang btsugs pa 'dzugs pa pog spos por pa phor pa blug snod ga pur karbur zur chag pa ste nus can yin ga pur yang zer ba sman zhig 'thul ba dri ngad ldang ba du ba 'phyur ba// par ma spar zin pa'i dngos po dang par zhes pa 'dra ba dang spar ba'i ming tsam mtshon pa'i sgra po ti glegs bam ste pusta ka zur chag pa paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros dang 'grogs pa mkhas pa lnga rig pa// ze prog sgo lcags kyi ze ma'i rtse dang ze ba'i rtse yin snyam prog zhu dbu rgyan dang rtse zhwa srog ces pa rtse la grags 'og pag ska rags kyi rgyan nam rked pa la 'phyang ba'i tshar tshar dang // pur ro'am gdung de'i khang pa ro khang gdung khang sreg khang par tang dre'u rngog gam stan khra po ṭa la gru 'dzin te sgra nyams nas po ta la sgrol ma'i gnas ri zhig dang dmar po ri// pu sa la sman 'o su dang pu shel tse sman zhig ste bya zas dang khru nga yang byed rung ba'i rtswa// pa sangs pa lba sangs gza' bdun gyi gcig pra phab pa pra se na 'bebs pa sngags sogs la brten nas lkog gyur gsal bar ston pa mo btab pa pri yaṅku sngo gling 'bru gsum gyi bye brag la 'jug

/pags pa shun pa skogs pa gzig gi pags pa sogs lag pod lag tshab lag pa g.yar ba phan tshun las ka'i rogs re mos byed pa'i ming tsam po zos pa ji ltar thogs pa re ltar thogs pa ji tsam 'gor bar gyur kyang ni sdud sgra ste re ltar thogs kyang lan bdun pa lta bu// par gyis 'phar tshul 'phar ba 'phag pa dang cod pan pa na sa ut+pal te por puṣ+pa sku par sogs pa rkyang ngo // (dpa) dpag pa 'jal ba'i tshad de rgyang grags brgyad sogs dang rtags mthong 'brel ba nges pa'i rjes su lkog gyur dpag pa 'jal ba nges pa rtogs par byed pa dpag bya lkog gyur gyi gzhal bya dam bca' rtags kyi yul bsgrub bya rtogs bya dang gzhal bya tsam dpog pa 'jal ba nges pa rtogs par byed pa// rgyal po sa gzhi skyong ba la sogs pa'i ming dpya zhes pa khral yin la lag dpyar yang 'gyur snang dpyang pa 'phyang ba thur du dpyongs byed kyi thag pa gdang thag sogs dpyangs pa 'phyang ba thur du btang ba// dpag pa tshad dam gzhal du med pa ma mchis pa dmag g.yul gyi dpung tshogs sam rgyal byed dpung bu chung rkang thang gi dmag rkang dmag /don nam dpe can gyi dpe'am dper brjod dam bkod na nges bzung ngam dmigs kyis 'byed pa dpe dang phal cher 'brel ba'i byad gzugs yin nam snyam ste dpyad don sen mo zangs mdog sogs brgyad cu dpe cha glegs bam yig cha dpen pa mkho ba yid du 'ong ba phangs pa// rnam par dpyod pa khyad 'phags kyi shes rab dang rnam par dpyad pa rtog pa dang dpyod pa gnyis blos 'jal ba tsam mam rtsing zhib kyi khyad kyang yod brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis gzhal ba dang rtog dpyod kyi yul lam bya las dang gcig tu sbrel na ming tsam yin pa 'di gong 'og la bsgre dgos pa dang // rje bo gtso bo gzhon nu gdong drug dpon po dbang byed po slob pa'am klog pa'i dpon po bla ma sems pa bsam pa dpa' ba mi ldog pa snying stobs brtan pa che ba chen po rgyal sras sogs/

dpyid thig le'am dpal dang dus kyi dbye ba dpyid ka dpral ba smin ma'i steng gi ngos sam thod par go dpyi mgo sta zur ram dku dpyi dang nu ma'i bar zer ba lta bu dpyongs pa dpyang ba dang dpyongs shig kyang*// shing nga dpung bcad dge slong ma'i nu sgrib kyi gos phu bcad lus kyi dpung pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan dpung gdub dar// dar gos thur du dpyangs pa rgyan zhig dpangs zhes pa mtho dman gyi tshad dam 'phang ngam mtho tshad dpag bsam gyi shing lha'i ljon shing sogs// dpa' bo snying stobs can sdar ma min pa dpa' ba spro ba 'phel ba snying stobs brtan pa'i don dpang po che bzhi'am gnya' bos yi ge sogs dpod pa gzhan la 'brir bcug nas rang gis smos pa lta bu// sman khong du btang nas nad gso bar byed pa dang dpyad thur ma sogs kyis nad phyi nas 'dren pa'am phyir 'don pa'am 'byin par byed pa ste gso rig dpyis mtha'am gting phyin pa son pa thon pa dpyas pa 'phya ba'am dpya ba'am skyon mi 'dogs pa sbyor ba// dpal ji skad du// dpal mo dbyangs can blo dang sde gsum gyi// phun sum tshogs dang 'byor pa mdzes pa dang*// 'tshog chas 'jigs med tshal dang 'phags pa dang*/ bdud rtsi rnams la dpal zhes rab tu grags// zhes pa'i don dang ldan pa bcas pa dpang rus shig lo rtswa ba blo gros brtan pa dang dpyal dpung gnyen dpag yas dpag gzhi dpags dpa' mo sogs das 'phul pa'o// (spa) pha spad pha bu'am pha khu spun zla sku mched nye du spang bya dor bya gzhom bya sbyang bya spong byed kyi yul spangs pa dor ba sogs 'das pa// sprang po dbul po med po'i ming spar mo lag pa'i spar ba changs pa lta bu dang sbar mo'i don spa shing gi bye brag sba yang zer spa dbyug spa 'khar sprad pa sprod ste pa ra ba gtad pa 'phrod pa// bdug pa byug pa sogs kyi spos lta bu sprin pa chu 'dzin spro ba da lta ma 'ongs dang spros 'das skul te don 'od sogs 'phro ba gtong ba rgyas par byed pa longs pa tshang bar spyod pa spyad pa 'dod yon nam 'byor ba'i ming yang yin spyod pa spyad pa 'jug pa nyams su myong ba brtul zhugs bya ba byed tshul bslab pa ya rabs kyi spyod pa sogs// spang spos bdug spos ral ba can zhig spar ba dang spor ba me sogs 'bar du 'jug pa snga ma 'das ma 'ongs phyi ma da lta ba skul tshig ste 'di rigs la rtags 'jug nas dus gsum 'byed tshul dngos su ma bstan kyang 'di ltar lag len nyer spyod dang bstun nas rigs bsgre spen ma rtsi shing zhig spyil bo rtswa sogs kyi khang ba spyil bu khang chung spro ba dga' ba skyid pa dro ba'am tsha ba brtson pa// spen tog rgyan zhig spug rin chen zhig ste chab rom lo stong lon na spug tu 'gyur bar bshad snyam rin chen mchog gis spud pa brgyan pa spras pas spa ba mdzes pa brjid chags pa// go gnas dang gong sogs mtho bar spar ba spor ba 'phar du 'jug pa bteg pa 'dren pa par rgyab pa spel ba bya 'dab chags dang shog bu spur ba 'phur du 'jug pa lding bar byed pa spur bya spur byed spur zin spur cig ces pa lta bu bya tshig dus gsum gzugs mi 'gyur ba kun la sbyar gnas gzhan du spags pa 'phag tu 'jug pa btang ba song ba 'bur ba// mgo las skyes pa'i spu skra dang ba spu sogs sprug sprug rdul sogs sprug tshul lam ming tsam thag pa'i thags su bran pa nyid kyi rgyu la sbyar rgyu'i spun snal ma// spe'u mkhar ram khang chung ngam sdong po'i ming gces spras gces po rtsis chen snying sdug spyad bya'i dngos po ka ca nor gyi spyi ming spel ba 'phel du 'jug pa skyed pa sbyar ba sre ba// spa ma shug pa lta bu'i shing zhig spru nag ma sngo sman zhig spra ba me len gyi rdzas mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar dkar zer ba lta bu spungs pa spung ba du ma gcig tu phung por byas pa sdom pa bcer ba// spra chal 'do med dam gtad med lang shor rgan po spra chal lang ba lta bu spod zas kyi bro ba skyed byed sga pi sogs dang zho 'o ma chu sogs kyi spris ma kha'i zhag lta bu spags pa bsres pa bsgos pa spags ma dang spags gnyis spags nas za lta bu// phan tshun 'thab mo 'khrug 'dzing sprad pa dang sprod pa gnyis sbyor ba thug pa'am rgyab tu 'jug pa spyos pa spyo ba gshe ba bsdigs nas spyugs pa gzhan du brdzangs pa'am bskrad pa// spyi thun mong gtso bo ldog pa rigs sgos bye brag gam sger spel ma re mos sam 'dres ma lta bur go 'phrin cha spring ba dang springs pa gnyis skur ba sring ba 'bri ba 'gro ba// rmongs mun gyis sprul pa bskyed pa ste rang bzo lta bu spong ba pa spong ba po'am sgom pa po spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo lta bu spongs shig spong ba'i skul tshig spyod pa pa mu stegs kyi bye brag

/tshur spyon byon nam 'byon dus gsum gzugs gcig snyam dka' ba'i las spyad pa spyod pa chos spyod yi ge 'bri ba dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sems bskyed sogs bcu tshan gsum lta bu spor ba mang du spel ba// spros pa 'gag pa sogs dang mtshan ma dang rtog pa sogs dang bral ba spangs pa sprul pa sbyin pa'am stob pa bskyed pa 'phrul du 'jug pa mchog sprul sogs gza' bdun gyi gcig la spen pa zer// gos gyon pa gnas rigs pa spo ba spos pa brje ba sgyur ba bsgre ba chu bor gru shan sogs spyings pa spying ba bying du bcug pa spra tshil sbrang rtsi'i ro ma'am snyigs ma lhung bzed glon byed dang lcags g.ya' len byed spyin 'byor byed kyi rdzas shig kha spyin lta bu// khe la 'jug pa'i spogs rgyal kha skyed bogs 'don pa spyang ki gcan gzan zhig spra sprel che spre'u spre g.yo byed// spyang po grung po sgrin po'i ming spobs pa gdeng mi 'jigs pa sngon ma thos pa'i chos don rtogs nas bskal bar bshad kyang mi zad par byed pas dge ba legs spyad mi dgag tshig spyom pa ngom pa'am bdag nyid sgrog pa spyoms pa// spyi blugs chab bum ril ba kha spub kha 'og tu bstan pa lhung bzed kha spub pa spub pa rgyan dang dpal gyis lus la spras pa mtshan pa brgyan pa spud pa// spyi bo spyi gtsug mgo bo rtse mo rdul can gyi gos sprugs pa sprug sprug byas pa rdul gyi don la thob pa'i spabs rdul chags pa rna spabs sogs// sgo gsum gyi spyod pa byed lugs spa bkong ba zhum par byas pa ri bo yi spo rtse mo'am mtho ba'am rtse'i thang ngam rmang 'gram yang yin snyam// mig gi don la 'jug pa'i spyan 'dren byed spyan pa lta rtog mkhan nam gnyer pa lta bu dang spos pa spong ba spu la bab pa sprug pa spyi mtshan spang spongs spun pa bsres pa'am thung ba sogs sar btags pa'o//

(lpa) stag lpags stag gi pags pa ste 'dir gzhi dang ma 'brel ba dang drug sgra yod na pa rkyang dang drug sgra med na la mgo can te ma 'brel ba ni pags pa lta bu dang mi lpags snying lpags la sogs lar btags pa'o// (pha) ༈ phang pa pang ba'am ngos dang thu bar go phun sum tshogs pa dpal legs pa dge tshogs phun tshogs kyi gzhi tshugs zug pa'am chags shing tshig phrad dam rkang 'thung phun zhes pa tshad kyi khyad par te phun gang phun re sdud lta bu/ phrug gu na phra ba'i byis pa dang phrad pa mjal ba thug pa sprad pa 'phrad pa rdul phran rdul phra rab bdun lta bu phran bu chung ba gyi na cung zad phra ba zab pa zhib pa phra mo chung ngu// brgya stong khri phrag tsho phyang ba 'phyang ba'i ming phrul pa 'phrul ba'i ming ngam yang na thur du phyang zhing phrul ba'i rgyan phyal grod pa'i zhe sa phyang nge ba 'phyang tshul 'jol le ba// phyug pa po nor can 'byor ldan 'byor pa yod pa'i don phyir ched don slad du phyogs chos dang chos can dang de tshogs pa'i bsgrub bya'am dam bca' dang rgyab rten dang ris dang mthun dang shar sogs mtshams bcas bcur go phyin pa 'gro ba son pa song ba thob pa// phyag dar phyags snyigs phyag dar khrod sogs phyi sa dri chen bshang ba'i ming phye ma zhib tu btags pa'i sman sogs phye rtsam pa phye ma// phywa gtso bo mo dpal lam g.yang mkhan po byed po phongs pa dbul ba nyam thag pa des phying ba ma btags pa'i gos phying zhwa phying dmar rul pa 'drul ba'am rnying ba phyar ba gdengs pa gzas pa brtsams pa 'phyar ba// phyi bdar phyi zhing phan tshun bdar ba'am ming tsam mam phyi ba'i ras dum gyis cog tse dang ri mo phyis pa dag par byas pa dbyi ba phyis shig kyang phyags ma rdul 'phyag byed kyis phyags pa 'phyag pa gad rgyag pa// nam mtshan phyed dgung phyed ka phyed ma phyen 'og rlung rtug dri gtong ba btang ba phyi rdo 'phongs phyi ba'i rdo dang phyi rgyab kyi rdo phang ba 'phen pa'i ming*// dbang gis phyug pa lha chen rgyal po gtso bo mgon po dbugs phyung ba sems gso btang ba gnas spar ba dbugs bton pa tsam phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa sgo la srol phye ba 'byed pa btod pa brtsams pa phral ba bkrol nas/

/phyags lham rkang pa la gyon rgyu'i lham mchil lham sogs phran tshegs chung ngu'am nyung ngu dang 'dul lung sde bzhi'i gcig phreng ba go rims su bstar ba'i gral lta bu phrogs pa 'phrog pa len pa tshar gcod pa phrogs shig /phra men lha'i g.yog 'khor ram gdon phrin las las ka mdzad pa bya ba bya byed kyi las sa thos bsam sogs phyod che ba tshegs chung gis don chen sgrub pa'i ming ngam sleb che ba/ phyugs bdud 'gro'i bye brag rta sogs kyi ming phru ma mngal gyi bu snod dam sha ma phye ma leb me lcer lcebs pa'i srog chags shig /phru ba snod rdza ma'am rdzi'u khog ma'i ming phyir phyi ru'am phyi rol tu phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa bkar ba bkol ba bskyed pa phyag lag pa'am sor mo lnga pa dag gis dar sogs phyor cig 'phyar ba'i skul tshig /smin ma mche ba'i phrag par mtshams phyag 'tshal ba 'dud pa phyag byed pa nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i dus phyad pa rgyun pa rtag pa phyad par rgyun du'am rtag tu// phra ma dbyen nam skyo ma mi mthun par byed pa'i tshig phrag dog gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi dga' ba'i sems phrag pa dpung mtshams kyi cha phrag par khur longs phrag gong lta bu phral ba phye ba bral ba tha dad du byed pa// phyin chad phan chad slad kyi cha yid sems phyung ba mi dga' ba'am skyo ba bskyed pa yid byung ba sun ci phyin pa rang gis rang sun 'byin pa dang gzhan la sun ci nus 'byin pa// phyi rjes 'brang ba snyeg pa phyir phyi ru'am rgyab tu dang yang ngam slar phyogs pa kha bstan pa gzhol ba 'jug pa phyin ci log pa nor ba go log pa mi bden pa// mi pham pa ma pham pa rgyal ba rgyal tshab byams pa tshig phan tshun phrad pa sbyor ba ste slar bsdu sogs yin tshig dang don rnam par dbye ba 'byed pa tha dad par byed pa dang po sogs phyed pa khyad par shes pa ma 'dres par rtogs pa ngos 'dzin pa// phru ma dmag sgar dang pho brang phyar ba 'phyar ba rgod cing g.yeng ba ste rnam g.yeng dang phru dang zhabs phyi zhe sa'i phyag snga phyi phyi nang phyi mig rgyu mtshan gyi phyir pha bu pha lam phu nu phar phyin pho ba pho long sogs pha rkyang ngo //

('pha) gzhan skyon can la 'phya ba dang 'phyas pa gnyis smod pa skyon brjod pa dpya ba 'od dang sems 'phro ba dang 'phros pa 'gyed pa 'tsher ba g.yeng ba spro ba// 'phyi ba sa khung gi srog chags shig 'phye bo rkang med lto ba sogs kyis 'gro mkhan dus tshod 'phyi ba dang 'phyis pa 'gyangs pa 'gor ba// rnam par 'phrul ba sprul pa g.yo ba 'gyur ba sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul rnam 'gyur snang cha sprul pa sgyu dra sogs mda' sgro ldan 'phen pa dang 'phangs pa skyel ba skyur ba rdeg pa rgyab pa 'phang pa rlag pa// nam mkha'i 'phang mthon po khri gdan 'phang mthon po'am steng go 'phang go gnas sam go sa mthon po 'phrog pa phrogs pa dang 'phrog byed// mtsho dang dud pa'am du ba lbu ba 'phyur ba blud pa 'thul ba thon pa 'tshubs pa dung 'phyur grangs gnas shig lam 'jug ngogs 'phyug pa dang 'phyugs pa gnyis nor ba 'dzol ba 'chugs kyang 'thad// snying don gyi rgyal po'am sems 'phyo ba g.yo ba mi bde ba'i don 'phyon ma smad 'tshong ma 'jug mthun mas phye rtsam sogs spun pa 'phyar ba phyar ba rlung la bstan pa bkag pa'am brkyang ba lta bu 'phangs pa 'phen pa chud zos pa 'phangs bstod smad kyang*// 'phongs tshos rkub tshos tshang ra rkub kyi ming 'phag 'phag gyen du 'phag tshul lam yang yang 'phag pa mgo bo dang thum po 'phur ba mnyed pa dang mkha' la 'gro ba// 'phong mda'am mda' rig 'phong dpyad 'phong skyen sna lnga dag gis gzhan pha rol 'pham pa pham pa glags rnyed pa thub pa 'phal ka ri mo'am shing sogs sbyor mtshams kyi kha 'grig pa sgrig pa// 'phyan pa dbang med du 'khyam pa'am yan pa'i don yin zhing 'phyo ba g.yo ba'am lding ba lding lding byed pa dar bo che sogs 'phyar ba phyar ba slong ba 'phral ma myur ba de ma thag glo bur te 'phral du song lta bu// 'phrin gzhan la bskur ba'i gtam mam lon te 'phrin yig 'phrin pa lta bu 'phrod pa sprod pa mthun pa phan pa'ang 'phrod pa 'chi 'phras shi sdug gam mya ngan sems snying la 'phreng ba ni 'dzin pa ma brjed par dran pa chags pa dang bgrang 'phreng*// 'phral ba gdong gi dpral ba dang so sor phral ba skra dang bal 'phyings pa dam du 'brel ba'am phyir pa ltar gyur pa phyag dar phyags snyigs 'phyag pa phyags pa byi dor byas pa// 'phyang ba thur du dpyang ba mchu 'phyang rna 'phyang lta bu dang 'phye ba 'gro ba'am brang sogs kyis 'gro ba dang bgrad kyang yin snyam 'phang 'phres 'phral 'phags 'phul rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul 'phar 'phyangs 'pho 'phos 'phan 'phel sogs 'as 'phul pha'o//

(ba) ༈ bla ma ni gong ma steng ma phyi ma dam pa slob dpon lci ba'i don bla na gong na'am gong ma na sogs bla bre mchod rdzas sam thog yol bre ba dang bres pa phan tshun sbrel pa sbras pa// byams pa bde ba dang ldan 'dod phan 'dod mdza' ba ma pham pas byad mthu gnod pa mya ngan byur mya ngan ltas ngan gang tshul byabs pa thur du 'then pa'am 'og tu 'dren pa dang sel ba dor bas byer ba bros pa 'thor ba song ba khyab pa// bre 'jal byed bre bo che bre kha la sogs pa yi don bye ma phye ma gaṅgā'i bye ma sogs kyis brabs pa 'brab pa gtor ba snun pa rgyab pa 'ju bas byang ba sbangs pa sbyangs pa mkhas pa 'byongs pa dag pa// bran pho mo g.yog pho mo byes gzhis min pa phyogs byes pa sogs byon pa 'byon pa phebs pa byung ba byug pa snum sogs 'byug rdzas byin pa sbyin pa ster ba gnang ba// byis pa shed ma bye ba skye 'phags mkhas blun rgan gzhon gyi zlas phye ba'i byis pas bya ra lta rtog spyan pa mel tshe'i ming bya ba dgos pa las ka mdzad pa bya ba'i las byos shig gyis shig blugs shig /bram ze brāh+ma ṇa zur chag pa ste tshangs pa'i bu rgyud rigs bzhi'i gcig brag gi ri bo dang brag zhun brag skyibs lta bu'i don byang phyogs bzhi'i ya gyal du grags byol ba 'dzur ba'am yol ba 'byol ba byol cig kyang*// bya 'dab chags dang rus shig dang bgyi byi'u bya chung ngam bya phrug byi ba lo skor bcu gnyis kyi dang po byi la byi ba'i dgra byad bzhin dbyibs tshugs dgra// byol song dud 'gro dang thogs med du 'gro ba brang gis 'gro ba sbrul la sogs pa'i ming brang lus kyi mthong ga dang bla brang pho brang byil byil bshud pa'am bshad pa'i tshul lam dbyibs lta bu// bla gab steng ngam thog g.yogs bla gos steng ngam stod gos blus pa blu ba rin gyis nyos pa blus shig kyang go bla rung bzod chog

/blun pa sems med lta bu'am rmongs pa po can nam bdag sgra yin snyam 'dam dang chur bying ba nub pa sbyings pa blo gros rig pa shes rab blong blong po rtab rtab po tshabs tshabs po mi bde ba rig pa mi gsal ba// bro nad kyi ming bro 'tshal ba na ba thabs sgrub byed dang bral ba zhes pa 'bral ba 'phral ba spangs pa bro bor ba mna' bskyal ba'am sgog pa bros pa 'bros pa 'khyus pa bros shig /byan mo g.yog mo'am thug tshod ma'i don byi bo byi byed po gzhan gyi chung ma spyod mkhan nam 'chal po dang byi mo byi phrug kyang mtshon par byed rang byan chud pa rang dbang thob pa'am gyur pa// byag mkhan mda' mkhan nam gar mkhan bro zhabs bro gar zlos gar lta bu bye ba grangs shig dang rgyas pa dang bral bas brel ba dal khom med pa// kha'i so yis blad pa ldad pa 'cha' ba bcem pa chu chang blud pa ldud pa ster ba zas thug brims pa 'brim pa ster ba 'dren pa brims shig brod pa dga' ba dang rtse ba brod po rtsed mo'am dga' po// bya na bya ny+pan zur chag thug pa'am tshod ma ste spags ma'am ro gsal ba'i don yo byad spyad dngos byur bu gang tshul lam phyur bur go blugs pa blug pa bcug pa ldugs pa blugs shig kyang*// da byid stobs skyed sman skyin gor ro rgod dri bro ba myong ba tshor ba bra ba byi ba lta bu'i sems can brun lud skyag bya brun lta bu// dong khung sogs su brubs pa 'brub pa nang du bcug pa mi thar bar byed pa brubs shig chu bo brug pa rgyas pa gang ba bru ba tsha ba dang bru ba ni ltogs pa bkres pa// gos gyon gos sogs byer ba dman pa zhan pa ngan pa yin snyam gos byed ltar na tshem bu pa btso blag tshos sam khrus btso blag mkhan lta bu gos sogs kyis byibs pa g.yogs pa bkab pa// bla gnyan po gnad rten rtsa ba yin snyam tshe bla'i don nam srog byang bu brjed byang chung ba kha ming mdzad 'gyur shing byang lta bur go ba bla tshon ser po zhig byugs pa bskus pa 'byug pa byugs shig

/kha dang lag pa yis blangs pa len pa blang ba sgrub pa 'jug pa bla thabs brjod bde'am rung thabs bde blag sla ba glo bur sa bla sa steng ngam sa las 'phags pa'i steng gis khyer ba khur ba// blo rig brid pa 'brid pa bslus pa bla dwags ming gi rnam grangs sam ming btags pa'am thogs pa yi ge ri mor bris pa bkod pa bri ba bris shig kyang*// spu skra byi ba ma btogs kyang med par gyur pa dang ri mo byi ba yang cha byad cha lugs gzi byin gzi brjid zil nus pa bri ba 'bri ba nyams pa 'grib pa 'brid pa// byi bzhin dang bra nye gnyis skar ma tha dad par go bra bo 'bru'i khyad par rgya bra sogs phye rtsam chang byo ba 'byo ba blug pa// byug ris gral lam go rims bya ba bgyi ba'am zer ba'i ming bye brag nang gses khyad par gsal ba la// rgyal po sa skyong gi blon po gros byed po mdun na 'don blo gros kyi mig spyan bde blag bya sla ba dka' tshegs med pa nges par byed pa bgyid pa byed las// blang ba len pa dor ba 'dor ba blon 'debs pa zur nas gros 'debs pa'am ston pa bla bo gtam mam brjod pa la// khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba 'byung ba phyung ba'am phul byung skra kha spu bregs pa 'breg pa gcod pa rna ba nyan byed blags pa rna ba gtod pa nyan pa blogs shig nyon cig /lto gos zas gos brang breng ngan ngon nam gyi na bya dga' gnang sbyin nam zho shar go byin pa ster ba sbyin pa// sman gyi bla ma sman rgyal byang ba spangs pa chub pa rtogs pa'am byang nas shes pa'am goms cha che ba bla na gong na med pa ma mchis pa// gzi byin gyis rlabs pa rlob pa'i ming tsam nus pa'i don 'dra byu ru dang byi ru rin chen dmar po dang brang skyes kha brag byings gtong bra ba byung ba byin rten bong bab col bul ba babs pa bu ga brus brang nge sogs ba rkyang ngo // (dab) dbyen pa mi mthun pa phra ma dbye ba'i ming dang dbye ba phye ba bye brag khyad par bral ba spangs pa chos rnams kyi dbyings rang bzhin khams 'dzin byed 'byung gnas sgra'i skabs byings kyang zer dbyibs gzugs kyi khyad par ring thung sogs// dbye ba byar med pa tha mi dad pa gcig pa dbu ma dang dbung dang dbus ma gsum dkyil ma bar pa mtha' bral gyi don gcig kyang tshig sbyor legs tshul grags pa bzhin byed dbus na mo yang*// dbyu gu chu tshod dang shing bu dang dbyug pa chung ba dbyig pa dang dbyug pa gnyis ber ka'i ming snga ma brda rnying dbyugs pa dbyug pa skyur ba 'phen pa snun pa dor ba yang 'jug med pa 'di da lta ba dang ma 'ongs par 'thad dbyugs shig kyang*// rdzing bu'i chu dbol ba btang ba 'chor ba rtol ba chu dang 'bru dbo ba pho ba 'bo ba bshos pa skar ma'i khyad par la 'jug pa'i dbo dang dbo zla// phyir dbyung ba phyir phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa sun dbyung ba 'byin pa phyung ba bton pa mtshon dang lcags gzer gyis dbug pa phug pa 'bugs pa rtol ba// dbul ba po bkren po med po sprang pos dbugs kha sna'i rlung lta bu dbyung ba phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa nor spyad dngos mi dgag tshig dbrog pa 'phrog pa 'joms pa// tshon rtsi yi ge dbyi ba 'byid pa phyis pa 'dag par byed pa'am sub pa dbyig mo 'jam po la sogs par go dbyig dbyig dbur tshul 'jam 'jam byil byil sgra'i khyad par yang yin snyam dbur ba 'jam por byed pa 'khrud pa// dbon po tsha bo sku mched rtsis pas dbyangs gdangs nga ro 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can ma dbul ba 'bul ba phul ba skur ba sbyin pa mchod pa sma dma' ba'i don yin 'dra mi dgag tshig dbab pa 'bebs pa 'bab tu 'jug pa bab pa sbril na sma 'bebs mi byed pa'i don// dbyig gnyen kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbu mgo rtse mo gong ma gtso bo gzhung bya ba lus kyi dbu zhabs lta bu la go gdugs gur thog kyang dbub pa 'bubs pa phub pa bkab pa lta bu// dbang bskur ba byed rung ba'i dbang sprad pa gtor ba dang blug pa'i don byin rlabs sogs dbab pa 'bebs pa phab pa gtan la dbab pa don la gnas par byed pa 'bebs pa phab pa// bar ma chad pa'i lung dbog pa 'bogs pa phog pa mnod pa len pa sbyin pa nor khur dbog pa 'bogs pa phog pa bzhag pa gtad pa sbyin pa dben pa bas mtha' mi g.yo ba stong pa ste dben sar dben gnas su dbral ba 'phral ba phral ba ral du 'jug pa yang*// dbang phyug u ma'i bdag po sogs dbang ba mnga' ba dang ldan pa byang shar ram dbang can dbang thang mnga' thang kha rje dbyar ka dus shig dbyar gnas dbyar rnga// dbang bya la dbang ba po nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam mi'i dbang po sogs dbyig nor ram rin po che mang po dpral ba sogs dbyes khyon nam rgya che ba// dba' rlabs rba rlabs dbu ba lbu ba skyon dang mar gyis dbags pa 'bags pa bsgos pa bsres pa 'das pa la dbags 'thad dam dpyad// dbre ba dang btsog pa gnyis dme ba mi gtsang ba ngan pa gyong po kha dbri ba 'brid pa phri ba dma' bar byed pa zhe sa gus pa'i don can gyi dba' ste lags so lta bu// dbal zhes pa ni sha nyams shed mo dang rtse mo'am zur dang drod dang tog la 'jug ste rim bzhin rta'i dbal phur ba'i dbal me'i dbal rgyal mtshan gyi dbal lta bu dang shugs kyang yin snyam// zha nye las byas pa'i dbyar 'dab snod stegs sam dge slong ma'i lhung bzed kyi stegs bu dang dbyig dug dbyig 'dzin yid dbyung phongs pa'i dbul ba dbad pa dbyings mnga' sogs das 'phul ba'o//

('ab) rab tu 'byams pa dang 'byams klas pa gnyis mtha' klas pa'am mang po snga ma bsdus na lha rams lta bu 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhi grangs 'brug dbyar rnga'am sprin sgra// 'bral ba bral ba med pa dgag tshig dang 'brel pa'am ba sbrel ba phan tshun sbyor ba mthun pa nye 'brel 'gal 'brel 'bras bu bskyed bya gzhag bya don dgos pa dngos po 'bru nas gro sogs dang 'bru ma rdog ma dang tshugs// 'bring po bar ma dkyil 'dam chur 'bying ba bying ba nub pa 'brum pa ni nad kyi khyad par 'brum dkar nag 'byang ba byang ba sbyong ba lto ba 'khru ba dag pa// 'brog dben pa dgon pa yul 'brog gi ming 'bri mo gnag gi khyad par 'brong ri dwags g.yag rgod rus kyi bye brag gcig la 'brom du grags// 'byung bar 'gyur ba ma 'ongs pa'am skye 'gyur tshe 'byid pa phyid pa 'tsho ba tshe mgo 'thon pa'am skyel ba 'drid pa'i don la 'byid pa 'thob cing dbyi ba'i don yang yin// skra sogs 'bal ba 'dzings pa gcod pa bshig pa 'bel ba legs pa yang dag pa chos mthun gyi gtam mchid sgo srol me tog 'bye ba bye ba rgyas pa bral ba 'byed pa phye ba dbye ba 'joms pa 'phral ba rgyas pa// 'bras chan btsos pa'i 'bras lce ro 'dzin pa yis 'byog pa ldag pa 'dag pa chang phye 'byo ba byo ba snod gcig nas gcig tu blug pa byos pa 'byangs pa dag pa lto ba 'khru ba chu la sbangs pa'ang yin snyam// 'brom gyi rus 'dzin dge bshes ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'byon pa byon pa phebs pa 'byung ba'i dus tshe skabs 'bros pa bros pa 'khyus shing rjes su 'brang ba 'brangs pa 'gro ba snyeg pa 'jug pa// 'brub pa brubs pa bcug pa'i khung bu kha 'byed pa kha dbye ba phye ba 'byol ba byol ba 'jur zhing 'byer ba byer ba nyams pa 'bros pa 'gro ba// mtshang skyon 'bru ba 'dru ba sngog pa brus pa'i ming tshig drungs 'byin pa 'don pa phyung ba tshon snum 'byug pa skud pa byugs pa 'byongs pa byang ba 'byang ba 'byangs pa sbyong ba spangs pa goms pa dag pa 'khru ba 'byongs shig kyang*// mtsho kha 'bri ba bri ba 'grib pa dman pa dang yi ge 'dri ba chu 'brub pa 'phel ba rgyas pa 'khol ba brubs kyang 'thad snyam sbyar ba'i don ston pa la 'byar ba 'jug mod byed po dang dngos su 'brel ma 'brel gyi khyad par yod tshul 'di kho bos kyang bsres nas bkod pa rnams phyed dgos rtags 'byar 'byar ma lta bu dang 'byor ba'i sbyor yang*// 'byung ba po sems yod dang khyad par gdon gyi rigs dang skye ba po'i don 'byor pa longs spyod son pa 'thob pa mthun pa dang 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba rus kyi 'bal zhabs 'brid 'bre 'bred pa nad kyi 'bras 'bags pa 'brongs sogs 'as 'phul ba'o//

(rba) khyi sogs rbad pa rbod pa 'gyed pa gtong ba skul ba mngag pa rbab ri nas 'gril ba'i rdo sgril ba 'gril ba kha rbad kha 'bras sam kha bshad dam kha sgrom che ba// rba dba' rlabs klong 'khor skya rbab bad kan gyi dbye ba zhig skra dang bal rbad rbod 'phyings pa'i tshul lam phying ba ltar gyur pa dang*// rbod ma mthu byad dam than skyel ba gtong ba yang na ma dgag tshig sngo lo ma phyar yang yin 'dra rbad bya rbod byed rbad rbod cig dang rbod gtong rbad gcod sogs rar btags ba'o// (lba) lbu ba chu'i dbu ba lba ba ske sogs kyi sha lhag g.yang lba byur lba sogs lar btags ba'o// (sba) nor sogs sbyin pa byin pa ster ba gnod pa sbyin pa gdon zhig sbyin pa'i bdag po yon bdag sbron pa grogs 'bod pa bcol ba 'gugs pa sbron cig dang*// sbun pa 'bru sogs kyi shun pa'am skogs snying po med pa sbangs rta skyag gam lud dang sbang ma sbang glum mam glum gyi bcud phyung ba'i snyigs mas sbangs pa sbang ba rlon pa byas pa// sbug phug gam nang sbug ma nang ma khang pa sogs kyi sbug tu go nor gter sba bya sbas zin pa sbos shig sbed byed de bzhi po'i don skung ba gsang ba srung ba// nyis sbrag nyis sbrel sum sbrag rkyang pa dang sbrag ma lta bu sbra nag tshang ngam gur 'bubs pa phub la sbrel ba sbyor ba sdeb pa 'brel nas sbyar ba sbyor ba sdeb pa// sbres pa 'khyags pa'am grang nas sbur ma rtsi shing chang chung ngam rdul lta bur go me sgron sbar ba dang sbor ba gnyis spor ba 'bar ba spor cig kyang*// chu sogs kyis sbrus pa bsnos pa bkrus pa zas zan sbrus pa brdzis pa g.yos pa phyogs gcig logs shig tu sboms zhes pa sbom dang sbams 'byung ba ltar na skul tshig tu gzung la don sdom pa sdud pa sre ba// sbrum ma mngal ldan ma she sbyor ma lto ba mgo sbos pa skrangs pa gang ba srog chags kyi khyad par zhig la sbre zer// phyag sbal btson khang ngam btson dong grog ma dang sbur ba 'bu zhig sbal pa lce med sbrul mig thos// grogs ra mda' sbran pa sbron pa sbungs pa grims pa stobs 'bad pa skyed pa spel ba sbud pa 'bud byed mi chas la sogs pa'i ming sbubs nang ngam khog stong rgya bu ga pad sbubs smyug sbubs// sbyig mo sgren mo'am gcer bur go sbyig pa 'dred pa 'byid pa la 'jug cing sbe ga shed tshad pa'am dbyug res byed pa'i ming sbyong ba sbyang ba sbyor ltar na sbyar ba// sbyag pa sha skam pa'am rid pa rdzud pa'i tshe dus kyi don yin snyam ste dpyad lus rkang sbrid pa ste rkang pa sbrid na 'ja' zhing mi 'gro mi nus pa lta bu sba shing gi 'khar ba sba dbyug ste lcag sbom pa phra min rags pa sdom pa// sha la 'khor ba'i sbrang bu dang sbrang ma ra yig gnyis pa sbrang ma'i rtsi me tog bcud dang sbrags pa sbrag pa sbrel ba// sbed byed rdo ba gor ma gser sogs kyi sbram bu gru bzhi lta bu'am lhad med dang lci ba'am brling ba sa le sbram gser rin chen dang po dang zangs sa le sbram yang*// sbyor ba sngon 'gro rigs pa thabs rnal 'byor sbyar ba sgom pa sdeb pa 'khrig pa sbyang bya spang bya 'dag bya bslab bya sbyong byed spong byed 'dag byed slob byed sbyangs pa spangs dag bslabs pa// dge sbyong sangs rgyas sogs gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa sogs gtsang sbra gtsang ma dag pa sbyor ba sbyar ba sbyor cig kyang*// 'doms gsang gnas kyi sba ba sba bya ste pho rtags dang sbrib sbribs sbreb sbrebs g.yal ba'i sbrid sbeg sbad sbyang sbags sbams sbyong sbyongs chu la sbengs byed sbongs shig kyang 'thad snyam lus kyi sbo sogs sar btags ba'o//

(ma) ༈ ro dus mtshan srog bral ba'i lus myags pa rul pa ro myags 'dam sogs myag myog ljan ljin nam mi gsal ba nags tshal sogs su myul ba gnyul ba 'tshol ba rgyu ba myur ba mgyogs pa la// nyams ro myong ba myang ba tshor ba myong cha myu gu gsar skyes ljang pa'i ming nas myug sogs ro mngar ba sogs myang ba myong ba bro ba myos pa bzi ba'am dga' ba// myang 'das mya ngan las 'das pa thar pa nges par song ba myang myang gug gug gam 'gro tshul myug myug khyag khyug gam 'tshol tshul lam dmyugs tshul dang // mya ngan sems kyi sdug bsngal lam mi bde ba mya ngam dgun dung ngam chu med pa mya ngam thang lta bu dang myos 'gyur myangs myongs shig mog mog mad pa mal mul mes po ma rkyang ngo // (dam) dmag g.yul lam tshogs dag gi ming nyes dmigs nyes pa'am mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dmangs ni rigs bzhi'i ya gyal dman pa tha ma tha shal dma' ba phri ba'am med pa// dme po rus gcig pa gsod mkhan dmus long mig med pa ldongs pa dmigs bu long khrid pa long sna 'khrid mkhan med pa// dmu rgod gyong po gtum pa dmu chu dmu rdzing ste chu nad 'dre srin gyi khyad par la 'jug pa'i dmu gdon zhig chu nad kyi bdag po// blo rig dmun pa blun pa mi gsal ba dmus byung tshi chad pa spro shi ba yi chad pa bu ga'i don can gyi dmig khung bu// gtsang ma dag pa dme ba dbre ba btsog pa 'dzum dmul ba cung zad rgod pa rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzum dmul dmul yang dmigs pa dmigs bya dmigs byed mthong ba bsam pa sgom pa gnad myong ba gtod pa gtad pa// lag dmar lag pas khag khur ba dang bshan pa kha dmar khas khag khur ba 'gan dang kha gsal dang kha dmar gdags pa thag gcad pa lta bu kha dog mdog dmar ba'am po mtshal mdog lta bu// nyams shing dmas pa rgud pa 'grib pa nyag phra ba dmod pa btsugs pa dang dmod pa 'dor ba gnyis smon lam ngan pa 'debs pa dmod mo byed pa bden pa bdar ba lta bu// dmyal ba chags pa'am dga' ba med pa tsha dmyal sogs gnas go sa dma' ba dmas pa dma' mo'i bya ba dman pa dmigs kyis bsal ba spyir btang ma yin pa logs su bkar ba nges gzung dmigs kyis phye ba dang // myug myug byas te dmyugs pa btsug pa 'dzul ba 'thon pa 'tshol ba myug myug gi bya ba yin 'dra dmar khrid dmar ser mod mi dma' dmigs bcas dmigs med dmigs rnam dmag dpon mi dpung lha min dmyal theg blo skye dman sogs das 'phul ma'o//

(rma) rmad du byung ba phung byung ngo mtshar 'phel ba dam pa rmugs 'dzin rmugs ldan gnod sbyin gyi bye brag dzam+bhal rmi lam gnyid kyi 'khrul snang ste gnas skabs bzhi'i gcig rmang lam yang zer rmis pa rmi ba gzim lam 'byung ba rmi lam mthong ba// rmang rtsa ba'am 'gram gzhi nas rmo ba dang rmos pa gnyis rmod pa zhing gi phru slog pa'am rmon pa rgyab pa rmon pa rmo ba'i ming dor cha zung 'dra ba dang // rmongs pa gti mug ma rig pa bdag lta mi shes pa rmugs pa gdon zhig dang rig pa mi gsal ba bying ba'i rnam grangs kyang yin khyi yis rus pa ril bu rmur ba sos bcem pa'am bcag nas bldad pa 'cha' ba mur ba rmugs pa gso 'debs pa'am rgyab pa dang gnod pa'i ming rma lhan skyes dang gsar byung gi rma dang bu ga dang skyon dang rus shig /rmen pa tshil la yod pa'i sha nag dang rma shul rmen bu yang zer rta rmig rta sogs kyi rkang lag gi rwa rmig pa dang rgya dngul rta rmig ma sga yi chas rmed rnga mar bskon bya// rmongs bu blun po gsang gnas kyi spu rmeg med gtan nas med pa gtan med ming med sun pa'i don can gyi rmus pa skyo ba mtsher ba yi chad pa// ser rme ser sna 'jungs pa bsris rme sri ba phri ba ser sna byed pa lta bu ngo mtshar la go ba'i rmad rmad byung rmad po che lta bu// rmo mo a phyi dang ma phyi dang rgan mo bal sogs rmel ba gsed pa dang 'khal ba yang yin snyam dris pa'i don can gyi rmas pa rmed pa rmad pa gtam 'dri ba zhu ba// rma bya mdongs mtha' can khams rmya ba khams nyog pa rid pa nyams pa bya rmyang gar ram rkyong shad byed pa bgyid pa// rmog mgo rmog dang go cha spyi mtshon las skyob byed dang dbu rmog mgo rmog dang dbu 'phang dang ya lad kyang rmas pa rmas ma rmod pa rmed pa rma dang rmig bu sogs rar btags ma'o// (sma) sman nad gso byed kyi rdzas dang spod sogs dang sman pa lha rje 'tsho byed gso ba po'i ming gtam mchid smra ba smras pa bshad pa smros shig smra ba'i skul tshig

/smig rgyu ri dwags sred chu ltar snang ba smag rum mun rum smag smun pa dang sman zhig zong ma min pa la go ba'i smar gces pa gser dngul lta bu// sman skye ba'i ljongs yul sug smel sūk+ṣ+mil zur chag pa el phra mo ste sman zhig smyag shad shing gi khyad par dang // smyug ma shing zhig smyug rtsi cu gang dong lta smyi gu smyu gu ste 'bri byed dam smyug chung smyig ma shing smyug ma smin pa tshos pa thul ba spyad rung gzags rung*// tshe khog sku lam grong smad smad cha stod min pa sma phab pa sma 'bebs pa'am skyon brjod pa smad ra bstod ra min pa'am smod pa'i ming tsam dang brnyas thabs kyis smod pa smad pa 'phya ba dma' bar byed pa// mgo sogs smyung ba ring po'am dbyibs 'jong mo smrang ba smra ba'am gsang ba dang smre sngags sdug skad dam 'o dod smras pa smra ba bshad pa// bu smad ma bu gnyis ka'i spyi ming ming mtshan nas smos pa brjod pa bshad pa smyan ka gnyen ka bag ma gtong len gyi thabs byed pa bgyid pa lhag ltung zhig kyang*// ngur smrig ja hong dang dmar ser rnam par smin pa 'bras bu spyi tsam dang 'bras lnga'i gcig dang byed par yang go smos pa ci zhig dgos te bshad mi dgos// smyung bar gnas pa chos kyi dka' thub byed pa'am ltogs skom du gnas pa dus tshod smyur myur ba'am myur bcug pa smyon pa smyo mkhan smyo ba smyos pa sems rnal du mi gnas pa'am 'khrul ba// smon 'drin grogs po blo brlug dri med dag pa dri smed ltar na gtam 'dri ba'i don du bshad kyang de la dri rmed 'thad snyam ste dpyad smon lam 'dod don la smon cing 'dun pa'i ming tsam sman pa phan pa sman gyur cig phan gyur cig lta bu// smin drug dang smal po dang smin drug gi bu gsum skar ma'i khyad par// lus kyi sme ba sha thig smug po'i rtsi 'bri mog gam ri tshos kha dog mdog smug po rgya smug lta bu// sma ra kha spu smin ma mig spu smin 'khyog lta bu sme sha can sme can nam rigs ngan// nag rtsis kyi sme ba gcig dkar sogs dgu dang smon pa smad pa smyos pa smin byed smyung smred pa smad 'tshong smas pa smrig smre pa sogs sar btags ma'o//

(tsa) ༈ tsab tsub tshab tshub mi brtan pa mi bya mi bgyi tsog tsog pu tsog pu 'dug stangs shig /tsan dan tsan+dan zur chag pa tshim byed dam 'bar byed de shing zhig tsaṣu ta a mra'i khyad par ro skyur shas can gyi shing tsam pa ka me tog dang grong khyer zhig tsam+pa ka zur chag /tsa ko ra bya gong ma sreg gam mig mdzes shing zla ba'i bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bya dang tsi ti mo byi'u 'am bya chung zhig /ne tso 'dab chags lce gnyis pa de tsam pa de snyed pa tsam zhes pa tshad 'dzin dang nges gzung gi sgra de tsug de 'dra'am de ci 'dra lags yin nam red 'di tsug sogs// tse ne ce re 'am 'dug tshul tse re skad tser tser tsa ri ba gnas tsa rir sdod mkhan// tsā ru zhes pa'i don bza' ba'am lha bshos dang mdzes pa tsa na ka sran chung zhig /tsug tsug kha nas tsug tsug zer ba'i sgra dang tsan+d+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsog pu ni tsu la sogs tsa rkyang ngo // (gtsa) gtsug tor spyi tor spyi bo dang gtsug gnyis mgo bo'am rtse mo gtsang khang dri gtsang khang ngam 'du khang gi sbug khang gtsang ba dag pa btsog pa med pa// mi gtsigs pa mi rigs pa'am mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byed tshul gtsug lag sde snod dam gsung rab kyi khang pa gnas// gtsod ri dwags shig rus rus pa'am ru'am rwas gtses pa 'tshe ba gzir bar byas shing gtser ba mi rigs byed pa'am 'tshe byed kyis gtses pa sun par byas pa'am gtses shig /mche ba gtsigs pa sgrig pa sbyor ba rtseg pa gtsub byed kyi shing dang gtsub bya'i gtan gyi shing gtsubs pa gtsub pa brdar ba 'drud pa skyod pa// gtso bo rang bzhin spyi khyab rje bo gnad mgon po snying po gtsigs gces spras sam rtsa ba che ba chen po gtsag bu gtsag byed kyi mtshon chung ngam gtar spyad kyis gtsags pa gshags pa gtar ba bkas pa bton pa gtsag pa// gtsang chu chen nam dbus kyi cig shos sam dag pa'i phyogs ngos kyi don gtsang chu yang de bzhin du sbyar gtso ba gtse ba gtsang ma mi gtsang ba gtsub pa gtsag pa sogs gas 'phul tsa'o/

(btsa) btsan pa ldog pa med pa 'da' bar mi byed pa 'gyur mi nus pa dbang ba gnyan pa btsan po btsan pa po'am btsan pa'i ming gnya' khri btsan po srong btsan sogs bka' gsung btsan po 'da' mi nus pa'am gnyan pa rdzong mkhar btsan po bgrod dka'am 'gyur mi nus pa dang // btsun mo rje mo rgyal po'i chung mar go bu phrug btsas pa btsa' ba skyes pa 'khrungs pa gru gzings ko btsas gla ste gru phud pa'i rngan pa'am yon btsal ba 'tshol ba gnyul ba brtag pa// btsun pa gtso bo khrims ldan grwa pa spyi dang bye brag la zhe sa'i brda mig kha btsums pa 'dzums pa zum du 'jug pa btson gyi ra ba btson khang la sogs par go btsud pa 'dzud pa nang du bcug pa// gos gyon pa btsems pa 'tshem pa drubs pa btsem pa btsag sa tshos sam sa tshon dmar po sogs dang btsod dmar tshos shing tshos kyis snam bu sha gser btsos pa mdog sgyur ba smin pa bzhus pa 'tshed pa// btsan dug bong nag sogs tshags 'tshag byed kyis btsags pa 'tshag pa dwangs snyigs phye bar shes dgos shing btsir ba 'tshir ba phyung ba bar du btsir ba// lcags btsa' g.ya' yis khyer ba ste g.ya' rgyab pa 'bags pa la go ba'i btsog pa mi gtsang ba dbre ba btso blag tshos sam khrus mkhan byed po// mtho btsams pa mtho 'tshams pa co 'dri ba 'gran pa gnod pa rdeg pa la go ba'i btsog pa 'tshog pa rdung ba btsog po rdo ba skyug bro bo ngan pa'am mi legs pa pho btsog pho rgod rdeg pa rdung ba// btsan 'dre'i khyad par rgod po btsan thabs thabs btsan pa glo bur gser rin chen dang po btso ma bzhu btul byas pa'am lhad med kyi zhun ma ste btso ma'i gser sogs// srol ka btsugs pa 'dzugs pa btod pa phye ba shing rkang 'thung btsugs pa 'dzugs pa bskyed pa btab pa bsnun pa slong ba btod pa sgog pa ke'u btsong kun dong ngam 'tshong ba btsongs pa btsong pa 'tshong ba rdzas brje ba// btsad po rgyal po btsas ma lo tog brnga bya ste 'tsho skyong byas pa'i don 'dra btsa' ba btso ba la btsas btsun ma btsem pa mtho btsam pa sogs bas 'phul tsa'o/

/ (rtsa) rtsa lag gnyen nam nye 'brel rtsa ba gzhi ma drung sdong po'i 'og cha shod skyed byed gtsigs gnad sdom rtse mo mchog ma mgo steng ma gong ma phul byung rab tshon rtsi mdog sgyur byed dam ri mo 'bri byed kyi rdzas rtsing ba zhib min rags pa sbom pa rtsing po rtsing ge /rtsi mar 'o zho rtsi tog gi mar rtsi shing gzhi mthun gyi sgra'am rtsi dang shing rtsi thog rtswa'am sngo'i 'bras bu rtswa sngo gzan pa sogs// 'thab rtsod 'khrug rtsod rtsod pa 'thab pa mi mthun par smra ba rgol ba rtsed mo rtsed 'jo rol rtsed rtse ba dang rtses pa'am rtses shig dang rtsen pa rnams rol ba rtsed mo rtse ba// lngas rtsen pa mi spyi'am lha'i dbye ba sum rtsen pa skabs gsum pa lha rtsis grangs sam rtsis rig rtsis mkhan rtsis pa rtsi po// rtsib ma glo g.yas g.yon gyi rus thur lta bu'i ming rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum sogs sbubs can rgyus pa chu ba rtsid pa g.yag gi spu lta bu rtsub pa mi 'jam pa gdung ba skya ba gyong ba yid du mi 'ong ba rtsub mo// kha rtsang grong tshig la kha sang ngam khar sang yod rtse rgod rtse zhing rgod pa lha 'bangs g.yog po rtsam pa phye rin pa gong rtseg pa spar ba rtseg rtseg byed pa// rtsabs ni gcod pa'am cog rtse sogs mi 'gul bar byed pa'i shing lta bu yin snyam rtsad gcod rtsad rtsa ba nas gcod pa dang rtsa ba'am rjes gcod pa tsher ma la go ba'i rtsang ste mdos rtsang rtsang phur yang*// stobs la go ba'i rtsal pha rol gnon pa'i bya ba 'bad pa dang rtsol ba brtson pa dang 'du byed dang brtsal ba rtsom pa bya ba'am mgo 'dzugs pa'am gsung rtsom rtsom pa brtsam pa sbyor ba// zho sogs kyi rtsabs rtsi'am ru rtsi rtsab mo chang 'dra ba'i skom mam btung ba zhig ser po'i mdog 'dzin gyi rtsa ba lcum lta bus btsos pa'i gos gyon pa sogs// rtsig pa rtsig skyabs sam rtsig bzhin pa rtsig mkhan rtsig pa po rdo bzo lta bu 'khor lo gdugs la sogs pa'i rtsibs rkang ngam thur ma lta bu lte rtsibs mur khyud// rtsangs pa skyin gor gyi bye brag rmig pa'am yan lag gi rlung lnga'i gcig srog rtsol rlung ste tha dad du phral ba yang snang rtsoms shig rtseg rtsegs shig rtseg rtseg bdud sra gla zhag rtsi gzhi rtsa ma rtsa rtsad chod sogs rar btags tsa'o//

(stsa) bka' gsung stsal ba gnang ba dngos grub thun mchog gi grub pa stsal pa sbyin pa'am gnang ba dang stsol byin cig gam sbyin pa// sbyin pa stsal ba sbyin pa'am gtang bar bgyi bya bgyid du stsal ba byed du bcug pa las la sbyar ba// stsal du gsol gnang ba'am sbyin par mdzod dam zhu zhes pa'i don yin la dus gsum gyi tshe phal cher stsal zhes 'byung zhing sngon 'jug sbyar na 'das ma 'ongs go bar ma zad bsal ba'i don yang ston bya bar stsal ba sogs sar btags tsa'o// (brtsa) brtson pa ni 'grus pa 'bad pa snying brtse ba snying po ltar brtse ba ste snying rje brtse ba can brtse ldan snying rje can// brtsad pa rtsod pa brgal ba rtsad bcad pa la 'jug cing dris pa rmas nas brtsam bya bstan bcos sam bya ba lta bu brtsams pa rtsom pa sbyar ba byas pa// khang bu yi ge brtsegs pa rtseg pa gcig steng du gcig bzhag pa lta bu brtsigs pa rtsig pa steng nas steng du sgrig pa lta bur go dgos shing brtsi bya bgrang bya bkur bya yon tan sogs brtsis pa rtsi ba bgrangs pa rtsis pa skor ba bkur ba// kha'i so sogs brtse ba mi bzod pa ste lcags drad drad byas pa las so brtse ba lta bu ha cang shin tu brtsengs pa bstungs pa'am 'jol ba min pa'i don gos bgo bya// brtsig brtseg brtsal ba sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i tsa'o// (tsha) ༈ shing nags kyi tshal nags ma skyed mos tshal dga' tshal lam ldum dang 'bras shing gi ra ba dang shing nags tsam yang tshi gu 'bras bu'i nang gi rus pa kham bu'i tshi gu lta bu'i ming tshigs ni mtshams sam bar mtshams gcod byed dang snyigs ma ste tshigs pa tshigs ma lta bu// tshogs pa 'dus pa phung po sde ba'i don sde le don chos las tshan dum bu tsho khag tshan pa drod kyi tshan dang shed kyi tshan dang yang lus kyi lang tsho na tshod lon// tshon rtsi tshon nam mdog sgyur byed kyi rdzas rin po che'i phra 'bru lha'i tshom bu tshogs chung ngam tshan pa tshar gral du dngar ba 'grig pa// the tshom blo rtse gnyis som nyi tsham rngams 'jigs tshul lam 'jigs pa 'ju byed la go ba'i tshwa zas kyi ro bro byed sogs te tshwa zhes tshig grogs med pa'i rkyang pa la smad 'dogs yod cing rgya tsha zhes pa lta bu'i tshig grogs sbyar na med par phyag len mdzad la 'on kyang lan tshwa la yod pa mang ngo*// khang pa spyi dang bye brag la go ba'i tshoms te sde tshan la yang 'jug ched du brjod pa'i tshoms sogs dang tsha tsho tshe tshems tshus tshir tshig tshogs tshes tshar tshal tshul tshil tshi tshong ba sogs tsha rkyang ngo*//

(mtsha) ngo mtshar rmad byung khyad mtshar mtshan ma mtshon byed so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu mtsho chu gter rgya mtsho sogs dang mtshe'u mtsho chung ba rdzing bu lta bu// mtshe ma mngal gcig nas dus mnyam du skyes pa'i bu mtshams tshigs 'brel lam bar bcad pa phye ba gcod pa mtshams che chung sbyor lta bu mtshan nyid rten pa'am 'brel ba'i gzhi ste mtshan nyid kyi bye brag gam mtshon bya'i khyad par ram dpe dang mtshon byar yang 'jug pa dang*// mtshan nyid mtshon byed go byed mtshan ma rtags rgyu ston byed mtshon bya go bya rtogs bya bstan bya mtshan ma mi nor ba'i rtags rgyu rang bzhin ltas spros pas mtshan byed rtogs byed ston byed dam dpe'am cung zad mtshan ltar na spras pa// phyogs dus kyi mtshams shar lho dang nyin mtshan gyi bar lta bu skyon la go ba'i mtshang nyes pa bcab bya nongs pa mtshan mo mtshan bya bral lam mtshar ba mdzes pa ya mtshan rtsed mo// mtshur rus kyi khyad par te mar pa'i slob ma mtshur ston dbang rdor lta bu kha sna'i mtshul pa kha sna'i nang ngos mtshal tshon dmar zhig ste rgya mtshal sogs dang mtshungs pa 'dra ba mnyam pa// rgyal mtshan ba dan mchod rdzas mtsha' mes gcan gzan 'phar ba mtsha' rta nag dmar mtsha' lu rting pa dkar po dang khyim bya dang dmar po'i don yang yin 'dra// mtshar ba mdzes pa dang skye mched ma 'dres par gsal ba mtshar po mdzes po khyad mtshar po sdug pa mdzes pa yid 'ong khyim mtshes khyim rogs shag mtshes sdum mches mtshe sman zhig ster mtshe lug mtshe lta bu dang mtshan sngo sman zhig ste mtshan dmar lta bu gso gzhung du tshan yang snang*// skye ba gzhan gyis bar mtshams gcad du med par dmyal ba mnar med du skye ba'i las te pha bsad pa sogs lnga dang nye ba lnga dang mtshams med pa la yang go mtsher ba sun pa las byed par mi spro ba skyo ba 'tsher yang 'thad dur mtshed dur gnas sam dur du bcug pa mtshun pha mes sam de'i bla'am lha// mtshon cha gri la sogs pa'i ming phyag na bsnam bya'i mtshan ma ral gri pad+ma lta bu dang mtshan ma mtshon cha mtshog ma skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi'i thad dang spyi bor yang go 'phyar ba gdengs pa// ming gi don ston pa'i mtshan mngon brjod dang spras pa'i mtshan mtshar po khyad mtshar ya mtshan mtshal kha dge mtshan sogs mas 'phul tsha'o//

('tsha) blo sems 'tshabs pa rtab pa brel ba 'jigs pa chu ja 'tshag pa btsags pa dwangs snyigs phye ba nang du ma bos par 'tshangs pa btsangs pa dbang shed lta bus 'dzul ba 'jug pa brlams pa// til snum 'tshir ba btsir ba bkar ba zhum par byed pa 'don pa me yis 'tshig pa tshig pa sreg pa du ba dud pa 'tshubs pa 'phyur ba tshab tshub byed pa// zas gos gser 'tshed pa btso ba smin pa mdog sgyur ba 'ju bar byed pa lus srog 'tsho ba gso ba gson pa 'tsho byed gso byed sman pa skyong byed 'tshengs pa tshim pa dga' ba rgyal ba// 'tshe ba gnod pa gtse ba nye zho med pa dgag tshig 'tshag pa sha nyams rgyas pa'am bzang ba legs pa 'tshal ma zas sam za ma 'tshal ba za ba'am bzhes pa dang 'tshal cig dang shes ma shes sogs// nor sems pa dag 'tshol ba btsal ba gnyul ba rtsad gcod pa brtag pa phyugs dud 'gro 'tsho ba btso ba skyong ba 'tshog chas yo byad dam nyer mkho 'tshong ba btsong ba tshong rgyab pa// brdeg pa la go ba'i 'tshog pa btsog pa'am rdung ba ngal dub 'tsho ba gso ba mnyel gso ba 'od sogs 'tsher ba 'bar ba'am bkrag thon pa rta skad sgrog pa las la sun pa'i don yin zhing*// blo yid dang 'tsham pa mthun pa 'tshams pa ran par go skyin pa tshab ma 'tshab pa bsab pa 'jal ba snon pa// gdung rigs dus 'tshob pa 'dzin pa 'tshang rgya ba sangs rgyas pa byang chub pa longs pa'i don can gyi 'tshar ba cher skye ba'am 'phel ba dang skyed 'thon pa// phyag 'tshal ba btsal ba gus pas 'dud pa shes pa go ba dang tshog pa 'grig pa la go ba'i 'tshal ba 'dod pa dang dgos par yang 'jug /'dzom pa'i don la 'tshag 'jug ste gsog pa dang 'dzem pa dang gnyer ba dang rgyas par yang go 'tshog pa 'tshub pa 'tshams pa spyan gyis 'tsho ba sems 'tshig pa 'tsho mdzad nyer 'tshe sogs 'as 'phul tsha'o// (dza) ༈ dza rag rdza bum sogs snod chung dza lang gtum po'am dred po dza bo ni shing gi bye brag dza ya rgyal ba'am mi pham pa can ldan pa dang dzi na dze ta'i tshal dza ba sogs dza rkyang ngo //

(mdza) dpa' ba'i don can gyi mdzangs pa snying stobs che ba mdza' bo mdza' ba po grogs zla bo'i ming bang mdzod mdzod khang dkor mdzod mdzes pa mtshar ba legs pa mthun pa spud pa// gnod pa la go ba'i mdzes pa ste khro bo gnod mdzes kyang mdzub mo sor mo dang sdigs mdzub mdzod spu sangs rgyas kyi smin phrag na yod pa'i spu dkar po// mdzo pho mo ba mo dang g.yag 'dus pa'i bu rta mgyogs 'gro'i ming mdzer pa sha 'bur ram sha'i gzer bu mdze ni klu nad dam tsi ti dz+wa la dang // mdzol bu ri dwags sogs 'dzin byed kyi rgya dang smad tshong gi bu bsrung ba srung ba'i don mdzad pa bya ba'am 'phrin las mdzod cig byos shig gyis shig /ya rabs la go ba'i mdzangs pa ma rabs min pa kun spyod legs pa dang mkhas pa'i mdzangs pa byams pa'am mthun pa'i mdza' ba mdza' mo sogs mas 'phul dza'o// ('dza) 'dzings pa 'dzing ba 'khrugs pa rtsod pa 'dres pas gos gzan 'dzar ba thur du 'phyang ba ring ba 'jol ba lta bu lag pa sug pas 'dzin pa gzung ba zhen pa gces pa yul can// 'dzag pa zag pa 'bab pa lhung ba 'thon pa dang 'dzir ba btsir ba 'dzag pa'i don snod spyad 'dzed pa bzed pa kha gyen du bstan pa 'dzem pa mi 'jug pa ngo tsha ba bag med mi byed pa rtsi ba dogs pa// 'dzur ba bzur ba 'byol ba mi 'jug pa'i don yin zhing khang pa'i sgo dang khung bur 'dzul ba 'jug pa zul ba 'dzeg pa 'dzegs pa gyen du 'gro ba 'dzeg skas them skas ya gad 'dzugs pa btsugs pa gzugs pa// bzhin ras 'dzum pa dmul ba ngo dkar ston pa cung zad dgod pa 'dzin pa dbang lag dang sngo 'dzim snod nang du 'dzud pa btsud pa blug pa bcug pa// 'dzam bu'i shing gis mtshan pa'i gling ste dzam+bū zur chag pa'i don du gzung 'dzom pa tshogs pa 'dus pa kha tshang ba 'dzom po 'dzoms pa nor rdzas 'dzangs pa dang 'dzad pa gnyis zad pa god pa gtugs pa// 'dzab ni dza pa zur chag pa ste bzlas pa'am brjod pa sngags bzlas lta bu skad 'dzer ba skad 'dzer 'dzer ram tser tser byed pa dang zer ba'am smra ba nor ba'i don can gyi 'dzol ba 'khrul pa// 'du 'dzi g.yeng yul lam rnam g.yeng chud 'dza' ba chud za ba'am zos pa rdo yi 'dzeng rdo'i tshigs sam bye brag

/'khrugs pa'i don can gyi 'dzag 'dzog 'dzings pa 'dres pa sna tshogs dang 'dzing pa 'dzegs pa 'dzums pa 'dzoms pa sogs 'as 'phul dza'o// (rdza) kun tu rdzob pa yang dag par sgrib pa rdzun pa snang ba tha snyad rdzun pa mi bden pa log pa'i tshig slu ba can gyi don rdzab rdzub tsab tsub g.yo zol dang // phyugs gnag gi rdzi bo skyong byed 'tsho byed lta bu'i ming rdzongs skyes sam skal ba'am rngan pa 'bul ba sogs su go rdzi'u rdza ma chung ba rdzi bo chung ba byin pa ster ba// rdzing bu phal cher bcos pa'i mtshe'ur go rdzus te skyes pa pad ma sogs su skyes pa ste skye gnas bzhi'i gcig 'dam pa rdzab rdzog ljan ljin lta bu// rdzi rlung phyogs ngos te rlung rgyu ba'i phyogs rdza ma sa snod rdza khog la sogs pa'i ming bu rdzi bu 'tsho mkhan nam byis pa'i g.yog byed dang // rdzi ring ba'i dri tshor byed med pa dgag tshig khyi lta bu la yod rdzi ma mig lpags kyi mtha' na yod pa'i spu zin pa'i don can gyi rdzogs pa tshar ba dang zad pa// mkhar la go ba'i rdzong ste bgrod dka'i khang pa dang brag rdzong sogs nor rdzas ka ca spyad dngos rdzas zhes pa dngos po rang bzhin bye brag kho na rdzas cha me mda'i rdzas sogs rdzu zhing 'phrul ba smad nas me 'bar stod nas chu 'bab pa sogs dang // rdzogs pa gang ba tshang ba yang dag par sangs rgyas pa shā kya thub pa lta bu dang zog gi rdzu ba phrag rdzong rdze ba rdzu ba rdzi ba nu rdzi rdzong ba sogs rar btags dza'o// (brdza ) gzhan pha rol gyis mi dgag sgra brdzi ba rdzi ba thub pa tshugs pa gnod pa khro bo la sogs par brdzus pa rdzu ba sgyur ba ma yin pa la yin pa ltar byas pa// ral pa skra ring gyen du brdzes pa rdzob slong ba sgreng ba srog chags 'bu brdzis pa mnan pa rdzi ba glebs pa// zan spags brdzis pa bsnos pa mnyes pa rdzi ba yul gzhan sogs su brdzangs pa mngag pa btang ba bskur ba bcug pa rdzong ba dang brdzu ba brdze ba brdzi ba brdzang ba sogs// bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i dza'o//

(wa) ༈ wa skyes sems can wa pha wang bya ma byi'am so gshog gnyis ldan gyi sems can zhig chu 'gro ba'i wa chu 'khrid nus kyi brus pa lta bu'i shing sogs te wa kha yang*// 'gi'u wang glang chen sogs las 'byung ba'i sman rdzas brgyad kyi gcig pi wang sgra snyan tam+būr 'dzum wang wang 'dzum dmul dmul rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur// yid sems la wal le gsal ba'i tshul lam rnam 'gyur wang long rna rgyan nam rna long dang // wa ta ras dang sman zhig dang gru gu yang yin snyam yug ras yug lta bu dang sa sman zhig wal wal wang chung wa sogs wa rkyang ngo // (zha) ༈ zha bo yan lag nyams pa'am zha pa po'i don zhwa mo mgo'i zhwa ste zhu yang zer zhum zhom zhen zhugs zhu zhus zhag zhog zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig zhang zhung bag la zha ba zhun ma zheng zho zhib zho sha sogs zha rkyang ngo // (gzha) ting 'dzin sogs la mnyam pa mtshungs par gzhag pa 'jog pa rjes thob kyi cig shos dang bsal gzhag gzhal bya shes bya'am 'jal byed kyi yul tshad dam rin gyis gzhal du med pa'i khang pa gzhal yas khang*// kun gyi gzhi ma rtsa ba rten sa bon gnas rgyud khams kun gzhi'i rnam shes sogs rnam par gzhag pa tshul lam lugs dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag sogs te 'jog pa'i don nam yang gzhag pa dus gtan nam rgyun pa// gzhon nu na phra'am gzhon pa gzhung khog gam zo bzang po legs pa gzha' tshon 'ja' tshon gyi brda rnying gzhu gnam ru mda' stan te gzung bya'i don 'dra// gzhogs zur gyis slong ba ste gzhan gyi rdzas 'thob par bya ba'i phyir de la bsngags pa byed pa log 'tsho lnga'i gcig bdud dgra nad gzhom pa 'joms pa tshar gcod pa sel ba sbo lus kyi brang dang lto ba'i ngos gzhogs glo'am ngos sam zur sogs kyang go /gnas la go ba'i gzhi rten bslab gzhi gzhi bcu bdun gzhong pa snod spyad ka to ra g.yang gzhi yan lag tshang ba'i pags pa gzhan pha rol lam tha dad dam bdag min pa'am bya las// mngag tu gzhug bya ste pho nya dang bran g.yog khu ba dang nu ma gzhib pa 'jib pa'i don yin la gzhol ba 'bab pa 'jug pa 'du ba thug pa// gzha' gsang g.yung drung ngam rtag pa mi 'gyur ba 'phrin las gzhongs yul ljongs su go lcag sba lcag gis gzhu ba snun pa rgyab pa gzung ba// gzhi grub pa yod pa gzhal bya smos ma dgos pa don la grub pa gzhung bstan bcos sogs kyi lugs ka brtag pa la 'jug pa'i gzhig pa dpyad pa bshig pa bcom pa rjes gzhig lta bu gzhug pa bcug pa byed du 'jug pa// lus kyi ngos sam gzhogs phyed sogs kyi don nad kyi gzhi ma bsnyung gzhi gzhang smad dam 'doms dang bshang lam go zhing bshang lam gyi nang sor bzhi tsam na yod pa'i bur nad la gzhang 'brum zer gzhil ba bcil ba 'jil ba// gzhar yang nam yang ngam slar yang gzhur ba 'jur ba gzhom pa med pa dgag tshig yid gzhungs blo gsal lam 'dzin rtsal che ba mkhas pa gzhob pa 'tshig pa ste bal rwa thab gzhob lta bu// gzhis ka sa zhing sgos gzhis pha gzhis sogs glu dang gzhas gnyis don gcig gzhas gtong ba glu len pa 'tsho gson zhing gzhes pa sdod pa'am bzhugs pa// dran pa mi brjed pa nye bar gzhag pa 'jog pa bzhag pa bsgrigs pa'i don la go ba'i gzhibs pa gshibs pa sdeb pa// gzhen pa legs pa'am phan pa la bskul ba ste gzhen 'debs sam dran bskul sogs nang du gzhug pa bcug pa 'jug pa dang dus kyi gzhes gzhungs pa gzhung bgres gzhon gzhi lam ma gzhi gzhal ba sogs gas 'phul zha'o//

(bzha) gnas su bzhag pa 'jog pa zin pa tshar ba bzhad pa bgad pa'am dgod pa bzhad mo ni gad mo'am bzhad gad dam ga zha bzhad bya'i khyad par te ngang pa yin nam dpyad dkar po bzhi grangs ka /bzhabs pa 'jabs pa gab nas skra spu bzhar ba bregs pa bcad pa bzhams pa 'jam por byas te bsgo ba bslab bya byed pa ste 'dul ba'i brda dran bskul// las brgya nas gsol ba dang bzhi'i las sum cu tsam yod de 'di yang 'dul ba'i brda dgongs pa la go ba'i bzhed pa bsam pa 'dod pa 'thad pa de bzhin nyid chos nyid yang dag mtha'// bzhengs pa langs pa ldang ba bskrun pa bzhugs pa bsdad pa yod pa gnas pa 'byon pa la go ba'i bzhud pa 'jud pa phebs pa song ba nyi ma bzhud pa bzhon pa theg pa rta sogs zhon pa 'chib pa// bzhon ma 'o ma bzho rgyu yod pa'i mdzo mo sogs bzho ba dang bzhos pa gnyis 'jo ba brlan pa la go ba'i gzha' ba gsher ba bzher ba bzhogs pa shing sogs 'jog pa// g.yog dang nor bzhun pa legs pa yid du 'ong ba mar khu bzhu ba bzhus pa skol ba'am 'ju ba bzhur ba dwangs snyigs phye ba'am gud du bton pa sogs nas lhag bcas bzhes pa za ba gyon pa len pa 'thung ba sogs don mang*// bzhin ras zhal ras gdong me bzhi dang gro bzhin dang byi bzhin gsum skar ma'i khyad par// 'di ji de bzhin lta bu 'dra ba dpe sgra khur 'gan bzhes pa len pa snom pa 'khyer ba dpang po la 'jug pa'i che bzhi gnya' bo ste grangs kyi bzhi min par bshad// bzhi mnyam bshang ba'i ming sogs bzhag nang khrol rgyu ma zhig dang bzhus pa bzhun po bzhibs pa tshul bzhin sgye bzhin shes bzhin bzher ba sogs bas 'phul zha'o// (za) ༈ zwa dang zwa tshod ni sngo tshod tsher ldan mi zad pa mi 'dzad pa zad mi shes pa gzhan mchog dman kun la zlo ba bzla ba 'chad pa smra ba// rig sngags sogs zlos pa bzla ba skor ba yang yang brjod pa zlos shig kyang zlos pa'i gar rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig gar 'khrab pa'i ming zla ba ku mud gnyen sogs zlum po dbyibs kyi khyad par gor gor dang ril ril zlum pa// zla gam zla phyed kyi dbyibs dang gos shig zla yis dbye ba grogs kyis phye ba bsdu ba drug gi gcig zlas drangs pa zlog pa bzlog pa log tu 'jug pa dang // zla bo grogs po mched po spun zla lo dus shig zla ba zhag sum cu'i ming mya ngan sems sdug las zlo ba bzla ba 'da' ru 'jug pa sgrol ba// bskyar ba'i don can gyi zlos pa don gcig yang yang 'chad pa ldab pa zlos skyon lta bu dang zlum pa la zlo ba zla bral zam chud za zing zi bo zul ba zag pa zab pa zug pa zer ba zol sbyor zong zum pa zil pa sogs za rkyang nyid do/

/ (gza) gcan gzan stag sogs gzig gcan gzan zhig gi ming gzugs brnyan 'dra cog snang brnyan gzigs pa lta ba shes pa 'tsho ba dgongs pa// gza' nyi ma sogs skar ma bra nye sogs 'od gzer 'od zer snang ba gsal ba gzi brjid gzi byin bkrag zil gzi nor bu khra bo zhig dang nus pa'am zil lam 'od// rngul len pa'i gzan yo byad bcu gsum gyi gcig sogs phrag pa dang snod lta bur gzed pa 'dzed pa bzed cing gzar ba bkal ba dpyang ba// gzong shing sogs rko byed kyi spyad cig gi ming gzeb gur dang smyug gzeb sogs la go gzer bu lcags gzer chung ba sogs gzugs pa btsugs pa 'dzugs pa// gzegs ma zegs ma nyar ma zer ma nyag ma phra ba'i dngos po gzegs can zas kyi zegs ma za zhing 'tsho ba ste bye brag pa'i ston pa sogs gzir ba mnar ba gtod pa snun pa skyen par go gzas pa brdeg par brtsams pa chas pa gtad pa// da gzod da gdod da tsam drin byas pa gzo ba byed pa rtsi ba 'jal ba rtsol ba'am 'bad pa chud mi gzon pa chud mi za ba'am chab mi 'tshal ba// gzu lums rang bzo bab col gzung ba yul lam gzhal bya dang bcang bya 'dzin pa yul can nam 'jal byed dang 'chang ba gzeg cha gnyod ka'am phra dngos chung ba// zug gzer zug cing na ba'am na zug dang gzer bu rgyab pa lta bu la go gzem pa 'dzem pa gzim pa mnal ba gnyid dam gnyid log pa gzim mal nyal sa'am gnas mal gzim shag lta bu zhe sa'i brda yang yin gzud pa btsud pa bcug pa// gze ma gze ma ra mgo zer ba'i tsher ma rtsa ba lnga'i nang tshan gzang ring rtse rno zhing ring ba gzan pa gnod pa gtses pa zad pa gzan po// gru la go ba'i gzings chu sogs las sgrol byed dang 'dzings pa dang gru gzings ma sha khog gi cha zhig la gzug zer te gzug gcig gnyis lta bu zas kyi don la go ba'i gzan zan gyi ming*// phying srin gzar stan nam gdan gzar bu skyogs sam blug byed dgang ba'i gzar bu dang blugs pa'i gzar bu gnyis sbyin sreg gi snod spyad sogs dang sdam shing zhig kyang*// gzengs bstod pa 'dun sar bstod pa'am mtho bar byed pa gzi ni mdangs sam stobs sogs gzod ma gdod ma thog ma'i ming dus tshod// ri gyen gzar po dam po bgrod dka' ba gzugs mo ni byi thur can te sgang gzugs sgang thur dang lus sogs// gzar ba dpyang ba'i thag pa gos kyi gdang bu gzungs tshem bu'i gzungs dang bum pa'i gzungs thag sogs gzabs pa gzob pa bag zon byed pa sgrim pa bstar ba gzabs sprod dang gzabs gzabs kyang go gzags pa 'dzag pa lhung ba// gzungs sngar thos pa'i chos don mi brjed par 'dzin pa spobs pa zad mi shes par 'chad nus pa gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma sogs thugs blo gzu bo drang po ris su mi lhung ba// bsgo ba bslab bya rna bar chun gzon pa mi nyan pa dang gzengs pa gzings pa gzims pa gza' gtad gzu gzugs su rung ba gas 'phul za'o//

(bza) bza' ba bza' bya spyad bya zas bza' ba dang bzas pa gnyis za ba bzhes pa spyod pa gnod pa bud med la go ba'i bza' ni mo'i don te rgya bza' bal bza' lta bu// bza' chung ma'am mo mi khyo'am skyes pa ste don khyo shug bzi ba ra ro ba'am myos pa'i don yin zhing phrad ma dgag sgra bzlugs pa dris pa rmas pa zhus pa blugs kyang go snyam// na bza' gos sam bgo ba bzang po legs pa dge ba phan pa bzang ba lag pa sug pas bzung ba 'dzin pa 'chang ba// bzo bo bzo rig shes mkhan nam bzo byed dam bzo pas lhung bzed yo byad bcu gsum gyi gcig slong phor yang zer bzed zhal zhag blug gam mchil snod bzed pa 'dzed pa gzed pa// bze re mi bzod pa'am sran med pa chung ba ste bzod sran che ba dang gnyod chung yang mi bzad pa ma rungs pa ha cang drag shul tshabs che ba'i las bya ba la bzur ba 'dzur ba gzur ba// bzod pa bsran pa nus pa khro ba spong ba tshogs gnyis bzlums pa bsdus pa 'dums pa dril pa mthun par byas pa ldang bar byas pa ston pas skar rgyal la tshigs bcad kyis bstod pas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs bzlums pa lta bu sngags gzungs bzla ba dang bzlas pa gnyis bskyar ba zlos pa// mi dgag tshig bzlog pa sgyur ba phyir ldog tu 'jug pa zlog pa g.yul dmag bzlog pa zlog pa bkag pa ldog tu 'jug pa'am log par byas pa mya ngan las bzla ba zlo ba bzlas pa// phyogs gcig tu du ma bzlums pa bsdoms pa bsdus pa dang bzlum pa lad mo dang la bzla bzlas bzo bzos bzlug pa bzabs pa bzang ba sogs bas 'phul za'o// ('a) ༈ 'ongs 'ong 'o skol 'on pa 'ug pa 'on cig 'os pa 'ol kha 'ud po che 'og ma 'on tang 'o ma 'obs 'od zer 'o dod sogs 'a nyid do// (ya) ༈ yi rang gzhan gyis byas pa la dga' ba'am dga' ba tsam yi chad pa tshi chad pa yi mug pa yi dwags ngan song gsum gyi gcig dang // mda' yab khang pa'i pu shu rnga ma'i yab ste rlung yab bsil yab sogs dang ya ma zung ya med yur ba yungs kar yol go gam yo yan pa yar ba yal ba yu ba yol ba yos sogs ya rkyang ngo //

(g.ya) g.yor mo gdos pa gru gzings kyi dar po che rlung g.yor g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gnyis 'grul bskyod pa 'gyur ba 'khyog pa brji ba phyi ma g.yos shig kyang g.yab mo g.yab g.yug gam g.yob pa'i ming tsam g.yabs pa g.yob pa g.yab pa bskyod pa 'gugs pa'i brda sogs byas pa// g.yor po yul gyi bye brag g.yung ba 'dris pa'am mi 'drog pa'am brling ba dang zhan pa dman pa za ba 'phrug pa longs spyod pa sogs g.yan pa g.ya' nad dam za phrug gi nad dgab pa 'gebs pa'i gos lta bu ste yo byad bcu gsum gyi g.yan dgab sogs// g.yang sa lhung sa'am sa gzar po mi g.yo ba mi skyod pa mi brdzi ba g.yung drung rtag pa 'gyur med dang bkra shis pa'i ri mo zhig g.yang dpal lam phun tshogs sam phywa// g.yel ba bsnyel ba snyom las brtson med brjed pa g.yeng ba med pa dgag tshig g.yur du za ba lo 'bras rgyas nas thur du 'phyang ba dang smin pa zas dang rgyu ma g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gnyis sbrus pa btsos pa sbyar ba sogs te g.yos zas sbyar zas lta bu// g.yang gi gzhi ma yan lag ldan pa'i pags pa sogs g.yog pa dang g.yogs pa gnyis bkab pa gtums pa bskon pa phyi ma skul tshig kyang g.yer ma spod dam sman zhig rgya g.yer lta bus g.yigs pa skyigs bu byed pa g.yig pa// g.yi gcan gzan zhig lpags shun g.yar ba g.yas pa brnyas nas g.yab g.yug g.yab mo'am g.yab cing g.yug pa g.yob pa g.yabs pa krab krab byed pa// g.yon ma g.yon can ma 'phyon ma dang g.yon mig ma mdzes ma log par g.yem pa 'dod pa ste 'dod log dang g.yem ma sogs g.yeng ba rgod pa 'phro ba skyod pa le lo 'phen pa rnam g.yeng gis g.yengs pa g.yeng ba dang g.yengs shig /g.ya' sgog reg nas gad mo slong ba'am ga ga tshil byed pa dang g.ya' ri las skyes pa'i sgog pa skyi g.ya' ba 'jigs pa skrag pa'am ba spu'i bu ga za ba lcags sogs kyi g.ya' btsa' glo bur dri ma lta bu g.yu rin chen drug dmar drug dkar// g.yung mo rigs ngan ma sogs dang g.yung po'ang g.yo sgyu g.yo thabs sam slu ba dang gya gyu g.yeng bag rgod bag g.yeng bag snang g.yel g.yag dud 'gro'i khyad par// g.yas pa phyogs dang brnyas pa g.yon pa phyogs dang mi brtan pa 'khyog pa g.yul dmag gam 'khrug pa sprod pa 'thab tu 'jug pa 'gyed pa g.yul las dmag las sam thog las g.yog las ka'am bya ba dang g.yog rgyug pa dang bran khol// mig g.yor zla ba gnyis snang lta bu'am grib ma ste sgyu ma'i dpe kha g.yal ba glal ba gdang ba g.yar tsha ba ni ngo tsha ba skyengs pa zhal ngo tsha ba// g.yar khral kha khral lam khral g.yar dam dam bca' zhal bzhes g.yar khams sku khams sam khams g.yar zhes pa kha gdong mdun sogs kyi zhe sa'i tshig dang zhe sa'i tshig tsam yang yod pas skabs phyed dgos pa dang // yul gyi snang ba la g.yel ba g.yeng ba dang g.yer bag dang sa yangs pa g.yer kha dril chung sogs dang g.yer ba g.ya' ba g.ya' ri g.yog 'khor g.yung ba rus kyi g.yung g.ya' kyi ma sogs gas 'phul ya'o//

(ra) ༈ ra dud 'gro'i khyar par lug bal ldan rwa co mgo skyes kyi ru rdul phran du rlog pa brlag pa 'joms pa 'thag pa// mngon par rlom pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal lam nga rgyal ba'am sems pa rlom pa chags pa'am nga rgyal ba'am ma yin pa la yin par 'dzin pa'i sems te mkhas rlom lta bu bla ma sogs kyi byin rlabs rlob pa'i ming tsam ste lhag gnas sam nus pa'i don yin snyam rlobs shig byin gyis rlob pa'i skul tshig /rlon pa gsher ba brlan pa rlag byed gnod byed 'joms byed dang stor byed 'doms gsang gnas kyi rlig pa sgro ba 'bras bu// rlabs chen bya ba rgya chen thabs chen phyod chen dba' rlabs chu rlabs mtsho rlabs lta bu rlangs pa drod skyes sa rlangs kha rlangs sogs rlung g.yo byed skyod byed 'byung bzhi'i gcig /rlam khyer ham pas khyer ba khrag rlangs khrag gi drod rlangs sam khrag rdog rlan rlon gsher ba'am skom mam btung ba chang sogs te rlan pa rlon pa'i don 'dra// rlag mo rnyang ma'am skyag sla rlugs pa zas ma zhu bar 'og nas 'thon pa ste bshal ba lta bu khung bu'i don can gyi rlubs bu ga dang dong dang dma' ba// dud 'gro re'u la sogs pa'i pags pa sbubs bshus byas pa la rlid bu zer zhing grod chung ngam pags khug la yang 'jug par mngon rlob pa rlom pa rlan pa rlung po rlung nad sogs rkyang pa yin pas bas 'phul med ces pa bshad zin gyi ming rkyang la yin no//

(brla) bcom brlag slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi yul tshig sogs brlang po rtsub po gyong po brlag bya dgra dang nor lta bu gzhom bya dang stor bya brlag po rlag pa'am rlog pa// lus kyi brla yi sha chu shing lta bu'i brla sogs chu dang mchil mas brlan pa rlon pa rlon pa gsher bar byas pa ya ma brla snying po med pa'am mi bden pa// grogs la blo brlug pa yid gcugs pa dang grogs po yang brtan pa la go ba'i brling ba 'gyur med sra ba lci ba tshugs pa dul ba zab pa byin gyis brlabs pa rlob pa bskyed pa lhag par gnas pa sogs// gdon 'dod pa 'jigs pa mya ngan gyis brlams pa bskyod pa smyo ba bslad pa zhugs pa brlam pa brlab pa brling po sogs bas 'phul rla'o// (la) ༈ lwa ba zhes pa ni gos kyi bye brag bal gos srab dkar sogs dang lug lugs lang langs long longs lag lags log logs lta bu rkyang pa las med kyang yang 'jug yod med kyi khyad par sogs shes dgos pa yin// (sha) ༈ shar nyi ma shar ba'i phyogs dang 'char ba'i don gyi ming shing rkang 'thung gi khar steng du shang shang 'dab chags shig shi ba 'chi ba// shul rjes sam mal dang lam du go shid zan gshin zas sam dad zas sam dge zas shel me shel chu shel spyan shel lta bu'i shel gyi ming shubs gtums snod// shed bu dang shed bdag dang shed las skyes gsum sems can nam gang zag gi ming shed ces pa yid dang stobs dang nyams dang tshangs pa// shun pa ni pags pa skogs pa shun lpags kyang snang sham thabs dge slong gi zlum por bgo bya'i gos shur bu ska rags kyi khyad par phre'u 'am ska rags tsam la go des bcings pa 'ching ba// shes ldan blo ldan mkhas pa dang sems can shin tu ha cang ngam nges par shub pu shub shub bam skad chung ngur smra ba// shan pa bshan pa gsod byed shwa 'od chu log dang shu ba shis pa shon shugs shes pa shor ba shong ba tshig phrad shing sogs sha rkyang ngo*//

(gsha) bde bar gshegs pa song ba 'gro ba rtogs pa spangs pa gshis lugs gnas lugs gnas tshul de bzhin du gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas// gshin po 'das po'i ming gshags rtsod pa tha dad shan 'byed pa po dpon nam dbang po gshin po rnams kyi rje bo mthar byed chos rgyal gshed gnod byed dgra dang gshed ma dang lha gshin rje gshed// gshen rabs bon po'i ston pa gshang rol mo cang dkrol ba 'khrol ba dbu skra mgo skra gshor ba rtsub pa mi 'jam pa/ /gshis ka rang bzhin rgyud ngan pa mi bzang ba g.yul dang mchod pa gshom pa bshams pa grabs byed pa'am sgrig pa gshung ba shub bur smod pa'am lkog kha gtong ba dang gshe ba spyo ba gshe gshe gtong ba// mo gsham rabs chad ma gsha' ma yang dag pa ngo ma lhad med pa yin du gsha' yin gsha' bden gsha' yod gsha' ngo ma bden pa gzhir bzhag pa dang 'thad pa 'os pa rigs pa// gshor snod cig dang yur ba'i gshor dang gsho tshul gyis chu sogs gsho ba bsho ba 'dor ba'am 'bo ba sogs shing gshog pa dang gshags pa gses pa bkas pa gnyis su byed pa// thong pa dang gshol mda' rmo spyad gsheg pa phyed pa kha gnyis su byed pa la 'jug cing 'dab ma la go ba'i gshog pa 'phur byed sogs gshibs pa gzhibs pa sgrig pa 'grogs pa// brlan pa la go ba'i gsher ba rlon pa bzha' bre dang phul gyis gshor ba 'jal ba bshar ba 'phrang lam la gshor ba bshar ba re re bzhin gral byas nas 'gro ba'am 'gro ba tsam yang*// gsham 'og ma phyi ma mtha' gsham gsal gyi sgra lta bu spang sogs kyi gshongs ljongs sam gzhongs dang sgang min pa zhing gi sa sogs gshin pa mnyen pa snyi ba 'jam pa dul ba mthun pa gshin po// gshong bu dma' ba kyong kyong gzhong bu'am skun bu'ang yin snyam mnyes gshin gshol 'dzin rus kyi gshen gshegs pa gshar ba gsho ba 'di bshos pa'i da lta bar bzhag na 'bob 'khrig pa zas g.yo ba gci bar 'jug gsham ma la sogs gas 'phul sha'o//

(bsha) mdza' ba'i bshes gcugs pa'i grogs sam grogs po dge ba'i bshes bla ma'am legs grogs lha sogs kyi bshos zhal zas sam g.yos zas bshams pa gshom pa sgrig pa bkod pa// sdig pa mi dge bshags pa 'chags pa mthol ba phyi bshol phyi bsnur phyi 'then le lo bshul ni lam 'jug ngogs bshar ba gshor ba song ba// bshum pa dang bshums pa gnyis ngu ba cho nge 'don pa bshal ba ni drud pa dang 'then pa bshud pa 'dar ba phud pa 'thon pa ste ldan pa dang lag pa bshud nas bshags pa gshags pa bkas pa phye ba gtar ba// bsha' tshe bsha' dkar sogs bgo bsha' skal ba bgo ba'i ming ri dwags ri skyes bshar ba gshor ba rngon pa// rgyab kyi bshul rgyab gzhung ngam sgal pa bshul sha lta bu pags shun yi ge dpe bshus pa bshu ba bkog pa phud pa ma dpe ltar bkod pa bshan pa rigs ngan shan pas lug bshas pa bsad pa srog bcad pa// me lce la sogs par bshur ba snam bu sogs dngos ma tshig par spu ring dang phyi shun lta bu tshig bcug pa chu dang sbyong sman gyis snod dang pho ba bshal ba dag par byas pa bkru ba 'khru ba sbyong ba bshang ba dri chen skyag pa gci ba gcin pa bsho ba gsho ba bshos pa// mkhar dang khrims bshig pa 'jig pa gzhig pa 'joms pa sogs bre phul gyis bshar ba gshor ba 'phrang lam la bshar ba gshor ba// smyug sbubs sogs bshangs pa nang drus pa'am bsal ba'am brtol ba bshang ba dpe don bshad pa 'chad pa brjod pa 'grel ba ste rtsa tshogs slob 'grel rnam rgyas chos bshad lta bu dang bshol ba bshos pa bshul gtam bsher ba bshu ba shad kyis bshad pa sogs bas 'phul sha'o// (sa) ༈ sangs pa sad pa spangs pa rgyas pa bye ba rtogs pa ste thub dbang sogs sor mo nas bdun gyi tshad mdzub mo nying lag sen mo slar skyes so tshems dang gri so rdza so so btsugs pa sogs// sil zhes pa'i sgra snyan par sgrog pa ste rol mo zhig sil sil sil snyan gyi sgra lta bu se mo nu ma gnyis kyi dbus thad du sleb pa'i do shal te do shal phyed pa rgyan cha zhig

/tshe la go ba'i srog gi dbang po lus shes kyi rten srung ba skyob pa 'tsho ba bsrung zhing 'od srung rigs kyi khyad par te 'od srung chen po lta bu sras bu dang bu mo gnyis ka'am bu la go /srid pa 'khor ba dang rten 'brel gyi gcig dang 'byung bar go sgo gsum drang por srong ba ste phyi nang gi thub pa srol lugs lam yur ba tshugs pa btsugs pa srid pa rung ba'am btub pa skye ba shes bya la srid dpe srid gal srid// srod mtshan stod dam srod 'khor gyi dus tshod sa sros sa sribs pa sa rib pa sre nag thab snod kyi nag dreg sogs srab pa bsrab pa phra ba mthug min// srin po 'byung po sha za lus srul po gdon zhig sa srung bu brgya byin gyi glang chen// srubs par ram gseng ngam gseb kyi ming lam srang srang lam khang bar gyi lam dang rgya lam srid dkyus sam khrun du go srings ring du skur ba gtong ba sring ba'i skul tshig yid srubs bdud dang 'dod chags kyis sreg pa gdung ba tshig pa thal bar byed pa sring mo phu mo nu mo gnyis kar go sred pa zhen pa mngon par chags pa// sru mo ma'i spun zla mo'i ming sri zhu bkur sti'am zhabs phyi sri'u bu chung ngam khye'u'i ming sri dar sri phung sri sogs te gnod byed dam nyams byed kyi don 'dra// sre mo srog chags sre mo sreg pa 'dab chags shig srin bya 'ug pa'am 'ug pa las chung ba'i bya zhig sram 'ug pa mchod byed// phyi nang gi srin bu srog chags phra mo sro ma shig gi sro ma'am nyi rdul bdun gyi tshad srad bu skud pa sra ba mkhregs pa gar ma snying po spro// ji srid ji tsam de srid de tsam mam de'i bar ram ring sran ma 'bru'i khyad par srus snye ma'i srus// bsnyen pa nye ba sring ba ring ba ring du gtong ba spring ba skyed pa 'degs pa bsring ba sreg byed sreg pa po me lta bu sreg blugs sbyin sreg gi rdzas sam sreg zas dang*// rgyal po'i srid rgyal po'i las sam bya ba mun sribs pa sa sros pa gdags kyi zlas phye ba'i sribs zhes pa
